title.zh: 卷6 本紀六 圣祖本紀一
title.raw: 卷6 本紀六 圣祖本紀一

sentences.zh: 聖祖合天弘運文武睿哲恭儉寬裕孝敬誠信功德大成仁皇帝，諱玄燁，世祖第三子也。

translations.literal: The Sacred Ancestor, Emperor Ren of the posthumous style Harmonizing with Heaven, Grandly Fortunate, Civil and Martial, Sagely and Wise, Respectful and Frugal, Generous and Liberal, Filial and Reverent, Sincere and Trustworthy, of Virtue and Merit Greatly Accomplished and Benevolent — taboo name Xuanye — was the third son of the Shizu Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: The Sacred Ancestor, Emperor Ren — whose full posthumous title runs “Harmonizing with Heaven, Grandly Fortunate, Civil and Martial, Sagely and Wise, Respectful and Frugal, Generous and Liberal, Filial and Reverent, Sincere and Trustworthy, of Virtue and Merit Greatly Accomplished and Benevolent” — bore the taboo name Xuanye and was the Shunzhi Emperor’s third son.

sentences.zh: 母孝康章皇后佟佳氏，順治十一年三月戊申誕上於景仁宮。

translations.literal: His mother was Empress Xiaokang Zhang of the Tonggiya clan. In the third month, day wushen, of the eleventh year of Shunzhi, the emperor was born in the Jingren Palace.
translations.idiomatic: His mother was Empress Xiaokang Zhang of the Tonggiya clan. On the wushen day of the third month in Shunzhi year eleven, he was born in the Jingren Palace.

sentences.zh: 天表英俊，岳立聲洪。

translations.literal: His heavenly countenance was handsome; he stood like a mountain peak and his voice was resonant.
translations.idiomatic: He was handsome of feature, stood tall as a peak, and spoke in a deep, carrying voice.

sentences.zh: 六齡，偕兄弟問安。

translations.literal: At age six, together with his brothers he went to inquire after [the emperor’s] well-being.
translations.idiomatic: At six he went with his brothers to pay their respects and inquire after the emperor’s health.

sentences.zh: 世祖問所欲。

translations.literal: The Shizu Emperor asked what they desired.
translations.idiomatic: The Shunzhi Emperor asked each what he wished for.

sentences.zh: 皇二子福全言：「原為賢王。

translations.literal: The second imperial son Fuyuan said: “I wish to be a worthy prince.
translations.idiomatic: The second imperial son, Fuyuan, said, “I wish to be a worthy prince.”

sentences.zh: 」帝言：「原效法父皇。

translations.literal: ” The emperor said: “I wish to emulate my imperial father.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor replied, “I wish to follow my imperial father’s example.”

sentences.zh: 」世祖異焉。

translations.literal: ” The Shizu Emperor marveled at this.
translations.idiomatic: The Shunzhi Emperor was struck with wonder.

sentences.zh: 順治十八年正月丙辰，世祖崩，帝即位，年八歲，改元康熙。

translations.literal: In the first month, day bingchen, of the eighteenth year of Shunzhi, the Shizu Emperor died; the emperor assumed the throne at age eight, and the era name was changed to Kangxi.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen day of the first month in Shunzhi year eighteen the Shunzhi Emperor died; Xuanye ascended the throne at eight sui and the reign was titled Kangxi.

sentences.zh: 遺詔索尼、蘇克薩哈、遏必隆、鰲拜四大臣輔政。

translations.literal: By the late emperor’s testament, the four great ministers Sonin, Suksaha, Ebilun, and Oboi were appointed to assist in government.
translations.idiomatic: By the late emperor’s will, Sonin, Suksaha, Ebilun, and Oboi were named the four regent ministers.

sentences.zh: 二月癸未，上釋服。

translations.literal: Second month, day guiwei — the emperor doffed mourning garb.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiwei day of the second month the emperor left off mourning dress.

sentences.zh: 乙未，誅有罪內監吳良輔，罷內官。

translations.literal: Day yiwei — the guilty eunuch Wu Liangfu was executed; palace eunuchs were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei the guilty eunuch Wu Liangfu was put to death and the palace eunuch establishment was abolished.

sentences.zh: 丙申，以嗣簡親王濟度子德塞襲爵。

translations.literal: Day bingshen — Dese, son of Prince Jian of the First Rank Jidu, was granted to succeed to the title.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen Dese, son of Prince Jian of the First Rank Jidu, was permitted to inherit the princedom.

sentences.zh: 三月丙寅，詔曰：「國家法度，代有不同。

translations.literal: Third month, day bingyin — an edict said: “The laws and institutions of the state differ from age to age.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingyin day of the third month an edict declared: “State law and custom differ from one age to another.

sentences.zh: 太祖、太宗創製定法，垂裕後昆。

translations.literal: The Taizu and Taizong established and fixed the laws, leaving abundance for posterity.
translations.idiomatic: The Taizu and Taizong created institutions and set laws, leaving a generous legacy to later generations.

sentences.zh: 今或滿、漢參差，或前後更易。

translations.literal: Now whether Manchu and Han differ, or earlier and later rules are changed—
translations.idiomatic: Today some provisions diverge between Manchu and Han, and some rules have been altered from earlier to later times.

sentences.zh: 其詳考成憲，勒為典章，集議以聞。

translations.literal: let these be examined in detail against established statutes, carved into canonical regulations, and deliberated upon for report.
translations.idiomatic: Let the established statutes be searched out in full, compiled into a code, and the result submitted after joint deliberation.”
Thus concluded the edict.

sentences.zh: 四月，予殉葬侍衛傅達理祭葬。

translations.literal: Fourth month — sacrificial rites and funeral honors were granted to the guard Fu Dali who died in attendance at the burial.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month sacrificial offerings and funeral rites were granted to the guard Fu Dali, who had died in service at the imperial burial.

sentences.zh: 甲申，命湖廣總督駐荊州。

translations.literal: Day jiashen — the Huguang Governor-General was ordered to take station at Jingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen the governor-general of Huguang was ordered to establish his headquarters at Jingzhou.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，命將軍線國安統定南部軍鎮廣西。

translations.literal: Day yiyou — General Xian Guo’an was ordered to command the southern army garrison of Ding in Guangxi.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou General Xian Guo’an was appointed to command the southern army at the Ding garrison in Guangxi.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，以拉哈達為工部尚書。

translations.literal: Day bingxu — Lahada was appointed Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu Lahada was made Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，安南國王黎維祺遣使入貢。

translations.literal: Day guimao — the king of Annam, Li Weiqi, dispatched envoys to present tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao Li Weiqi, king of Annam, sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 丙午，大學士洪承疇乞休，允之，予三等輕車都尉世職。

translations.literal: Day bingwu — Grand Secretary Hong Chengchou requested retirement; it was granted, and he was given the hereditary rank of Third-class Commandant of Light Chariots.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu Grand Secretary Hong Chengchou asked to retire; the request was granted and he received the hereditary office of third-class commandant of light chariots.

sentences.zh: 戊申，賜馬世俊等三百八十三人進士及第出身有差。

translations.literal: Day wushen — Ma Shijun and three hundred eighty-three others were granted differing ranks as jinshi who passed the palace examination.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen Ma Shijun and three hundred eighty-three others were awarded jinshi honors with graded ranks according to their examination placement.

sentences.zh: 五月，罷各省巡按官。

translations.literal: Fifth month — the touring censor posts in each province were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month the provincial touring censorates were abolished.

sentences.zh: 己巳，以高景為工部尚書，劉良佐為江安提督。

translations.literal: Day jisi — Gao Jing was appointed Minister of Works, and Liu Liangzuo was made Jiang’an provincial military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi Gao Jing was appointed Minister of Works and Liu Liangzuo was made military commissioner of Jiang’an.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，安南叛臣莫敬耀來歸，封歸化將軍。

translations.literal: Day yihai — Mo Jingyao, a rebel minister of Annam, came over in submission and was enfeoffed as General of Submissive Transformation.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai Mo Jingyao, a renegade minister of Annam, submitted and was enfeoffed as General of Submissive Transformation.

sentences.zh: 六月己卯，江蘇巡撫朱國治疏言蘇省逋賦紳衿一萬三千五百十七人，下部斥黜有差。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day jimao — Jiangsu governor Zhu Guozhi memorialized that in Su province thirteen thousand five hundred seventeen gentry and officials were in arrears on land tax; the ministry was ordered to dismiss and degrade them in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: On the jimao day of the sixth month Jiangsu governor Zhu Guozhi reported that in Suzhou circuit 13,517 gentry and officials owed land-tax arrears; the ministry was instructed to dismiss or degrade them according to the degree of offense.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，黑龍江飛牙喀部十屯來歸。

translations.literal: Day xinsi — ten villages of the Feiyaka tribe of Heilongjiang came over in submission.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi ten Feiyaka villages of Heilongjiang submitted.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，以嗣信郡王鐸尼子鄂扎襲爵。

translations.literal: Day gengyin — Ezha, son of Prince Xin of the First Rank Duoni, was granted to succeed to the title.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin Ezha, son of Prince Xin of the First Rank Duoni, was permitted to inherit the princedom.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，大學士傅以漸乞休，允之。

translations.literal: Day guisi — Grand Secretary Fu Yijian requested retirement; it was granted.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi Grand Secretary Fu Yijian asked to retire and was allowed to do so.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，罷內閣，復內三院。

translations.literal: Day dingyou — the Grand Secretariat was abolished and the Three Inner Academies were restored.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou the Grand Secretariat was abolished and the three inner academies were restored.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，吳三桂進馴象五，卻之。

translations.literal: Day wuxu — Wu Sangui presented five tame elephants; they were declined.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu Wu Sangui offered five tame elephants; the court refused them.

sentences.zh: 詔停直省進獻。

translations.literal: An edict halted tribute submissions from all provinces.
translations.idiomatic: An edict stopped tribute gifts from every province.

sentences.zh: 閏七月庚辰，以車克為吏部尚書，阿思哈為戶部尚書。

translations.literal: Intercalary seventh month, day gengchen — Cheke was appointed Minister of Personnel, and Asihan was appointed Minister of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengchen day of the intercalary seventh month Cheke was made Minister of Personnel and Asihan Minister of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 甲午，以傅維鱗為工部尚書。

translations.literal: Day jiawu — Fu Weilin was appointed Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu Fu Weilin was appointed Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，予蘇松提督梁化鳳男爵。

translations.literal: Day renyin — Liang Huafeng, provincial military commissioner of Su-Song, was granted a baronage for his son.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin a baronage was granted to the son of Liang Huafeng, military commissioner of Su-Song.

sentences.zh: 八月甲寅，達賴喇麻請通市，許之。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day jiayin — the Dalai Lama requested permission for border trade; it was granted.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiayin day of the eighth month the Dalai Lama petitioned to open border markets; permission was given.

sentences.zh: 九月丁未，以卞三元為雲南總督，李棲鳳為廣東總督，郎廷佐為江南總督，梁化鳳為江南提督。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day dingwei — Bian Sanyuan was appointed Yunnan governor-general, Li Qifeng Guangdong governor-general, Lang Tingzuo Jiangnan governor-general, and Liang Huafeng Jiangnan provincial military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingwei day of the ninth month Bian Sanyuan was made governor-general of Yunnan, Li Qifeng of Guangdong, Lang Tingzuo of Jiangnan, and Liang Huafeng military commissioner of Jiangnan.

sentences.zh: 十月己酉，以林起龍為漕運總督。

translations.literal: Tenth month, day jiyou — Lin Qilong was appointed grain-transport governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiyou day of the tenth month Lin Qilong was appointed grain-transport governor-general.

sentences.zh: 誅降將鄭芝龍及其子世恩、世廕。

translations.literal: The surrendered general Zheng Zhilong and his sons Shien and Shiyin were executed.
translations.idiomatic: The surrendered general Zheng Zhilong and his sons Shien and Shiyin were put to death.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，裁順天巡撫。

translations.literal: Day xinyou — the Shuntian governor was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou the post of Shuntian governor was abolished.

sentences.zh: 山東民於七作亂，逮問巡撫許文秀，總兵李永盛、范承宗，命靖東將軍濟世哈討平之。

translations.literal: The people of Shandong rose in disorder under Yu Qi; the governor Xu Wenxiu, the regional commander Li Yongsheng, and Fan Chengzong were arrested and questioned; the Pacification Commissioner of the East Jishiha was ordered to suppress the rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Qi led a popular rising in Shandong; Governor Xu Wenxiu and regional commanders Li Yongsheng and Fan Chengzong were seized for investigation; Pacification Commissioner of the East Jishiha was ordered to put down the disturbance.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙子朔，上親祀天於圜丘。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day bingzi, first day of the month — the emperor personally sacrificed to Heaven at the Round Mound.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day, bingzi, of the eleventh month the emperor offered Heaven sacrifice at the Round Mound in person.

sentences.zh: 己亥，世祖章皇帝升祔太廟。

translations.literal: Day jihai — the Zhang Emperor of the Shizu line was enshrined in the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai the late Shunzhi Emperor was given a place in the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，湖南巡按御史仵劭昕坐贓棄市。

translations.literal: Day jiachen — the Hunan touring censor Wu Shaoxin was executed in the marketplace for corruption.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen Wu Shaoxin, touring censor of Hunan, was beheaded in the marketplace for graft.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙午，平西王吳三桂、定西將軍愛星阿會報大軍入緬，緬人執明永曆帝朱由榔以獻。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day bingwu — the Prince of the West Wu Sangui and the Pacification Commissioner of the West Ai Xing’a jointly reported that the great army had entered Burma, and the Burmese handed over the Yongli Emperor Zhu Youlang as a captive.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingwu day of the twelfth month Wu Sangui, Prince of the West, and Pacification Commissioner Ai Xing’a reported jointly that the main force had entered Burma and that the Burmese delivered the Yongli Emperor Zhu Youlang as prisoner.

sentences.zh: 明將白文選降。

translations.literal: The Ming general Bai Wenxuan surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: The Ming commander Bai Wenxuan surrendered.

sentences.zh: 班師。

translations.literal: The army withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: The troops were withdrawn.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，宗人府進玉牒。

translations.literal: Day dingmao — the Imperial Clan Court presented the jade genealogy.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao the Imperial Clan Court submitted the jade genealogy register.

sentences.zh: 是歲免直隸、江南、河南、浙江、湖廣、陝西各州縣被災額賦有差。

translations.literal: That year land-tax quotas were remitted in varying degrees for disaster-stricken districts in Zhili, Jiangnan, Henan, Zhejiang, Huguang, and Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: That year disaster remissions of land tax were granted, in varying amounts, to affected districts in Zhili, Jiangnan, Henan, Zhejiang, Huguang, and Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 朝鮮遣使進香入貢。

translations.literal: Korea dispatched envoys to offer incense and tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Korea sent envoys with incense and tribute.

sentences.zh: 康熙元年壬寅春正月乙亥朔。

translations.literal: Kangxi year 1, spring, first month, day yihai — new year’s day.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Kangxi, on the yihai day of the first month of spring, the new year opened.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，享太廟。

translations.literal: Day yiyou — offerings were presented at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou the court sacrificed at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，錄大學士范文程等佐命功，官其子承謨等俱內院學士。

translations.literal: Day gengyin — the merit of Grand Secretary Fan Wencheng and others in assisting the founding enterprise was recorded; their sons Chengmo and others were all appointed academicians of the inner court.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin the services of Grand Secretary Fan Wencheng and others in establishing the dynasty were entered in the record, and their sons, including Chengmo, were appointed inner-court academicians.

sentences.zh: 二月壬子，太皇太后萬壽節，上率群臣朝賀。

translations.literal: Second month, day renzi — the Grand Empress Dowager’s longevity celebration; the emperor led the officials in court congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi day of the second month, the Grand Empress Dowager’s birthday, the emperor led the officials in congratulatory audience.

sentences.zh: 三月，以滇南平，告廟祭陵，赦天下。

translations.literal: Third month — because Yunnan had been pacified, the ancestral temple and imperial tombs were notified and a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, with the south of Yunnan pacified, victory was announced at the ancestral shrines and imperial tombs and an empire-wide amnesty was declared.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，萬壽節。

translations.literal: Day xinmao — longevity celebration.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao the longevity rites were observed.

sentences.zh: 己亥，遣官安輯浙江、福建、廣東新附官民。

translations.literal: Day jihai — officials were dispatched to settle and reassure officials and people newly brought under rule in Zhejiang, Fujian, and Guangdong.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai commissioners were sent to pacify officials and commoners newly submitted in Zhejiang, Fujian, and Guangdong.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丙辰，上太祖、太宗尊諡。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day bingchen — posthumous honorific titles were conferred on the Taizu and Taizong.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on bingchen, posthumous titles were bestowed on the Taizu and Taizong.

sentences.zh: 五月戊寅，夏至，上親祭地於方澤。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day wuyin — the summer solstice; the emperor personally sacrificed to Earth at the Square Mound.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuyin day of the fifth month, at the summer solstice, the emperor sacrificed to Earth at the Square Mound in person.

sentences.zh: 六月丁未，命禮部考定貴賤等威。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day dingwei — the Ministry of Rites was ordered to fix the ritual distinctions of noble and humble ranks.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingwei day of the sixth month the Ministry of Rites was instructed to codify ritual distinctions between high and low status.

sentences.zh: 秋七月壬申朔，以車克為大學士，寧古禮為戶部尚書，張傑為浙江提督，施琅為福建提督。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day renshen, first day of the month — Cheke was appointed Grand Secretary, Ningguli Minister of Revenue, Zhang Jie Zhejiang military commissioner, and Shi Lang Fujian military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day, renshen, of the seventh month of autumn Cheke was made Grand Secretary, Ningguli Minister of Revenue, Zhang Jie military commissioner of Zhejiang, and Shi Lang of Fujian.

sentences.zh: 八月辛丑朔，大學士金之俊罷。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day xinchou, first day of the month — Grand Secretary Jin Zhijun was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day, xinchou, of the eighth month Grand Secretary Jin Zhijun was removed from office.

sentences.zh: 九月，裁延綏巡撫。

translations.literal: Ninth month — the Yansui governor was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month the governorship of Yansui was abolished.

sentences.zh: 冬十月壬寅，以成克鞏為大學士。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day renyin — Cheng Kegong was appointed Grand Secretary.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin day of the tenth month of winter Cheng Kegong was appointed Grand Secretary.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，尊皇太后為太皇太后。

translations.literal: Day guimao — the empress dowager was honored as Grand Empress Dowager.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao the empress dowager was elevated to Grand Empress Dowager.

sentences.zh: 尊皇后為仁憲皇太后，母后為慈和皇太后。

translations.literal: The empress was honored as Grand Empress Dowager Renxian; the emperor’s mother was honored as Grand Empress Dowager Cihe.
translations.idiomatic: The empress was raised to Grand Empress Dowager Renxian, and the emperor’s mother to Grand Empress Dowager Cihe.

sentences.zh: 十一月辛巳，冬至，祀天於圜丘，免朝賀。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day xinsi — the winter solstice; Heaven was sacrificed to at the Round Mound, and court congratulations were waived.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinsi day of the eleventh month, at the winter solstice, Heaven sacrifice was offered at the Round Mound and the congratulatory audience was dispensed with.

sentences.zh: 十二月辛酉，命吳三桂總管雲南、貴州兩省。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day xinyou — Wu Sangui was ordered to exercise overall control of Yunnan and Guizhou provinces.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinyou day of the twelfth month Wu Sangui was placed in general charge of Yunnan and Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 是歲，天下戶丁一千九百一十三萬七千六百五十二，徵銀二千五百七十二萬四千一百二十四兩零。

translations.literal: That year registered households throughout the realm numbered nineteen million one hundred thirty-seven thousand six hundred fifty-two; land tax collected was twenty-five million seven hundred twenty-four thousand one hundred twenty-four taels and fractions.
translations.idiomatic: That year empire-wide registered households totaled 19,137,652; land tax receipts came to 25,724,124 taels and odd cash.

sentences.zh: 鹽課銀二百七十二萬一千二百一十二兩零。

translations.literal: Salt monopoly revenue was two million seven hundred twenty-one thousand two hundred twelve taels and fractions.
translations.idiomatic: Salt-tax revenue was 2,721,212 taels and odd cash.

sentences.zh: 鑄錢二萬九千萬有奇。

translations.literal: Coin was cast to the amount of two hundred ninety million and odd.
translations.idiomatic: Copper cash coined exceeded 290,000,000 strings.

sentences.zh: 免直隸、江南各州縣災賦有差。

translations.literal: Disaster land-tax quotas were remitted in varying degrees for districts in Zhili and Jiangnan.
translations.idiomatic: Disaster remissions of land tax were granted, in varying amounts, to affected districts in Zhili and Jiangnan.

sentences.zh: 朝鮮入貢。

translations.literal: Korea presented tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Korea sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 二年癸卯春正月己亥，廣東總督盧崇峻請封民船濟師，斥之。

translations.literal: Year 2, spring, first month, day jihai — Guangdong Governor-General Lu Chongjun requested that civilian vessels be chartered to transport troops; the request was rejected.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi year two, on the jihai day of the first month of spring, Guangdong governor-general Lu Chongjun asked permission to hire merchant ships for troop transport; the court refused.

sentences.zh: 二月庚戌，慈和皇太后佟佳氏崩。

translations.literal: Second month, day gengxu — Grand Empress Dowager Cihe of the Tonggiya clan died.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu day of the second month Grand Empress Dowager Cihe of the Tonggiya clan died.

sentences.zh: 三月，荷蘭國遣使入貢，請助師討台灣，優賚之。

translations.literal: Third month — the Netherlands dispatched envoys with tribute, requesting aid in an expedition against Taiwan; they were generously rewarded.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month the Dutch sent tribute envoys asking troops to help attack Taiwan; they were treated with generous gifts.

sentences.zh: 五月丙子，以孫廷銓為大學士。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day bingzi — Sun Tingquan was appointed Grand Secretary.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingzi day of the fifth month Sun Tingquan was made Grand Secretary.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，雲南開局鑄錢。

translations.literal: Day yiyou — coining was opened at a mint in Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou a mint was established in Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，詔天下錢糧統歸戶部，部寺應用，俱向戶部關領，著為令。

translations.literal: Day bingxu — an edict ordered that land tax and grain payments empire-wide be unified under the Ministry of Revenue, and that all ministries and courts draw funds from the Ministry of Revenue; this was established as a permanent rule.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu an edict centralized all land tax and grain payments under the Ministry of Revenue and required every ministry and court to draw its funds from that ministry alone, fixing the rule for the future.

sentences.zh: 戊子，以魏裔介為吏部尚書。

translations.literal: Day wuzi — Wei Yijie was appointed Minister of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi Wei Yijie was appointed Minister of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 甲午，恭上大行慈和皇太后尊諡曰孝康慈和庄懿恭惠崇天育聖皇后。

translations.literal: Day jiawu — the late Grand Empress Dowager Cihe was honored with the posthumous title Empress Xiaokang, Cihe, Zhuangyi, Gonghui, Chongtian, Yusheng.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu the late Grand Empress Dowager Cihe received the posthumous title Empress Xiaokang Cihe Zhuangyi Gonghui Chongtian Yusheng.

sentences.zh: 六月，葬世祖章皇帝於孝陵，孝康皇后、端敬皇后祔焉。

translations.literal: Sixth month — the Zhang Emperor of the Shizu line was buried at the Xiaoling; Empresses Xiaokang and Duanjing were enshrined with him.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month the Shunzhi Emperor was interred at the Xiaoling, with Empresses Xiaokang and Duanjing enshrined beside him.

sentences.zh: 戊申，以龔鼎孳為左都御史。

translations.literal: Day wushen — Gong Dingzi was appointed Censor-in-chief of the Left.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen Gong Dingzi was made left censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，故明將李定國子嗣興來降。

translations.literal: Day yimao — Li Sixing, son of the former Ming general Li Dingguo, came over in submission.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao Li Sixing, son of the former Ming commander Li Dingguo, submitted.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，以哈爾庫為浙江提督。

translations.literal: Day yichou — Harku was appointed Zhejiang military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou Harku was appointed military commissioner of Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 八月癸卯，詔鄉、會試停製義，改用策論，復八旗繙譯鄉試。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day guimao — an edict halted the eight-legged essay in provincial and metropolitan examinations, substituting policy questions and discursive essays, and restored the Manchu translation provincial examination for the Eight Banners.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day of the eighth month an edict abolished the eight-legged examination essay in favor of policy questions and discursive themes, and revived the banner translation provincial examination.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，命穆里瑪為靖西將軍，圖海為定西將軍，率禁旅會四川、湖廣、陝西總督討鄖陽逋賊李來亨、郝搖旗等。

translations.literal: Day jiayin — Muluwa was appointed Pacification Commissioner of the West, Tu Hai Pacification Commissioner of Ding, to lead the guards and join the governors-general of Sichuan, Huguang, and Shaanxi in suppressing the Shunyang bandits Li Laigang, Hao Yaoqi, and others.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin Muluwa was named Pacification Commissioner of the West and Tu Hai Pacification Commissioner of Ding, to lead the guards and cooperate with the governors-general of Sichuan, Huguang, and Shaanxi against the Shunyang fugitives Li Laigang, Hao Yaoqi, and their fellows.

sentences.zh: 冬十月壬寅，耿繼茂、施琅會荷蘭師船剿海寇，克廈門，取浯嶼、金門二島，鄭錦遁於台灣。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day renyin — Geng Jimao and Shi Lang, joining Dutch warships, attacked sea rebels, took Xiamen, seized the islands of Wuyu and Jinmen, and Zheng Jing fled to Taiwan.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin day of the tenth month of winter Geng Jimao and Shi Lang, with Dutch naval allies, struck the sea rebels, captured Xiamen and the islands of Wuyu and Jinmen, and Zheng Jing withdrew to Taiwan.

sentences.zh: 十一月，詔免諸國貢使土物稅。

translations.literal: Eleventh month — an edict remitted duties on native products presented by tribute envoys from all states.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month an edict exempted tribute envoys from all countries from tax on local products they carried.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，冬至，祀天於圜丘。

translations.literal: Day yiyou — the winter solstice; Heaven was sacrificed to at the Round Mound.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, the winter solstice, Heaven sacrifice was offered at the Round Mound.

sentences.zh: 十二月壬戌，祫祭太廟。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day renxu — a collective offering was made at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On the renxu day of the twelfth month a collective ancestral sacrifice was performed.

sentences.zh: 是歲，免直隸、江南、江西、河南、陝西、浙江、湖廣、四川、雲南、貴州等省二百七十餘州縣災賦。

translations.literal: That year disaster land tax was remitted for more than two hundred seventy districts in Zhili, Jiangnan, Jiangxi, Henan, Shaanxi, Zhejiang, Huguang, Sichuan, Yunnan, Guizhou, and other provinces.
translations.idiomatic: That year disaster remissions of land tax were granted to more than 270 districts in Zhili, Jiangnan, Jiangxi, Henan, Shaanxi, Zhejiang, Huguang, Sichuan, Yunnan, Guizhou, and elsewhere.

sentences.zh: 朝鮮入貢進香。

translations.literal: Korea presented tribute and incense.
translations.idiomatic: Korea sent tribute and incense offerings.

sentences.zh: 三年甲辰春正月，賜朝正外籓銀幣鞍馬。

translations.literal: Year 3, spring, first month — on the new-year audience, silver, coins, saddles, and horses were bestowed on outer feudatories.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi year three, at the spring new-year audience, outer vassals were granted silver, coin, saddles, and horses.

sentences.zh: 二月壬寅，巡鹽御史張吉午請增長蘆鹽引。

translations.literal: Second month, day renyin — the salt-censor Zhang Jiwu requested an increase in salt certificates for the Changlu circuit.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin day of the second month salt censor Zhang Jiwu asked to enlarge Changlu salt quotas.

sentences.zh: 斥之。

translations.literal: The request was rejected.
translations.idiomatic: The request was rejected.

sentences.zh: 三月丙子，耿繼茂等拔銅山。

translations.literal: Third month, day bingzi — Geng Jimao and others captured Tongshan.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingzi day of the third month Geng Jimao and his forces took Tongshan.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，賜嚴我斯等一百九十九人進士及第出身有差。

translations.literal: On bingxu day, bestowed differentiated status as jinshi graduates and office appointments upon Yan Wosi and one hundred ninety-nine others.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingxu day, Yan Wosi and one hundred ninety-nine others were granted the jinshi degree and appointed to office with differentiated ranks.

sentences.zh: 夏四月己亥，輔臣等誣奏內大臣飛揚古子侍衛倭赫擅騎御馬，飛揚古怨望，並棄市，籍其家，鰲拜以予其弟穆里瑪。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, jihai day: the regents falsely memorialized that Inner Minister Feiyanggu's son, guardsman Wohe, had unlawfully ridden the imperial horse; Feiyanggu bore resentment — both were executed at the marketplace, their households confiscated, and Oboi granted the property to his younger brother Murima.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the jihai day, the regents falsely charged that guardsman Wohe, son of Inner Minister Feiyanggu, had ridden the imperial horse without leave and that Feiyanggu had shown resentment; both were executed, their estates were confiscated, and Oboi gave the property to his brother Murima.

sentences.zh: 遣尚書喀蘭圖赴科爾沁四十七旗蒞盟。

translations.literal: Sent Minister Kelantu to the forty-seven banners of Khorchin to preside over the league assembly.
translations.idiomatic: Minister Kelantu was dispatched to the forty-seven Khorchin banners to preside at the league assembly.

sentences.zh: 戊申，裁鄖陽撫治。

translations.literal: On wushen day, the office of Xiangyang supervising commissioner was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On the wushen day the Xiangyang supervising commissioner was abolished.

sentences.zh: 五月甲子，詔州縣私派累民，上官容隱者並罪之。

translations.literal: Fifth month, jiazi day, edict: where counties and prefectures imposed unauthorized levies burdening the people, superiors who connived shall also be punished.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiazi day of the fifth month an edict declared that prefectural and county officials who imposed unauthorized levies on the people, and their superiors who covered it up, would all be punished.

sentences.zh: 六月庚申，詔免順治十五年以前逋賦。

translations.literal: Sixth month, gengshen day, edict exempting arrears in tax and grain levies prior to the fifteenth year of Shunzhi.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengshen day of the sixth month an edict remitted tax and grain arrears dating before the fifteenth year of Shunzhi.

sentences.zh: 閏六月乙酉，以王弘祚為刑部尚書。

translations.literal: Intercalary sixth month, yiyou day, appointed Wang Hongzuo Minister of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary sixth month, on the yiyou day, Wang Hongzuo was appointed Minister of Punishments.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，以漢軍京官歸入漢缺升轉。

translations.literal: On bingxu day, Han Army metropolitan officials were placed within Han quotas for promotion and transfer.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingxu day Han Army metropolitan officials were assigned to Han quotas for promotion and transfer.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丁未，以施琅為靖海將軍，征台灣。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, dingwei day, appointed Shi Lang Pacifying-the-Seas General to campaign against Taiwan.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the dingwei day, Shi Lang was made Pacifying-the-Seas General to campaign against Taiwan.

sentences.zh: 八月甲戌，浙江總督趙廷臣疏報擒獲明臣張煌言。

translations.literal: Eighth month, jiaxu day, Zhejiang Governor-General Zhao Tingchen memorialized the capture of Ming minister Zhang Huangyan.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiaxu day of the eighth month, Zhejiang Governor-General Zhao Tingchen reported the capture of the Ming minister Zhang Huangyan.

sentences.zh: 己卯，穆里瑪、圖海疏報進剿鄖陽茅麓山李來亨、郝搖旗，俱自焚，賊平。

translations.literal: On jimao day, Murima and Tulai memorialized the advance against Li Laiheng and Hao Yaoqi at Maolu Mountain in Xiangyang — both immolated themselves, and the bandits were pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On the jimao day Murima and Tulai reported that in the drive against Li Laiheng and Hao Yaoqi at Maolu Mountain in Xiangyang both men burned themselves to death and the rebels were pacified.

sentences.zh: 九月癸丑，發倉粟賑給八旗莊田。

translations.literal: Ninth month, guichou day, distributed granary grain to provision the Eight Banners estate lands.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the guichou day, granary grain was issued to relieve the Eight Banners estate lands.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，以查克旦為領侍衛內大臣。

translations.literal: On yimao day, appointed Chakdan Grand Guardian of the Imperial Bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: On the yimao day Chakdan was appointed Grand Guardian of the Imperial Bodyguard.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬辰，冬至，祀天於圜丘。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, renchen day, winter solstice — sacrificed to Heaven at the Circular Mound Altar.
translations.idiomatic: On the renchen day of the eleventh month, the winter solstice, the emperor sacrificed to Heaven at the Circular Mound Altar.

sentences.zh: 丁未，以魏裔介為大學士，杜立德為吏部尚書，王弘祚為戶部尚書，龔鼎孳為刑部尚書。

translations.literal: On dingwei day: appointed Wei Yijie Grand Secretary; Du Lede Minister of Personnel; Wang Hongzuo Minister of Revenue; Gong Dingzi Minister of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingwei day Wei Yijie was made Grand Secretary, Du Lede Minister of Personnel, Wang Hongzuo Minister of Revenue, and Gong Dingzi Minister of Punishments.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊午朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, first day wuwu, solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the twelfth month, wuwu, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，祫祭太廟。

translations.literal: On bingxu day, brought-in seasonal sacrifice at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingxu day the seasonal brought-in sacrifice was performed at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 是月，彗星見張宿、井宿、胃宿、奎宿，金星見，給事中楊雍建請修省。

translations.literal: That month, a comet appeared in the mansions Zhang, Jing, Wei, and Kui; Venus appeared; Supervising Secretary Yang Yongjian memorialized requesting repentance and self-examination.
translations.idiomatic: That month a comet was seen in the Zhang, Jing, Wei, and Kui mansions and Venus appeared; Supervising Secretary Yang Yongjian memorialized asking the court to repent and reform.

sentences.zh: 是歲，免直隸、江南、江西、山東、陝西、浙江、福建、湖廣、貴州等省一百二十一州縣被災額賦有差。

translations.literal: That year, differential exemption of assessed taxes for disaster-affected districts in one hundred twenty-one prefectures and counties of Zhili, Jiangnan, Jiangxi, Shandong, Shaanxi, Zhejiang, Fujian, Huguang, Guizhou, and other provinces.
translations.idiomatic: That year assessed taxes were remitted in varying degrees for one hundred twenty-one disaster-stricken prefectures and counties in Zhili, Jiangnan, Jiangxi, Shandong, Shaanxi, Zhejiang, Fujian, Huguang, Guizhou, and other provinces.

sentences.zh: 朝鮮入貢。

translations.literal: Korea sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Korea sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 四年乙巳春正月壬辰，以郝惟訥為左都御史。

translations.literal: Year 4, yisi, spring, first month, renchen day — appointed Hao Weine Censor-in-Chief of the Left.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi year four, on the renchen day of the first month of spring, Hao Weine was appointed Censor-in-Chief of the Left.

sentences.zh: 己亥，停榷關溢額獎敘。

translations.literal: On jihai day, suspended commendation rewards for customs posts exceeding quota receipts.
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai day rewards for customs posts that exceeded their quotas were suspended.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，封承澤親王碩色子博翁果諾為惠郡王。

translations.literal: On xinchou day, enfeoffed Prince Chenze Suose's son Bo'onggo as Prince of Hui commandery.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinchou day Prince Chenze Suose's son Bo'onggo was enfeoffed as Prince of Hui.

sentences.zh: 致仕大學士洪承疇卒，予祭葬，諡文襄。

translations.literal: Retired Grand Secretary Hong Chengchou died; granted sacrificial rites and burial honors; posthumous title Wenxiang.
translations.idiomatic: Retired Grand Secretary Hong Chengchou died and was granted state funeral rites with the posthumous title Wenxiang.

sentences.zh: 二月乙丑，太皇太后聖壽，免朝賀。

translations.literal: Second month, yichou day, the Grand Empress Dowager's sacred birthday — court congratulations exempted.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day of the second month, the Grand Empress Dowager's birthday, the court congratulatory audience was waived.

sentences.zh: 己巳，吳三桂疏報剿平水西烏撒土司，擒其酋安坤、安重聖。

translations.literal: On jisi day, Wu Sangui memorialized the suppression of the Shuixi and Wusa tribal chiefs, capturing chieftains An Kun and An Zhongsheng.
translations.idiomatic: On the jisi day Wu Sangui reported the pacification of the Shuixi and Wusa chieftains and the capture of An Kun and An Zhongsheng.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，以星變詔臣工上言闕失。

translations.literal: On bingxu day, owing to celestial anomalies, edict ordering officials to memorialize on deficiencies.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingxu day, because of celestial omens, an edict ordered officials to report governmental failings.

sentences.zh: 御史董文驥疏言大臣更易先皇帝制度，非是，宜一切復舊。

translations.literal: Censor Dong Wenji memorialized that the regent ministers had altered the late emperor's institutions — it was wrong and all should be restored.
translations.idiomatic: Censor Dong Wenji memorialized that the regents had changed the late emperor's institutions, which was improper, and that everything should be restored.

sentences.zh: 三月戊子，京師地震有聲。

translations.literal: Third month, wuzi day, the capital region earthquake with audible sound.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day of the third month the capital was shaken by an earthquake that could be heard.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，金星晝見。

translations.literal: On xinmao day, Venus appeared in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinmao day Venus was visible in daylight.

sentences.zh: 以星變地震肆赦，免逋賦。

translations.literal: Owing to celestial anomalies and the earthquake, a general amnesty was proclaimed and tax arrears remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Because of the omens and the earthquake a general amnesty was proclaimed and tax arrears were remitted.

sentences.zh: 山西旱，有司不以聞，下吏部議罪，免其積逋及本年額賦。

translations.literal: Shanxi suffered drought; local officials failed to report — referred to the Ministry of Personnel for sentencing; their accumulated arrears and the current year's assessed levies were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Shanxi suffered drought and the local officials failed to report it; the case was sent to the Ministry of Personnel for punishment, and accumulated arrears and that year's assessed levies were remitted.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，詔禁州縣預徵隔年稅糧。

translations.literal: On renchen day, edict forbidding prefectures and counties from collecting in advance the tax grain of the following year.
translations.idiomatic: On the renchen day an edict forbade prefectures and counties to collect the next year's tax grain in advance.

sentences.zh: 丙申，詔曰：「郡縣災荒，有司奏請蠲賦，而小民先期已完，是澤不下逮也。

translations.literal: On bingshen day, edict said: "When prefectures and counties suffer calamity and famine, officials memorialize to remit levies, yet commoners have already paid in advance — the benefit does not reach those below."
translations.idiomatic: On the bingshen day an edict said: "When prefectures and counties suffer disaster and famine, officials request tax relief, but the common people have already paid in full — so the grace never reaches them."

sentences.zh: 自今被災者，預緩徵額賦十之三。

translations.literal: "From now on, where disaster strikes, thirty percent of assessed levies shall be collected on a deferred schedule in advance."
translations.idiomatic: "Henceforth, in stricken areas thirty percent of the assessed levy shall be collected on a deferred schedule before the due date."

sentences.zh: 」甲辰，萬壽節，免朝賀。

translations.literal: " On jiachen day, the Longevity festival — court congratulations were exempted.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiachen day, the emperor's birthday, the congratulatory audience was waived.

sentences.zh: 丙午，修歷代帝王廟。

translations.literal: On bingwu day, repair the Temple of Past Dynasties' Emperors.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingwu day the Temple of Emperors of Past Dynasties was repaired.

sentences.zh: 太常寺少卿錢綎請簡老成耆德博通經史者數人，出入侍從，以備顧問。

translations.literal: Vice Minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices Qian Shou requested selection of several aged, virtuous men thoroughly versed in the classics and histories to attend in and out as companions for consultation.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Minister Qian Shou of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices asked that several elderly, learned men versed in the classics and histories be chosen to attend the emperor and serve as advisers.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丙寅，詔凡災傷免賦者並免丁徭。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, bingyin day, edict: wherever disaster remission of levies was granted, corvée and miscellaneous exactions were also exempted.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the bingyin day, an edict declared that wherever disaster taxes were remitted, corvée and miscellaneous levies were remitted as well.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，詔卿貳督撫員缺，仍廷推。

translations.literal: On wuchen day, edict: vacancies for ministers, vice-ministers, governors-general, and governors were again to be filled by court recommendation.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuchen day an edict restored court nomination for vacancies among ministers, vice-ministers, governors-general, and governors.

sentences.zh: 五月丁未，置直隸總督，兼轄山東、河南。

translations.literal: Fifth month, dingwei day, established the Zhili governor-general, also overseeing Shandong and Henan.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingwei day of the fifth month the Zhili governor-general was established, with jurisdiction over Shandong and Henan as well.

sentences.zh: 裁貴州總督歸雲南，廣西總督歸廣東，江西總督歸江南，山西總督歸陝西，鳳陽、寧夏、南贛巡撫悉裁之。

translations.literal: The Guizhou governor-general was abolished and returned to Yunnan; Guangxi to Guangdong; Jiangxi to Jiangnan; Shanxi to Shaanxi; the Fengyang, Ningxia, and Nangan governors were all abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The Guizhou governor-general was abolished and placed under Yunnan; Guangxi under Guangdong; Jiangxi under Jiangnan; Shanxi under Shaanxi; and the Fengyang, Ningxia, and Nangan governorships were all abolished.

sentences.zh: 六月乙丑，詔父子兄弟同役，給復一年。

translations.literal: Sixth month, yichou day, edict: where father and sons or brothers served corvée together, one year's restoration was granted.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day of the sixth month an edict granted one year's exemption to households in which father and sons or brothers served corvée together.

sentences.zh: 秋七月己酉，吏部以山西徵糧如額，請議敘。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, jiyou day, the Ministry of Personnel, because Shanxi had collected grain levies to quota, requested consideration for commendation.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the jiyou day, the Ministry of Personnel asked that Shanxi officials be commended because grain levies there had been collected in full.

sentences.zh: 詔曰：「曩以太原諸處旱災飢饉，督撫不以聞，議罪。

translations.literal: Edict said: "Recently, because of drought and famine in Taiyuan and other places, the governor-general and governor failed to report — they were sentenced.
translations.idiomatic: An edict said: "Not long ago, when Taiyuan and other districts suffered drought and famine, the governor-general and governor failed to report it and were sentenced."

sentences.zh: 會赦得原。

translations.literal: They were pardoned by the general amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: They were cleared by the general amnesty.

sentences.zh: 豈可仍以催科報最。

translations.literal: How can they still be reported as outstanding in tax collection for merit evaluation?
translations.idiomatic: How can they still be rated foremost for tax collection?

sentences.zh: 惟未被災之地方官，仍予紀錄。

translations.literal: Only officials in places not stricken by disaster shall still receive recorded commendation."
translations.idiomatic: Only officials in districts that were not stricken may still receive commendation."

translations.literal: "" (closing punctuation in source.)
translations.idiomatic: The passage continues.

sentences.zh: 八月庚午，詔贓官遇赦免罪者，不許復職。

translations.literal: Eighth month, gengwu day, edict: corrupt officials whose crimes were pardoned by amnesty were not permitted to resume office.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengwu day of the eighth month an edict declared that corrupt officials pardoned by amnesty might not return to office.

sentences.zh: 九月辛卯，冊赫舍里氏為皇后，輔臣索尼之孫女也。

translations.literal: Ninth month, xinmao day, invested the Lady Hesheri as empress — granddaughter of regent Sonin.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the xinmao day, the Lady Hesheri was invested as empress; she was the granddaughter of regent Sonin.

sentences.zh: 上太皇太后、皇太后尊號，加恩中外。

translations.literal: Bestowed honorific titles upon the Grand Empress Dowager and Empress Dowager; extended favor within and without the court.
translations.idiomatic: Honorific titles were bestowed on the Grand Empress Dowager and the Empress Dowager, and favors were extended throughout the court and realm.

sentences.zh: 冬十月癸亥，上幸南苑校射行圍。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, guihai day, the emperor visited the Southern Park for archery practice and the hunting encirclement.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the guihai day, the emperor went to the Southern Park for archery and the hunting encirclement.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，還宮。

translations.literal: On jiaxu day, returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiaxu day he returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 十一月丁酉，祀天於圜丘。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, dingyou day, sacrificed to Heaven at the Circular Mound Altar.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day of the eleventh month he sacrificed to Heaven at the Circular Mound Altar.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚辰，祫祭太廟。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, gengchen day, brought-in seasonal sacrifice at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengchen day of the twelfth month the seasonal brought-in sacrifice was performed at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 是歲，免直隸、江南、江西、山東、河南、浙江、廣東、貴州等省一百二十一州縣衛災賦有差。

translations.literal: That year, differential disaster tax remission for one hundred twenty-one prefectures, counties, and garrisons in Zhili, Jiangnan, Jiangxi, Shandong, Henan, Zhejiang, Guangdong, Guizhou, and other provinces.
translations.idiomatic: That year disaster taxes were remitted in varying degrees for one hundred twenty-one prefectures, counties, and garrisons in Zhili, Jiangnan, Jiangxi, Shandong, Henan, Zhejiang, Guangdong, Guizhou, and other provinces.

sentences.zh: 朝鮮、琉球、暹羅入貢。

translations.literal: Korea, Ryukyu, and Siam sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Korea, Ryukyu, and Siam sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 索倫、飛牙喀人來歸。

translations.literal: Solon and Fiyaka people came to submit.
translations.idiomatic: Solon and Fiyaka peoples came to submit.

sentences.zh: 五年丙午春正月庚寅，以廣東旱，發倉穀七萬石賑之。

translations.literal: Year 5, bingwu, spring, first month, gengyin day — owing to drought in Guangdong, seventy thousand shi of granary grain was distributed for relief.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi year five, on the gengyin day of the first month of spring, seventy thousand shi of granary grain were issued to relieve drought in Guangdong.

sentences.zh: 以承澤親王碩色子恩克布嗣爵。

translations.literal: Prince Chenze Suose's son Enkebu succeeded to the title.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Chenze Suose's son Enkebu succeeded to the princely title.

sentences.zh: 二月壬子朔，置平遠、大定、黔西三府。

translations.literal: Second month, first day renzi — established the three prefectures of Pingyuan, Dading, and Qianxi.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the second month, renzi, the three prefectures of Pingyuan, Dading, and Qianxi were established.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，以十二月中氣不應，詔求明曆法者。

translations.literal: On dingsi day, because the mid-month qi in the twelfth month did not correspond, edict sought those versed in the Ming calendar.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingsi day, because the mid-month qi of the twelfth month did not match, an edict called for men skilled in the Ming calendar.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，詔自今漢軍官丁憂，准解任持三年喪。

translations.literal: On yichou day, edict: from now on when Han Army officials entered mourning for a parent, they were permitted to leave office and observe the three-year mourning period.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day an edict declared that henceforth Han Army officials who entered mourning for a parent might leave office and observe the three-year mourning period.

sentences.zh: 三月，以胡拜為直隸總督。

translations.literal: Third month, appointed Hubai governor-general of Zhili.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month Hubai was appointed governor-general of Zhili.

sentences.zh: 五月丙午，以孫延齡為廣西將軍，接統定南部軍駐桂林。

translations.literal: Fifth month, bingwu day, appointed Sun Yanling General of Guangxi to take over Dingnan's southern army, stationed at Guilin.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingwu day of the fifth month Sun Yanling was made General of Guangxi to take command of the Dingnan southern forces, stationed at Guilin.

sentences.zh: 六月庚戌朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Sixth month, first day gengxu, solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the sixth month, gengxu, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，傅維麟病免，以郝惟訥為工部尚書。

translations.literal: On guiyou day, Fu Weilin removed from office due to illness; appointed Hao Weine Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiyou day Fu Weilin was dismissed because of illness and Hao Weine was appointed Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 辛未，詔崇文門凡貨物出京者弛其稅。

translations.literal: On xinwei day, edict: for all goods passing out of Beijing through Chongwen Gate, the tax was relaxed.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinwei day an edict relaxed the tax on all goods leaving the capital through Chongwen Gate.

sentences.zh: 秋七月庚辰朔，以朱之弼為左都御史。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, first day gengchen, appointed Zhu Zhibi Censor-in-Chief of the Left.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the seventh month of autumn, gengchen, Zhu Zhibi was appointed Censor-in-Chief of the Left.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，琉球來貢，並補進漂失前貢。

translations.literal: On xinsi day, Ryukyu sent tribute and additionally presented tribute lost in shipwreck from prior missions.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinsi day Ryukyu sent tribute and also made good tribute lost in earlier shipwrecks.

sentences.zh: 上嘉其恭順，命還之，自今非其國產勿以貢。

translations.literal: The emperor praised their respectful obedience, ordered the goods returned, and from now on only products native to their country were to be offered as tribute.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor commended their respectful obedience, ordered the goods returned, and ruled that henceforth only products of their own country might be offered as tribute.

sentences.zh: 八月己酉，給事中張維赤疏請親政。

translations.literal: Eighth month, jiyou day, Supervising Secretary Zhang Weichi memorialized requesting that the emperor personally assume governance.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the jiyou day, Supervising Secretary Zhang Weichi memorialized asking the emperor to assume personal rule.

sentences.zh: 九月丁亥，上行圍南苑。

translations.literal: Ninth month, dinghai day, the emperor conducted the hunting encirclement in the Southern Park.
translations.idiomatic: On the dinghai day of the ninth month the emperor held the hunting encirclement in the Southern Park.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，還宮。

translations.literal: On guimao day, returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day he returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 禮部尚書沙澄免。

translations.literal: Minister of Rites Sha Cheng removed from office.
translations.idiomatic: Minister of Rites Sha Cheng was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 以梁清標為禮部尚書，龔鼎孳為兵部尚書，郝惟訥為刑部尚書，朱之弼為工部尚書。

translations.literal: Appointed Liang Qingbiao Minister of Rites; Gong Dingzi Minister of War; Hao Weine Minister of Punishments; Zhu Zhibi Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: Liang Qingbiao was appointed Minister of Rites, Gong Dingzi Minister of War, Hao Weine Minister of Punishments, and Zhu Zhibi Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，詔起范承謨為秘書院學士。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, edict reinstating Fan Chengmo as Academician of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter an edict reinstated Fan Chengmo as Academician of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙申，輔臣鰲拜以改撥圈地，誣奏大學士管戶部尚書蘇納海、直隸總督朱昌祚、巡撫王登聯等罪，逮下獄。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, bingshen day, regent Oboi, on account of the reallocation of banner land, falsely impeached Grand Secretary and acting Minister of Revenue Sunahe, Zhili Governor-General Zhu Changzuo, Governor Wang Denglian, and others — all were arrested and imprisoned.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingshen day of the eleventh month, regent Oboi, over the reallocation of banner estates, falsely charged Grand Secretary and acting Minister of Revenue Sunahe, Zhili Governor-General Zhu Changzuo, Governor Wang Denglian, and others; they were arrested and imprisoned.

sentences.zh: 四大臣之輔政也，皆以勛舊。

translations.literal: When the four great ministers assisted in government, all were meritorious veterans.
translations.idiomatic: The four regents who assisted the government were all men of merit and long service.

sentences.zh: 索尼年老，遏必隆闇弱，蘇克薩哈望淺，心非鰲拜所為而不能爭。

translations.literal: Sonin was aged; Ebilun was weak and indecisive; Suksaha lacked foresight — though they disapproved of Oboi's actions they could not contend.
translations.idiomatic: Sonin was old, Ebilun timid and weak, and Suksaha shortsighted; though they disapproved of Oboi's conduct they could not oppose him.

sentences.zh: 鰲拜橫暴，又宿將多戰功，敘名在末，而遇事專橫，屢興大獄，雖同列亦側目焉。

translations.literal: Oboi was violent and overbearing; moreover, as a veteran general with many battle honors, though listed last in seniority, on affairs he acted despotically, repeatedly launching major prosecutions — even his colleagues looked askance.
translations.idiomatic: Oboi was brutal and domineering; a veteran with many battle honors, though lowest in seniority among the regents, he acted arbitrarily, repeatedly opened major cases, and even his colleagues looked on in fear.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙寅，鰲拜矯旨殺蘇納海、朱昌祚、王登聯。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, bingyin day, Oboi forged an imperial order and executed Sunahe, Zhu Changzuo, and Wang Denglian.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingyin day of the twelfth month Oboi forged an imperial edict and put Sunahe, Zhu Changzuo, and Wang Denglian to death.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，祫祭太廟。

translations.literal: On jiaxu day, brought-in seasonal sacrifice at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiaxu day the seasonal brought-in sacrifice was performed at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 是歲，免直隸、江南、江西、河南、陝西、浙江、湖廣等省八十六州縣災賦有差。

translations.literal: That year, differential disaster tax remission for eighty-six prefectures and counties in Zhili, Jiangnan, Jiangxi, Henan, Shaanxi, Zhejiang, Huguang, and other provinces.
translations.idiomatic: That year disaster taxes were remitted in varying degrees for eighty-six prefectures and counties in Zhili, Jiangnan, Jiangxi, Henan, Shaanxi, Zhejiang, Huguang, and other provinces.

sentences.zh: 朝鮮、琉球入貢。

translations.literal: Korea and Ryukyu sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Korea and Ryukyu sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 六年丁未春正月己丑，封世祖第二子福全為裕親王。

translations.literal: Year 6, dingwei, spring, first month, jichou day — enfeoffed the Shizu Emperor's second son Fuyuan as Prince Yu.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi year six, on the jichou day of the first month of spring, the Shunzhi Emperor's second son Fuyuan was enfeoffed as Prince Yu.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，上幸南苑行圍。

translations.literal: On dingyou day, the emperor visited the Southern Park for the hunting encirclement.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day the emperor went to the Southern Park for the hunting encirclement.

sentences.zh: 以明安達禮為禮部尚書。

translations.literal: Appointed Ming'andali Minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: Ming'andali was appointed Minister of Rites.

sentences.zh: 二月癸亥，晉封故親王尼堪子貝勒蘭布為郡王。

translations.literal: Second month, guihai day — advanced the late Prince Nikan's son, Beile Lanba, to Prince of a commandery.
translations.idiomatic: On the guihai day of the second month the late Prince Nikan's son, Beile Lanba, was promoted to commandery prince.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，以宗室公班布爾善為大學士。

translations.literal: On dingmao day, appointed imperial clansman Duke Banbuerchan as Grand Secretary.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingmao day the imperial clansman Duke Banbuerchan was appointed Grand Secretary.

sentences.zh: 起圖海復為大學士。

translations.literal: Reinstated Tulai as Grand Secretary.
translations.idiomatic: Tulai was reinstated as Grand Secretary.

sentences.zh: 錫故總督李率泰一等男爵。

translations.literal: Granted the late Governor-General Li Shuaitai the rank of Baron of the First Class.
translations.idiomatic: The late Governor-General Li Shuaitai was posthumously granted the rank of first-class baron.

sentences.zh: 三月己亥，賜繆彤等一百五十人進士及第出身有差。

translations.literal: Third month, jihai day — conferred differentiated jinshi graduate status and appointments upon Miu Tong and one hundred fifty others.
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai day of the third month Miu Tong and one hundred fifty others were granted the jinshi degree and appointed to office with differentiated ranks.

sentences.zh: 夏四月甲戌，加索尼一等公。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, jiaxu day — Sonin promoted to Duke of the First Class.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the jiaxu day, Sonin was raised to duke of the first class.

sentences.zh: 甲子，江南民人沈天甫撰逆詩誣告人，誅之。

translations.literal: On jiazi day — Jiangnan commoner Shen Tianfu composed seditious verse and falsely accused others; he was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiazi day the Jiangnan commoner Shen Tianfu, who had written seditious poetry and falsely accused others, was executed.

sentences.zh: 被誣者皆不論。

translations.literal: Those falsely accused were not prosecuted.
translations.idiomatic: Those he had falsely accused were not punished.

sentences.zh: 御史田六善言奸民告訐，於南人不曰「通海」，則曰「逆書」，北人不曰「於七黨」，則曰「逃人」，請鞫誣反坐。

translations.literal: Censor Tian Liushan stated that malicious commoners brought accusations — for southerners, if not charging "communicating with the sea," they charged "seditious writings"; for northerners, if not charging "the Yuqi faction," they charged "fugitive bondservants" — he requested investigation of false accusations with reciprocal punishment.
translations.idiomatic: Censor Tian Liushan said that malicious informers, unable to charge southerners with "communicating with the sea" or northerners with "the Yuqi faction," would instead accuse them of "seditious writings" or "fugitive bondservants"; he asked that false accusers be tried and punished in turn.

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: The request was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The request was approved.

sentences.zh: 五月辛酉，吳三桂疏辭總理雲南、貴州兩省事。

translations.literal: Fifth month, xinyou day — Wu Sangui memorialized resigning overall charge of Yunnan and Guizhou provincial affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinyou day of the fifth month Wu Sangui memorialized asking to be relieved of overall responsibility for Yunnan and Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: The request was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved the request.

sentences.zh: 六月己亥，禁採辦楠木官役生事累民。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day jihai: forbade officials sent to procure nanmu from harassing the people and causing trouble.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on jihai, the court forbade procurement agents collecting nanmu from oppressing the people.

sentences.zh: 秋七月己酉，上親政，御太和殿受賀，加恩中外，罪非殊死，咸赦除之。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day jiyou: the Emperor took personal rule; at the Hall of Supreme Harmony he received congratulations; grace was extended within and without; crimes short of capital punishment were all pardoned and remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, the seventh month, on jiyou, the Emperor assumed personal rule. At the Hall of Supreme Harmony he received congratulations, extended favors throughout the realm, and pardoned all crimes short of death.

sentences.zh: 是日，始御乾清門聽政。

translations.literal: That day he first heard affairs at the Gate of Heavenly Purity.
translations.idiomatic: That same day he began to hold court and hear affairs at the Gate of Heavenly Purity.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，命武職官一體引見。

translations.literal: Day jiayin: ordered that military officials likewise be presented at audience.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, he ordered that military officials also be presented at audience.

sentences.zh: 己未，輔臣鰲拜擅殺輔臣蘇克薩哈及其子姓。

translations.literal: Day jiwei: the assisting minister Oboi arbitrarily executed the assisting minister Suksaha and his sons and clansmen.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, the regent Oboi put the regent Suksaha and his sons and kin to death on his own authority.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，賜輔臣遏必隆、鰲拜加一等公。

translations.literal: Day guihai: the assisting ministers Ebilun and Oboi were granted the rank of first-class duke.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, the regents Ebilun and Oboi were promoted to first-class duke.

sentences.zh: 九月丙午，命修世祖實錄。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day bingwu: ordered the compilation of the Veritable Records of Emperor Shizu.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on bingwu, he ordered the compilation of the Veritable Records of Emperor Shizu.

sentences.zh: 冬十月己卯，盛京地震有聲。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day jimao: Mukden was shaken by an earthquake with audible sound.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, the tenth month, on jimao, Mukden was struck by an earthquake that could be heard.

sentences.zh: 十一月丁未，冬至，祀天於圜丘。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day dingwei: winter solstice; Heaven was sacrificed to at the Circular Mound.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on dingwei, the winter solstice, the Emperor sacrificed to Heaven at the Circular Mound.

sentences.zh: 奉世祖章皇帝配饗。

translations.literal: Emperor Zhang of Shizu was offered in joint sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Zhang of Shizu was joined in the offering.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，加上太皇太后、皇太后徽號。

translations.literal: Day dingsi: honorific titles were added for the Grand Empress Dowager and the Empress Dowager.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, honorific titles were conferred upon the Grand Empress Dowager and the Empress Dowager.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙戌，以塞白理為廣東水師提督。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day bingxu: Sebeli was appointed naval commander of Guangdong.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on bingxu, Sebeli was appointed naval commander of Guangdong.

sentences.zh: 戊子，以馬爾賽為戶部增設尚書。

translations.literal: Day wuzi: Ma'ersai was appointed additional Minister of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, Ma'ersai was appointed an additional Minister of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，祫祭太廟。

translations.literal: Day wuxu: joint sacrifice at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, a joint seasonal sacrifice was held at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 是歲，免直隸、江南、江西、山東、山西、陝西、甘肅、浙江、福建、湖廣等省一百六十州縣災賦有差。

translations.literal: That year, disaster taxes were remitted in varying measure for one hundred sixty prefectures and counties in Zhili, Jiangnan, Jiangxi, Shandong, Shanxi, Shaanxi, Gansu, Zhejiang, Fujian, Huguang, and other provinces.
translations.idiomatic: That year disaster taxes were reduced or remitted, each according to local need, in one hundred sixty prefectures and counties across Zhili, Jiangnan, Jiangxi, Shandong, Shanxi, Shaanxi, Gansu, Zhejiang, Fujian, Huguang, and other provinces.

sentences.zh: 朝鮮、荷蘭入貢。

translations.literal: Korea and the Netherlands presented tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Korea and the Netherlands sent tribute missions.

sentences.zh: 七年戊申春正月戊申，以莫洛為山西陝西總督，劉兆麒為四川總督。

translations.literal: Seventh year, spring, first month, day wushen: Molo was appointed governor-general of Shanxi and Shaanxi; Liu Zhaoqi was appointed governor-general of Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year, spring, the first month, on wushen, Molo was made governor-general of Shanxi and Shaanxi, and Liu Zhaoqi governor-general of Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 戊午，加鰲拜、遏必隆太師。

translations.literal: Day wuwu: Oboi and Ebilun were made Grand Preceptors.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, Oboi and Ebilun were appointed Grand Preceptors.

sentences.zh: 二月辛卯，上幸南苑。

translations.literal: Second month, day xinmao: the Emperor visited the Southern Park.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on xinmao, the Emperor went to the Southern Park.

sentences.zh: 三月丁未，詔部院官才能卓越，升轉毋拘常調。

translations.literal: Third month, day dingwei: an edict ordered that when officials of the ministries and courts possessed outstanding ability, promotion and transfer should not be bound by routine regulations.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on dingwei, an edict declared that officials of outstanding talent in the ministries and courts were not to be held to routine rules of promotion.

sentences.zh: 夏四月庚辰，浙江嘉善民郁之章有罪遣戍，其子褒、廣叩閽請代。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day gengchen: Yu Zhizhang of Jiashan in Zhejiang, guilty and sentenced to banishment, had his sons Bao and Guang knock at the palace gate asking to take his place.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, the fourth month, on gengchen, Yu Zhizhang of Jiashan in Zhejiang, condemned to exile, had his sons Bao and Guang come to the palace gate to beg that they serve his sentence in his stead.

sentences.zh: 上並宥之。

translations.literal: The Emperor pardoned them all.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor pardoned father and sons alike.

sentences.zh: 五月壬子，以星變地震，下詔修省，諭戒臣工。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day renzi: because of unusual stars and earthquakes, an edict ordered self-examination and admonished the officials.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on renzi, in view of celestial omens and earthquakes, the Emperor issued an edict calling for moral self-scrutiny and warning his ministers.

sentences.zh: 六月癸酉，金星晝見。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day guiyou: Venus was seen in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on guiyou, Venus appeared in daylight.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，平南王尚可喜遣子之信入侍。

translations.literal: Day dinghai: Prince of Pacifying the South Shang Kexi sent his son Zhixin to attend at court.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, Shang Kexi, Prince of Pacifying the South, sent his son Zhixin to serve at court.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊午，前漕運總督吳維華請徵市鎮間架錢，洲田招民出錢佃種。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day wuwu: the former grain transport governor-general Wu Weihua memorialized to levy interstitial taxes on market towns and to recruit commoners to pay money to cultivate sandbank fields.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, the seventh month, on wuwu, the former grain transport governor-general Wu Weihua proposed levying building-space taxes on market towns and charging commoners for the right to farm sandbank fields.

sentences.zh: 上惡其言利，下刑部議罪。

translations.literal: The Emperor detested his profit-seeking and referred the matter to the Ministry of Justice to determine guilt.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor, loathing such schemes for profit, sent the case to the Ministry of Justice for punishment.

sentences.zh: 庚申，以誇岱為滿洲都統。

translations.literal: Day gengshen: Kuadai was appointed Manchu commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, Kuadai was appointed Manchu commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 八月壬申，戶部尚書王弘祚坐失察書吏偽印盜帑免。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day renshen: Minister of Revenue Wang Hongzuo was dismissed for failure to detect clerks' use of forged seals to steal from the treasury.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on renshen, Wang Hongzuo, Minister of Revenue, was dismissed for not detecting clerks who forged seals and stole from the treasury.

sentences.zh: 九月庚子，以吳瑪護為奉天將軍，額楚為江寧將軍，瓦爾喀為西安將軍。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day gengzi: Wu Mahu was appointed general of Fengtian; Etuh was appointed general of Jiangning; Warka was appointed general of Xi'an.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on gengzi, Wu Mahu was made general of Fengtian, Etuh general of Jiangning, and Warka general of Xi'an.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，上將巡邊，侍讀學士熊賜履、給事中趙之符疏諫。

translations.literal: Day renyin: the Emperor was about to tour the frontier; Reader-in-waiting Xiong Cili and supervising secretary Zhao Zhifu memorialized in remonstrance.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, as the Emperor prepared to tour the frontier, Reader-in-waiting Xiong Cili and supervising secretary Zhao Zhifu submitted memorials of remonstrance.

sentences.zh: 上為止行，仍令遇事直陳。

translations.literal: The Emperor therefore halted the journey, yet still ordered that on all matters they speak frankly.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor thereupon abandoned the tour, but still commanded that they speak plainly on every issue.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，定八旗武職人員居喪百日，釋縞任事，仍持服三年。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month: it was fixed that Eight Banners military officials observe mourning for one hundred days, lay aside white mourning and resume duty, yet still wear mourning garments for three years.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, the tenth month, it was decreed that Eight Banners military officers observe a hundred days of mourning, then leave off white dress and return to duty while continuing full mourning for three years.

sentences.zh: 庚午，上幸南苑。

translations.literal: Day gengwu: the Emperor visited the Southern Park.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, the Emperor visited the Southern Park.

sentences.zh: 十一月癸丑，冬至，祀天於圜丘。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day guichou: winter solstice; Heaven was sacrificed to at the Circular Mound.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on guichou, the winter solstice, the Emperor sacrificed to Heaven at the Circular Mound.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸酉，以麻勒吉為江南總督，甘文焜為雲南貴州總督，范承謨為浙江巡撫。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day guiyou: Melehi was appointed governor-general of Jiangnan; Gan Wenkun was appointed governor-general of Yunnan and Guizhou; Fan Chengmo was appointed governor of Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on guiyou, Melehi was made governor-general of Jiangnan, Gan Wenkun governor-general of Yunnan and Guizhou, and Fan Chengmo governor of Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，祫祭太廟。

translations.literal: Day guisi: joint sacrifice at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, a joint seasonal sacrifice was held at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 是歲，免奉天、直隸、江南、山東、河南、浙江、陝西、甘肅等省二百十六州縣災賦有差。

translations.literal: That year, disaster taxes were remitted in varying measure for two hundred sixteen prefectures and counties in Fengtian, Zhili, Jiangnan, Shandong, Henan, Zhejiang, Shaanxi, Gansu, and other provinces.
translations.idiomatic: That year disaster taxes were reduced or remitted in two hundred sixteen prefectures and counties across Fengtian, Zhili, Jiangnan, Shandong, Henan, Zhejiang, Shaanxi, Gansu, and other provinces.

sentences.zh: 朝鮮、安南、暹羅入貢。

translations.literal: Korea, Annam, and Siam presented tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Korea, Annam, and Siam sent tribute missions.

sentences.zh: 八年己酉春正月戊申，修乾清宮，上移御武英殿。

translations.literal: Eighth year, spring, first month, day wushen: the Palace of Heavenly Purity was repaired; the Emperor moved his residence to the Hall of Military Glory.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year, spring, the first month, on wushen, as the Palace of Heavenly Purity was being repaired, the Emperor took up residence in the Hall of Military Glory.

sentences.zh: 二月庚午，命行南懷仁推算曆法。

translations.literal: Second month, day gengwu: ordered Ferdinand Verbiest to calculate and revise the calendar.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on gengwu, he ordered Ferdinand Verbiest to calculate and revise the calendar.

sentences.zh: 庚午，上巡近畿。

translations.literal: Day gengwu: the Emperor toured the near suburbs.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, the Emperor toured the near suburbs.

sentences.zh: 三月辛丑，以直隸廢籓田地予民。

translations.literal: Third month, day xinchou: abolished princely estates in Zhili were granted to the people.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on xinchou, land from abolished princely estates in Zhili was given to commoners.

sentences.zh: 夏四月癸酉，衛周祚免，以杜立德為大學士。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day guiyou: Wei Zhouzuo was dismissed; Du Lede was appointed Grand Secretary.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, the fourth month, on guiyou, Wei Zhouzuo was dismissed and Du Lede made Grand Secretary.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，上幸太學，釋奠先師孔子，講周易、尚書。

translations.literal: Day dingchou: the Emperor visited the Imperial Academy, offered sacrifice to the sage Confucius, and lectured on the Book of Changes and the Book of Documents.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, the Emperor visited the Imperial Academy, sacrificed to Confucius, and lectured on the Book of Changes and the Book of Documents.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，給事中劉如漢請舉行經筵。

translations.literal: Day dingsi: supervising secretary Liu Ruhua requested that the classics mat be instituted.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, supervising secretary Liu Ruhua asked that regular lectures on the classics be established.

sentences.zh: 上嘉納之。

translations.literal: The Emperor praised and accepted it.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor welcomed the proposal and approved it.

sentences.zh: 五月乙未，以黃機為吏部尚書，郝惟訥為戶部尚書，龔鼎孳為禮部尚書，起王弘祚為兵部尚書。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day yiwei: Huang Ji was appointed Minister of Personnel; Hao Weine Minister of Revenue; Gong Dingzi Minister of Rites; Wang Hongzuo was reappointed Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on yiwei, Huang Ji was made Minister of Personnel, Hao Weine Minister of Revenue, Gong Dingzi Minister of Rites, and Wang Hongzuo was restored as Minister of War.

sentences.zh: 戊申，詔逮輔臣鰲拜交廷鞫。

translations.literal: Day wushen: an edict ordered the arrest of the assisting minister Oboi and his delivery to the court for trial.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, an edict ordered the regent Oboi seized and brought before the court for trial.

sentences.zh: 上久悉鰲拜專橫亂政，特慮其多力難制，乃選侍衛、拜唐阿年少有力者為撲擊之戲。

translations.literal: The Emperor had long known Oboi's arbitrary tyranny and disorder of government; he especially feared Oboi's great strength and difficulty of control; therefore he selected young, strong bodyguards and palace attendants for wrestling sport.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor had long known of Oboi's tyranny and misrule and feared his personal strength; he therefore trained young, powerful guards in the art of wrestling.

sentences.zh: 是日，鰲拜入見，即令侍衛等掊而縶之。

translations.literal: That day, when Oboi entered for audience, he immediately ordered the guards to seize and bind him.
translations.idiomatic: That day, as Oboi came in for audience, the Emperor had his guards seize and bind him on the spot.

sentences.zh: 於是有善撲營之制，以近臣領之。

translations.literal: Thereupon the institution of the skilled-wrestlers' guard was established, led by close ministers.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon the Skilled Wrestlers' Guard was established under close ministers.

sentences.zh: 庚申，王大臣議鰲拜獄上，列陳大罪三十，請族誅。

translations.literal: Day gengshen: the princes and ministers reported Oboi's case upward, listing thirty great crimes and requesting execution of his entire clan.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, the princes and ministers submitted Oboi's case, setting forth thirty grave crimes and asking that his whole clan be put to death.

sentences.zh: 詔曰：「鰲拜愚悖無知，誠合夷族。

translations.literal: The edict said: "Oboi is stupid and rebellious without understanding; he truly deserves extermination of the clan.
translations.idiomatic: The edict declared that Oboi was stupid and lawless and that by rights his clan should be destroyed.

sentences.zh: 特念效力年久，迭立戰功，貸其死，籍沒拘禁。

translations.literal: Yet considering his long service and repeated battlefield achievements, his life is spared; his property is confiscated and he is imprisoned under guard.
translations.idiomatic: Yet in view of his many years of service and repeated battlefield merit, his life is spared; his property is confiscated and he is held in confinement.

sentences.zh: 」其弟穆里瑪、塞本得，從子訥莫，其黨大學士班布爾善，尚書阿思哈、噶褚哈、濟世，侍郎泰璧圖，學士吳格塞皆誅死。

translations.literal: His younger brothers Murima and Seibende, his nephew Nemo, his faction-member Grand Secretary Banbursan, Ministers Ashan, Gatuha, and Jishi, Vice Minister Taibitu, and Academician Ggese were all executed.
translations.idiomatic: His younger brothers Murima and Seibende, his nephew Nemo, his partisan Grand Secretary Banbursan, Ministers Ashan, Gatuha, and Jishi, Vice Minister Taibitu, and Academician Ggese were all put to death.

sentences.zh: 餘坐譴黜。

translations.literal: The rest were punished or dismissed according to their offenses.
translations.idiomatic: The remainder were punished or dismissed according to their crimes.

sentences.zh: 其弟巴哈宿衛淳謹，卓布泰有軍功，免從坐。

translations.literal: His younger brother Baha, a palace guard of pure conduct, and Zhuobutai, who had military merit, were exempted from joint punishment.
translations.idiomatic: His younger brother Baha, an upright palace guard, and Zhuobutai, who had won merit in war, were spared implicated punishment.

sentences.zh: 嗣敬謹親王蘭布降鎮國公。

translations.literal: Prince Jingjin Lanbu was reduced to Duke Who Guards the State.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Jingjin Lanbu was reduced to Duke Who Guards the State.

sentences.zh: 褫遏必隆太師、一等公。

translations.literal: Ebilun was stripped of Grand Preceptor and first-class duke.
translations.idiomatic: Ebilun was deprived of his rank as Grand Preceptor and first-class duke.
