sentences.zh: 六月丁卯，詔曰：「朕夙夜求治，念切民依。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day dingmao: an edict said: "We seek good government morning and night, our thoughts fixed on the people's reliance.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on dingmao, an edict declared that the Emperor labors day and night for good government, ever mindful of the people's dependence upon the throne.

sentences.zh: 邇年水旱頻仍，盜賊未息，兼以貪吏朘削，民力益占，朕甚憫焉。

translations.literal: In recent years floods and droughts have come in succession, bandits have not yet been stilled, and moreover greedy officials have squeezed and cut; the people's strength is ever more burdened; We are deeply grieved.
translations.idiomatic: In recent years flood and drought have followed one upon another, banditry is not yet quelled, and grasping officials have further drained the people; their strength is ever more strained, and We are deeply grieved.

sentences.zh: 部院科道諸臣，其以民間疾苦，作何裨益，各抒所見以聞。

translations.literal: Ministers of the ministries and courts, the censorate, and the rest—you are to set forth what benefit may be made to the people's hardships and report your views.
translations.idiomatic: The edict called on ministers of the ministries and courts and the censorate to set forth plainly what might relieve the people's hardships.

sentences.zh: 」戊辰，敕改造觀象台儀器。

translations.literal: Day wuchen: ordered the renovation of the instruments of the Observatory.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, he ordered the astronomical instruments of the Observatory to be rebuilt.

sentences.zh: 壬申，詔復輔臣蘇克薩哈官及世職，其從子白爾圖立功邊徼，被枉尤酷，復其世職，均令其子承襲。

translations.literal: Day renshen: an edict restored the assisting minister Suksaha to office and to his hereditary post; his nephew Bai'ertu, who had won merit on the frontier yet was most cruelly wronged, had his hereditary post restored as well; both were to be inherited by their sons.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, an edict restored the regent Suksaha to office and hereditary rank; his nephew Bai'ertu, who had earned merit on the frontier yet suffered the cruelest injustice, was likewise restored, each line to pass to a son.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，詔滿兵有規占民間房地者，永行禁止，仍還諸民。

translations.literal: Day wuyin: an edict permanently forbade Manchu soldiers from seizing commoners' houses and land; such holdings were still to be returned to the people.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, an edict permanently forbade Manchu soldiers to seize commoners' houses and land and ordered such property returned.

sentences.zh: 以米思翰為戶部尚書。

translations.literal: Mi Sihan was appointed Minister of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: Mi Sihan was appointed Minister of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 戊子，詔宗人有罪，遽絕屬籍，心有不忍。

translations.literal: Day wuzi: an edict said: "When clansmen commit crime, to cut them off from the register at once—Our heart cannot bear it.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, an edict said that when a clansman offends, to strike him from the register at once is more than the Emperor can willingly do.

sentences.zh: 自順治十八年以來，宗人削籍者，宗人府詳察以聞。

translations.literal: From the eighteenth year of Shunzhi onward, those clansmen struck from the register—the Imperial Clan Court is to examine each case in detail and report.
translations.idiomatic: For all clansmen struck from the register since the eighteenth year of Shunzhi, the Imperial Clan Court was ordered to review each case and report.

sentences.zh: 秋七月壬辰朔，裁直隸山東河南總督。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, first day renchen: the governor-generalship of Zhili, Shandong, and Henan was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, the seventh month, on the first day renchen, the governor-generalship of Zhili, Shandong, and Henan was abolished.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，詔復大學士蘇納海、總督朱昌祚、巡撫王登聯原官，並予諡。

translations.literal: Day renyin: an edict restored Grand Secretary Sunahai, Governor-General Zhu Changzuo, and Governor Wang Denglian to their former offices and granted them posthumous titles.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, an edict restored Grand Secretary Sunahai, Governor-General Zhu Changzuo, and Governor Wang Denglian to their former offices and granted posthumous titles.

sentences.zh: 八月甲申，以索額圖為大學士，明珠為左都御史。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day jiashen: Suo'etu was appointed Grand Secretary; Mingzhu was appointed Censor-in-chief of the Left.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on jiashen, Suo'etu was made Grand Secretary and Mingzhu Censor-in-chief of the Left.

sentences.zh: 九月甲午，京師地震有聲。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day jiawu: the capital was shaken by an earthquake with audible sound.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on jiawu, the capital was struck by an earthquake that could be heard.

sentences.zh: 丁未，以勒貝為滿洲都統，塞白理為浙江提督，畢力克圖為蒙古都統。

translations.literal: Day dingwei: Lebei was appointed Manchu commander-in-chief; Sebeli naval commander of Zhejiang; Biliketu Mongol commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, Lebei was made Manchu commander-in-chief, Sebeli naval commander of Zhejiang, and Biliketu Mongol commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 冬十月甲子，上幸南苑，詔行在勿得借用民物。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day jiazi: the Emperor visited the Southern Park; an edict ordered that on tour the court must not borrow goods from the people.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, the tenth month, on jiazi, the Emperor visited the Southern Park and decreed that the traveling court must not requisition the people's goods.

sentences.zh: 盧溝橋成，上為文勒之石。

translations.literal: The Lugou Bridge was completed; the Emperor composed an inscription and had it carved in stone.
translations.idiomatic: The Lugou Bridge was completed, and the Emperor wrote an inscription for the stone.

sentences.zh: 十一月己亥，先是山西陝西總督莫洛、陝西巡撫白清額均坐鰲拜黨罷。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day jihai: formerly Governor-General Molo of Shanxi and Shaanxi and Governor Bai Qing'e of Shaanxi had both been dismissed as members of Oboi's faction.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on jihai: earlier, Molo, governor-general of Shanxi and Shaanxi, and Bai Qing'e, governor of Shaanxi, had both been dismissed as Oboi's partisans.

sentences.zh: 至是，西安百姓叩閽稱其清廉，乞還任。

translations.literal: At this time the people of Xi'an knocked at the palace gate, declaring them incorrupt and begging their return to office.
translations.idiomatic: Now the people of Xi'an came to the palace gate, praising their integrity and begging that they be restored.

sentences.zh: 詔特許之。

translations.literal: An edict specially permitted it.
translations.idiomatic: An edict specially granted the request.

sentences.zh: 壬子，太和殿、乾清宮成，上御太和殿受賀，入居乾清宮。

translations.literal: Day renzi: the Hall of Supreme Harmony and the Palace of Heavenly Purity were completed; the Emperor took his seat in the Hall of Supreme Harmony to receive congratulations and entered residence in the Palace of Heavenly Purity.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, with the Hall of Supreme Harmony and the Palace of Heavenly Purity completed, the Emperor received congratulations in the great hall and took up residence in the Palace of Heavenly Purity.

sentences.zh: 十二月己卯，顯親王福壽薨。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day jimao: Prince Xianqin Fushou died.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on jimao, Prince Xianqin Fushou died.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，祫祭太廟。

translations.literal: Day dinghai: joint sacrifice at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, a joint seasonal sacrifice was held at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 是歲，免直隸、江南、河南、山西、陝西、湖廣等省四十五州縣災賦有差。

translations.literal: That year, disaster taxes were remitted in varying measure for forty-five prefectures and counties in Zhili, Jiangnan, Henan, Shanxi, Shaanxi, Huguang, and other provinces.
translations.idiomatic: That year disaster taxes were reduced or remitted in forty-five prefectures and counties across Zhili, Jiangnan, Henan, Shanxi, Shaanxi, Huguang, and other provinces.

sentences.zh: 朝鮮、琉球入貢。

translations.literal: Korea and Ryukyu presented tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Korea and Ryukyu sent tribute missions.

sentences.zh: 九年庚戌春正月丙申，予宋儒程顥、程頤後裔五經博士。

translations.literal: Ninth year, spring, first month, day bingshen: descendants of the Song Confucians Cheng Hao and Cheng Yi were granted the office of Five Classics Erudite.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year, spring, the first month, on bingshen, descendants of the Song masters Cheng Hao and Cheng Yi were granted the title Erudite of the Five Classics.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，饗太廟。

translations.literal: Day dingyou: feast at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, a feast was held at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，祈穀於上帝，奉太祖高皇帝、太宗文皇帝、世祖章皇帝配饗。

translations.literal: Day xinchou: prayer for grain was offered to the Supreme Lord; the High Emperor Taizu, the Literary Emperor Taizong, and Emperor Zhang of Shizu were offered in joint sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, prayer for grain was offered to Heaven; the High Emperor Taizu, the Literary Emperor Taizong, and Emperor Zhang of Shizu were joined in the offering.

sentences.zh: 起遏必隆公爵，宿衛內廷。

translations.literal: Ebilun was restored to duke and stationed as inner guard.
translations.idiomatic: Ebilun was restored to ducal rank and assigned to guard the inner palace.

sentences.zh: 己酉，詔明籓田賦視民田輸納。

translations.literal: Day jiyou: an edict ordered that Ming princely land taxes be paid on the same terms as commoners' fields.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, an edict declared that land tax on Ming princely estates was to be assessed like that on common fields.

sentences.zh: 壬子，上幸南苑。

translations.literal: Day renzi: the Emperor visited the Southern Park.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, the Emperor visited the Southern Park.

sentences.zh: 二月癸酉，以金光祖為廣東廣西總督，馬雄鎮為廣西巡撫。

translations.literal: Second month, day guiyou: Jin Guangzu was appointed governor-general of Guangdong and Guangxi; Ma Xiongzhen was appointed governor of Guangxi.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on guiyou, Jin Guangzu was made governor-general of Guangdong and Guangxi, and Ma Xiongzhen governor of Guangxi.

sentences.zh: 癸未，詔尚陽堡、寧古塔流徙人犯，值十月至正月俱停發。

translations.literal: Day guiwei: an edict ordered that for exiles to Shangyang Fort and Ningguta, dispatch between the tenth month and the first month was suspended.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, an edict suspended the transport of exiles to Shangyang Fort and Ningguta during the months from the tenth to the first.

sentences.zh: 三月辛酉，賜蔡啟僔等二百九十二人進士及第出身有差。

translations.literal: Third month, day xinyou: Cai Qipu and two hundred ninety-two others were granted jinshi with rank distinctions according to degree.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on xinyou, Cai Qipu and two hundred ninety-two others received the jinshi degree, each according to rank.

sentences.zh: 夏四月己丑，以蔡毓榮為四川湖廣總督。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day jichou: Cai Yurong was appointed governor-general of Sichuan and Huguang.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, the fourth month, on jichou, Cai Yurong was appointed governor-general of Sichuan and Huguang.

sentences.zh: 己亥，上幸南苑。

translations.literal: Day jihai: the Emperor visited the Southern Park.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, the Emperor visited the Southern Park.

sentences.zh: 五月丙辰朔，加上孝康章皇后尊諡，升祔太廟，頒發恩詔，訪隱逸，賜高年，赦殊死以下。

translations.literal: Fifth month, first day bingchen: the posthumous honorific of Empress Xiaokangzhang was added; she was enshrined in the Imperial Ancestral Temple; a grace edict was promulgated; recluses were sought out; the aged were rewarded; and all below capital punishment were pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the first day bingchen, the posthumous title of Empress Xiaokangzhang was conferred, she was enshrined in the Imperial Ancestral Temple, a grace edict was issued, recluses were sought, the aged were rewarded, and all crimes short of death were pardoned.

sentences.zh: 丙子，纂修會典。

translations.literal: Day bingzi: the institutional statutes were ordered compiled.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, compilation of the institutional statutes was ordered.

sentences.zh: 六月丙戌朔，以席卜臣為蒙古都統。

translations.literal: Sixth month, first day bingxu: Xibochen was appointed Mongol commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the first day bingxu, Xibochen was appointed Mongol commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，以故顯親王福壽子丹臻襲爵。

translations.literal: Day dingyou: Danzhen, son of the late Prince Xianqin Fushou, inherited the title.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, Danzhen, son of the late Prince Xianqin Fushou, succeeded to the princely title.

sentences.zh: 己酉，命大學士會刑部錄囚。

translations.literal: Day jiyou: ordered Grand Secretaries to convene with the Board of Punishments to review prisoners.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiyou day he ordered the grand secretaries to meet with the Board of Punishments and review the prisoners.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丁巳，以王輔臣為陝西提督。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day dingsi: appointed Wang Fuchen Military Superintendent of Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the dingsi day, Wang Fuchen was made military superintendent of Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，奉祀孝康章皇后於奉先殿。

translations.literal: On dingsi, offered sacrifice to Empress Xiaokangzhang at the Hall of Ancestors.
translations.idiomatic: On the same dingsi day the Empress Xiaokangzhang was worshipped at the Hall of Ancestors.

sentences.zh: 八月戊子，祭社稷壇。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day wuzi: sacrificed at the Altars of Soil and Grain.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day of the eighth month he sacrificed at the altars of soil and grain.

sentences.zh: 詔都察院糾察陪祀王大臣班行不肅者。

translations.literal: Edict ordered the Censorate to investigate princes and great ministers whose ranks at collateral sacrifice were disorderly.
translations.idiomatic: An edict directed the Censorate to discipline princes and senior ministers who had been disorderly in rank while attending collateral sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 乙未，復內閣，復翰林院。

translations.literal: On yiwei, restored the Grand Secretariat, restored the Hanlin Academy.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiwei day the Grand Secretariat and the Hanlin Academy were restored.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，上奉太皇太后、皇太后有事於孝陵。

translations.literal: On dingyou, the Emperor accompanied the Grand Empress Dowager and Empress Dowager to perform rites at the Xiaoling Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day the emperor escorted the grand empress dowager and empress dowager to perform rites at the Xiaoling mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 壬子，車駕還宮。

translations.literal: On renzi, the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi day the imperial procession returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 九月庚申，以簡親王濟度子喇布襲爵。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day gengshen: Prince Jian's son Labu inherited the title.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengshen day of the ninth month Labu, son of Prince Jian Jidu, inherited his father's title.

sentences.zh: 冬十月庚巳，頒聖諭十六條。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day gengsi: promulgated the Sixteen Maxims of the Sacred Edict.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the gengsi day, the Sixteen Maxims of the Sacred Edict were promulgated.

sentences.zh: 甲午，改內三院，復中和殿、保和殿、文華殿大學士。

translations.literal: On jiawu, reformed the Three Inner Courts, restored Grand Secretaries of the Zhonghe Hall, Baohe Hall, and Wenhua Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiawu day the Three Inner Courts were reorganized and the grand secretaries of the Zhonghe, Baohe, and Wenhua halls were restored.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，諭禮部舉經筵。

translations.literal: On dingyou, instructed the Ministry of Rites to hold the classics lecture.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day he instructed the Ministry of Rites to hold the daily classics lecture.

sentences.zh: 十一月癸酉，以艾元徵為左都御史。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day guiyou: appointed Ai Yuanzheng Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiyou day of the eleventh month Ai Yuanzheng was appointed left censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 壬午，以中和殿大學士魏裔介兼禮部尚書。

translations.literal: On renwu, Grand Secretary Wei Yijie of the Zhonghe Hall additionally appointed Minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: On the renwu day Grand Secretary Wei Yijie of the Zhonghe Hall was also made minister of rites.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸卯，以莫洛為刑部尚書。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day guimao: appointed Moluo Minister of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day of the twelfth month Moluo was appointed minister of punishments.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，祫祭太廟。

translations.literal: On xinhai, performed the seasonal offering at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinhai day the seasonal offering was performed at the imperial ancestral temple.

sentences.zh: 是歲，免河南、湖廣、江南、福建、廣東、雲南等省二百五十三州縣衛災賦有差。

translations.literal: That year, disaster taxes remitted in varying degrees for 253 prefectures, counties, and garrisons in Henan, Huguang, Jiangnan, Fujian, Guangdong, Yunnan, and other provinces.
translations.idiomatic: That year disaster taxes were remitted in varying degrees at 253 prefectures, counties, and garrisons in Henan, Huguang, Jiangnan, Fujian, Guangdong, Yunnan, and other provinces.

sentences.zh: 朝鮮入貢。

translations.literal: Korea sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Korea sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 十年辛亥春正月丁卯，蒙古蘇尼特部、四子部大雪飢寒，遣官賑之。

translations.literal: Year 10, spring, first month, day dingmao: Sonid and Siziwang Mongol banners suffered heavy snow, cold, and hunger; officials dispatched to relieve them.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year, on the dingmao day of the first month of spring, the Sonid and Siziwang Mongol banners suffered from heavy snow, cold, and hunger, and officials were sent to relieve them.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，封世祖第五子常寧為恭親王。

translations.literal: On guiyou, enfeoffed the Shunzhi Emperor's fifth son Changning as Prince Gong.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiyou day the Shunzhi emperor's fifth son Changning was enfeoffed as Prince Gong.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，大學士魏裔介罷。

translations.literal: On gengchen, Grand Secretary Wei Yijie dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengchen day Grand Secretary Wei Yijie was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 以曹申吉為貴州巡撫。

translations.literal: Appointed Cao Shenji Governor of Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Cao Shenji was appointed governor of Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 二月丁酉，以馮溥為大學士，以梁清標為刑部尚書。

translations.literal: Second month, day dingyou: appointed Feng Pu Grand Secretary, appointed Liang Qingbiao Minister of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day of the second month Feng Pu was made grand secretary and Liang Qingbiao minister of punishments.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，召宗人覺羅年七十以上趙班等四人入見，賜朝服銀幣。

translations.literal: On yisi, summoned four men of the Aisin Gioro clan aged seventy or above, including Zhao Ban, for audience; bestowed court dress and silver coins.
translations.idiomatic: On the yisi day four members of the imperial clan aged seventy or above, including Zhao Ban, were summoned to audience and given court dress and silver.

sentences.zh: 戊申，命編纂孝經衍義。

translations.literal: On wushen, ordered compilation of the Exegesis of the Classic of Filial Piety.
translations.idiomatic: On the wushen day he ordered the compilation of the Exegesis of the Classic of Filial Piety.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，以尼雅翰為滿洲都統。

translations.literal: On gengxu, appointed Niyahan Manchu Banner General.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu day Niyahan was appointed Manchu banner general.

sentences.zh: 三月壬子朔，誥誡年幼諸王讀書習騎射，勿恃貴縱恣。

translations.literal: Third month, new moon of day renzi: issued admonitions to young princes to study and practice riding and archery, not to rely on rank to indulge themselves.
translations.idiomatic: On the new moon of the renzi day in the third month an admonition was issued to young princes to study and practice riding and archery and not to rely on their rank to indulge themselves.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，置日講官。

translations.literal: On guichou, established daily lecture officials.
translations.idiomatic: On the guichou day daily lecture officials were established.

sentences.zh: 庚午，以無雨風霾，下詔修省。

translations.literal: On gengwu, because of drought and dusty winds, issued an edict calling for self-examination.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengwu day, because of drought and dusty winds, an edict called for self-examination.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙酉，命纂修太祖、太宗聖訓。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day yiyou: ordered compilation of the sacred instructions of the Taizu and Taizong emperors.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiyou day of the fourth month of summer he ordered the compilation of the sacred instructions of the Taizu and Taizong emperors.

sentences.zh: 詔宗人閒散及幼孤者，量予養贍，著為令。

translations.literal: Edict: for idle or orphaned members of the imperial clan, maintenance allowances were granted as appropriate and established as regulation.
translations.idiomatic: An edict provided maintenance allowances as appropriate for idle or orphaned members of the imperial clan and made this a standing regulation.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，詔清理庶獄，減矜疑一等。

translations.literal: On bingxu, edict to clear common prisons and reduce doubtful capital cases by one grade.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingxu day an edict ordered the clearing of ordinary prisons and reduced doubtful capital sentences by one grade.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，始開日講。

translations.literal: On xinmao, the daily lecture was first opened.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinmao day the daily lecture was first held.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，上詣天壇禱雨。

translations.literal: On renchen, the Emperor went to the Temple of Heaven to pray for rain.
translations.idiomatic: On the renchen day the emperor went to the Temple of Heaven to pray for rain.

sentences.zh: 甲午，雨。

translations.literal: On jiawu, rain.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiawu day it rained.

sentences.zh: 五月庚申，理籓院尚書喀蘭圖乞休，加太子太保，以內大臣奉朝請。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day gengshen: Kalanitu, Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs, requested retirement; made Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent and granted attendance as inner grand minister.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengshen day of the fifth month Kalanitu, minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs, asked to retire; he was made grand guardian of the heir apparent and granted attendance as an inner grand minister.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，上幸南苑。

translations.literal: On guiyou, the Emperor visited the Southern Park.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiyou day the emperor visited the Southern Park.

sentences.zh: 六月丁亥，以靳輔為安徽巡撫。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day dinghai: appointed Jin Fu Governor of Anhui.
translations.idiomatic: On the dinghai day of the sixth month Jin Fu was appointed governor of Anhui.

sentences.zh: 甲午，金星晝見。

translations.literal: On jiawu, Venus seen in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiawu day Venus was seen in daylight.

sentences.zh: 是月，靖南王耿繼茂卒，子精忠襲封，仍鎮福建。

translations.literal: That month, Prince Jingnan Geng Jingmao died; his son Jingzhong inherited the title and continued to garrison Fujian.
translations.idiomatic: That month Prince Jingnan Geng Jingmao died; his son Jingzhong inherited the title and continued to garrison Fujian.

sentences.zh: 八月己卯朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Eighth month, new moon of day jimao: solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the new moon of the jimao day in the eighth month there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 丁未，上御經筵。

translations.literal: On dingwei, the Emperor attended the classics lecture.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingwei day the emperor attended the classics lecture.

sentences.zh: 戊申，以王之鼎為江南提督。

translations.literal: On wushen, appointed Wang Zhiding Military Superintendent of Jiangnan.
translations.idiomatic: On the wushen day Wang Zhiding was appointed military superintendent of Jiangnan.

sentences.zh: 九月庚戌，上以寰宇一統，告成於二陵。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day gengxu: because the realm was unified, the Emperor reported completion at the two mausoleums.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu day of the ninth month, because the realm had been unified, the emperor reported the accomplishment at the two imperial mausoleums.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，上奉太皇太后、皇太后啟鑾。

translations.literal: On xinhai, the Emperor accompanied the Grand Empress Dowager and Empress Dowager as they set out.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinhai day the emperor accompanied the grand empress dowager and empress dowager as they set out.

sentences.zh: 蒙古科爾沁、喀喇沁、土默特、敖漢諸部王、貝勒、公朝行在。

translations.literal: Princes, beile, and dukes of the Khorchin, Kharchin, Tumed, and Aohan Mongol banners came to the temporary court to pay homage.
translations.idiomatic: Princes, beile, and dukes of the Khorchin, Kharchin, Tumed, and Aohan Mongol banners came to the traveling court to pay homage.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，謁福陵、昭陵。

translations.literal: On dingmao, visited Fuling and Zhaoling.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingmao day he visited Fuling and Zhaoling.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，祭福陵，行告成禮。

translations.literal: On wuchen, sacrificed at Fuling and performed the completion rite.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuchen day he sacrificed at Fuling and performed the completion rite.

sentences.zh: 庚午，祭昭陵，行告成禮。

translations.literal: On gengwu, sacrificed at Zhaoling and performed the completion rite.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengwu day he sacrificed at Zhaoling and performed the completion rite.

sentences.zh: 辛未，上幸盛京，御清寧宮，賜百官宴，八十以上召前賜酒。

translations.literal: On xinwei, the Emperor visited Shengjing, took seat in the Qingning Palace, gave a banquet to all officials; those eighty or above were summoned forward and given wine.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinwei day the emperor visited Shengjing, took his seat in the Qingning Palace, and gave a banquet to the officials; those eighty or older were summoned forward and given wine.

sentences.zh: 大賚奉天、寧古塔甲士及於傷廢老病者白金，民間高年亦如之。

translations.literal: Great gifts of silver were given to soldiers of Fengtian and Ningguta, and to the wounded, disabled, elderly, and sick; the aged among the people likewise.
translations.idiomatic: Great gifts of silver were given to the soldiers of Fengtian and Ningguta and to the wounded, disabled, elderly, and sick, and likewise to the aged among the people.

sentences.zh: 曲赦死罪減一等，軍流以下釋之。

translations.literal: A restricted amnesty reduced death sentences by one grade; those sentenced to military exile or below were released.
translations.idiomatic: A restricted amnesty reduced death sentences by one grade and released those sentenced to military exile or lesser punishments.

sentences.zh: 山海關外蹕路所經，勿出今年明年租賦。

translations.literal: Along the imperial route outside Shanhaiguan, rent and levies for this year and the next were not collected.
translations.idiomatic: Along the imperial route outside Shanhaiguan, rent and levies for that year and the next were not collected.

sentences.zh: 遣官祭諸王諸大臣墓。

translations.literal: Officials were dispatched to sacrifice at the tombs of princes and great ministers.
translations.idiomatic: Officials were sent to sacrifice at the tombs of princes and senior ministers.

sentences.zh: 壬申，上自盛京東巡。

translations.literal: On renshen, the Emperor toured east from Shengjing.
translations.idiomatic: On the renshen day the emperor toured east from Shengjing.

sentences.zh: 冬十月辛巳，駐蹕愛新。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day xinsi: halted at Aisin.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinsi day of the tenth month of winter the court halted at Aisin.

sentences.zh: 召寧古塔將軍巴海，諭以新附瓦爾喀、虎爾哈宜善撫之。

translations.literal: Summoned General Bahai of Ningguta and instructed him kindly to pacify the newly submitted Warka and Hurka peoples.
translations.idiomatic: He summoned Bahai, general of Ningguta, and instructed him to treat kindly and pacify the newly submitted Warka and Hurka peoples.

sentences.zh: 己丑，上回蹕盛京，再賜老人金。

translations.literal: On jichou, the Emperor returned to Shengjing and again bestowed gold on the elderly.
translations.idiomatic: On the jichou day the emperor returned to Shengjing and again bestowed gold on the elderly.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，謁福陵、昭陵。

translations.literal: On xinmao, visited Fuling and Zhaoling.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinmao day he visited Fuling and Zhaoling.

sentences.zh: 命文武官較射。

translations.literal: Ordered civil and military officials to compete in archery.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered civil and military officials to compete in archery.

sentences.zh: 命來朝外籓較射。

translations.literal: Ordered visiting outer vassals to compete in archery.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered visiting outer vassals to compete in archery.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，上奉太皇太后、皇太后迴鑾。

translations.literal: On renchen, the Emperor accompanied the Grand Empress Dowager and Empress Dowager on the return journey.
translations.idiomatic: On the renchen day the emperor accompanied the grand empress dowager and empress dowager on the return journey.

sentences.zh: 十一月庚戌，還京。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day gengxu: returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu day of the eleventh month the court returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 壬申，以明珠為兵部尚書。

translations.literal: On renshen, appointed Mingzhu Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: On the renshen day Mingzhu was appointed minister of war.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙午，祫祭太廟。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day bingwu: performed the seasonal offering at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingwu day of the twelfth month the seasonal offering was performed at the imperial ancestral temple.

sentences.zh: 是歲，免直隸、江南、江西、浙江、山東、河南、陝西、湖廣等省三百二州縣衛災賦逋賦有差。

translations.literal: That year, disaster and overdue taxes remitted in varying degrees for 302 prefectures, counties, and garrisons in Zhili, Jiangnan, Jiangxi, Zhejiang, Shandong, Henan, Shaanxi, Huguang, and other provinces.
translations.idiomatic: That year disaster and overdue taxes were remitted in varying degrees at 302 prefectures, counties, and garrisons in Zhili, Jiangnan, Jiangxi, Zhejiang, Shandong, Henan, Shaanxi, Huguang, and other provinces.

sentences.zh: 朝鮮、琉球入貢。

translations.literal: Korea and Ryukyu sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Korea and Ryukyu sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 十一年壬子春正月辛未，上奉太皇太后幸赤城湯泉，過八達嶺，親扶慈輦，步行下山。

translations.literal: Year 11, spring, first month, day xinwei: the Emperor accompanied the Grand Empress Dowager to the hot springs at Chicheng; passing Badaling, he personally supported her palanquin and walked down the mountain on foot.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year, on the xinwei day of the first month of spring, the emperor accompanied the grand empress dowager to the hot springs at Chicheng; passing Badaling, he personally steadied her palanquin and walked down the mountain on foot.

sentences.zh: 二月戊寅，奉太皇太后至湯泉。

translations.literal: Second month, day wuyin: escorted the Grand Empress Dowager to the hot springs.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuyin day of the second month he escorted the grand empress dowager to the hot springs.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，上回京。

translations.literal: On xinmao, the Emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinmao day the emperor returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 丙申，親耕耤田。

translations.literal: On bingshen, personally plowed the sacred field.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingshen day he personally plowed the sacred field.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，朝日於東郊。

translations.literal: On dingyou, worshipped the sun at the eastern suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day he worshipped the sun at the eastern suburb.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，上詣赤城。

translations.literal: On wuxu, the Emperor went to Chicheng.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuxu day the emperor went to Chicheng.

sentences.zh: 三月戊辰，上奉太皇太后還宮。

translations.literal: Third month, day wuchen: the Emperor escorted the Grand Empress Dowager back to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuchen day of the third month the emperor escorted the grand empress dowager back to the palace.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙巳，命侍衛吳丹、學士郭廷祚巡視河工。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day yisi: ordered Guardsman Wu Dan and Academician Guo Tingzuo to inspect river works.
translations.idiomatic: On the yisi day of the fourth month of summer he ordered the guardsman Wu Dan and the academician Guo Tingzuo to inspect the river works.

sentences.zh: 五月乙丑，世祖實錄成。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day yichou: the Veritable Records of the Shunzhi Emperor were completed.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day of the fifth month the Veritable Records of the Shunzhi emperor were completed.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，上出德勝門觀麥。

translations.literal: On bingyin, the Emperor went out Desheng Gate to view the wheat.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingyin day the emperor went out Desheng Gate to view the wheat.

sentences.zh: 六月庚寅，命更定賦役全書。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day gengyin: ordered revision of the complete book of tax and corvée obligations.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengyin day of the sixth month he ordered the revision of the complete register of tax and corvée obligations.

sentences.zh: 秋七月己酉，論征緬甸、雲南、貴州功，予何建忠等一百二十七人世職。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day jiyou: reviewed merits of the Burma, Yunnan, and Guizhou campaigns and granted hereditary offices to 127 men including He Jianzhong.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiyou day of the seventh month of autumn the merits of the Burma, Yunnan, and Guizhou campaigns were reviewed and hereditary offices were granted to 127 men including He Jianzhong.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，上觀禾。

translations.literal: On bingchen, the Emperor viewed the grain crops.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen day the emperor viewed the grain crops.

sentences.zh: 御史孟雄飛疏言孫可望窮蹙來歸，濫膺王封。

translations.literal: Censor Meng Xiongfei memorialized that Sun Kewang, having come to surrender in dire straits, had been lavishly enfeoffed as a prince.
translations.idiomatic: Censor Meng Xiongfei memorialized that Sun Kewang, having surrendered in dire straits, had nevertheless been lavishly enfeoffed as a prince.

sentences.zh: 及伊身死，已襲二次。

translations.literal: By the time of his death, the title had already been inherited twice.
translations.idiomatic: By the time of his death the title had already been inherited twice.

sentences.zh: 今孫徵淳死，宜令降襲。

translations.literal: Now that Sun Zhengchun had died, the succession should be reduced in rank.
translations.idiomatic: Now that Sun Zhengchun had died, the succession should be reduced in rank.

sentences.zh: 詔降襲慕義公。

translations.literal: Edict ordered the reduced inheritance of the title Duke of Muyi.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered the reduced inheritance of the title Duke of Muyi.

sentences.zh: 閏七月，復封尚善為貝勒。

translations.literal: Intercalary seventh month: restored Shangshan's title as beile.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary seventh month Shangshan's title as beile was restored.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，詔治獄勿用嚴刑輕斃人命，違者罪之。

translations.literal: On dinghai, edict that in handling cases severe torture must not be used to take lives lightly; violators would be punished.
translations.idiomatic: On the dinghai day an edict declared that in handling cases severe torture must not be used to take lives lightly, and that violators would be punished.

sentences.zh: 八月壬子，上幸南苑行圍。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day renzi: the Emperor visited the Southern Park for the hunt.
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi day of the eighth month the emperor visited the Southern Park for the hunt.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，詔曰：「帝王致治，在維持風化，辨別等威。

translations.literal: On guichou, an edict said: "For emperors and kings to bring order, it lies in maintaining moral custom and distinguishing ranks and dignities.
translations.idiomatic: On the guichou day an edict said, "For emperors and kings to bring order lies in maintaining moral custom and distinguishing ranks and dignities.

sentences.zh: 比來官員服用奢僭，競相效尤。

translations.literal: Recently officials' dress and use of goods have been extravagant and presumptuous, vying with one another in emulation.
translations.idiomatic: Recently officials' dress and furnishings have grown extravagant and presumptuous, each vying to outdo the other.

sentences.zh: 其議禁之。

translations.literal: Let this be deliberated and forbidden."
translations.idiomatic: Let this be deliberated and forbidden."

sentences.zh: 」庚申，上御經筵。

translations.literal: On gengshen, the Emperor attended the classics lecture.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengshen day the emperor attended the classics lecture.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，上奉太皇太后幸遵化湯泉。

translations.literal: On renxu, the Emperor accompanied the Grand Empress Dowager to the hot springs at Zunhua.
translations.idiomatic: On the renxu day the emperor accompanied the grand empress dowager to the hot springs at Zunhua.

sentences.zh: 甲子，閱薊州官兵較射。

translations.literal: On jiazi, reviewed the troops of Jizhou in archery competition.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiazi day he reviewed the troops of Jizhou in an archery competition.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，上謁孝陵。

translations.literal: On dingmao, the Emperor visited the Xiaoling Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingmao day the emperor visited the Xiaoling mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 九月丁丑，閱遵化兵、三屯營兵。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day dingchou: reviewed the troops of Zunhua and the Santunying garrison.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingchou day of the ninth month he reviewed the troops of Zunhua and the Santunying garrison.

sentences.zh: 冬十月甲辰，上奉太皇太后還宮。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day jiachen: the Emperor escorted the Grand Empress Dowager back to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiachen day of the tenth month of winter the emperor escorted the grand empress dowager back to the palace.

sentences.zh: 壬子，命范承謨為福建總督。

translations.literal: On renzi, appointed Fan Chengmou Governor-General of Fujian.
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi day Fan Chengmou was appointed governor-general of Fujian.

sentences.zh: 十一月辛丑，上幸南苑，建行宮。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day xinchou: the Emperor visited the Southern Park and built a traveling palace.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinchou day of the eleventh month the emperor visited the Southern Park and built a traveling palace.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁未，裕親王福全、庄親王博果鐸、惠郡王博翁果諾、溫郡王孟峨疏辭議政。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day dingwei: Prince Yu Fuquan, Prince Zhuang Boguoduo, Prince Hui Bo'erguonuo, and Prince Wen Meng'e memorialized declining participation in deliberations on government.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingwei day of the twelfth month Prince Yu Fuquan, Prince Zhuang Boguoduo, Prince Hui Bo'erguonuo, and Prince Wen Meng'e memorialized their wish to withdraw from deliberations on government.

sentences.zh: 允之。

translations.literal: Permission was granted.
translations.idiomatic: Permission was granted.

sentences.zh: 戊午，上召講官諭曰：「有人請令言官風聞言事。

translations.literal: Day wuwu: the emperor summoned the lecturing officials and instructed them, saying: "Someone has asked that censor-officials be allowed to report matters on hearsay.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuwu day the emperor summoned his lecture officials and said, "Someone has proposed that censors be allowed to act on rumor and hearsay.

sentences.zh: 朕思切中事理之言，患其不多。

translations.literal: I consider that words hitting the heart of the matter—I fear there are not enough of them.
translations.idiomatic: I want counsel that cuts to the truth; my worry is that there is too little of it.

sentences.zh: 若借端生事，傾陷擾亂，深足害政。

translations.literal: If they seize pretexts to stir up affairs, frame and ruin people, and cause disturbance, that deeply harms government.
translations.idiomatic: If they seize pretexts, frame rivals, and throw the realm into turmoil, government suffers deeply.

sentences.zh: 與民休息，道在不擾。

translations.literal: To let the people rest and recover, the Way lies in not disturbing them.
translations.idiomatic: To give the people rest, the Way is to leave them undisturbed.

sentences.zh: 虛耗元氣，則民生蹙矣。

translations.literal: If vital energy is squandered in vain, the people's livelihood becomes cramped.
translations.idiomatic: Squander the state's strength and the people's livelihood tightens.

sentences.zh: 」己未，康親王傑書、安親王岳樂疏辭議政。

translations.literal: " Day jiwei: Prince Kang Jieshu and Prince An Yuele memorialized to resign from deliberating on government.
translations.idiomatic: " On the jiwei day Prince Kang Jieshu and Prince An Yuele asked to step down from regency deliberation.

sentences.zh: 不許。

translations.literal: Not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: The request was denied.

sentences.zh: 庚午，祫祭太廟。

translations.literal: Day gengwu: joint sacrifice at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengwu day the court performed the joint seasonal sacrifice at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 是歲，免直隸、江南、浙江、山東、山西、河南、湖廣等省一百四十一州縣衛災賦有差。

translations.literal: That year, land tax and disaster levies were remitted in varying degrees for one hundred forty-one prefectures, counties, and guards in Zhili, Jiangnan, Zhejiang, Shandong, Shanxi, Henan, Huguang, and other provinces.
translations.idiomatic: That year disaster taxes were reduced or remitted, in varying degrees, across one hundred forty-one prefectures, counties, and guards in Zhili, Jiangnan, Zhejiang, Shandong, Shanxi, Henan, Huguang, and other provinces.

sentences.zh: 朝鮮入貢。

translations.literal: Korea sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Korea presented tribute.

sentences.zh: 十二年癸丑春正月庚寅，上幸南苑，大閱。

translations.literal: Twelfth year, guichou cycle, first month of spring, day gengyin: the emperor visited the Southern Park for a grand review.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year of the Kangxi reign, on the gengyin day of the first month of spring, the emperor went to the Southern Park for a grand military review.

sentences.zh: 二月辛亥，以吳正治為左都御史。

translations.literal: Second month, day xinhai: Wu Zhengzhi was appointed Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinhai day of the second month Wu Zhengzhi was made Left Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 壬子，上御經筵，命講官日直。

translations.literal: Day renzi: the emperor attended the classics lecture and ordered the lecturing officials to serve daily shifts.
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi day the emperor held court at the lecture hall and ordered the lecturers to attend in daily rotation.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，賜八旗官學繙譯大學衍義。

translations.literal: Day wuchen: the Eight Banners official schools were granted the Manchu translation of the Great Learning with Extended Meaning.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuchen day the court bestowed upon the Eight Banners official schools the Manchu translation of the Daxue yanyi.

sentences.zh: 三月丁丑，上視麥。

translations.literal: Third month, day dingchou: the emperor inspected the wheat crop.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingchou day of the third month the emperor went out to inspect the wheat.

sentences.zh: 壬午，平南王尚可喜請老，許之；

translations.literal: Day renwu: Pacifying-the-South Prince Shang Kexi requested retirement; permitted;
translations.idiomatic: On the renwu day Pacifying-the-South Prince Shang Kexi asked to retire; the request was granted;

sentences.zh: 請以其子之信嗣封鎮粵，不許，令其撤籓還駐遼東。

translations.literal: he asked that his son Zhixin succeed him in holding Guangdong; not permitted; he was ordered to relinquish his fief and return to garrison Liaodong.
translations.idiomatic: he asked that his son Zhixin inherit the fief and continue to guard Guangdong; this was refused, and he was ordered to withdraw the fief and return to garrison Liaodong.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，賜韓菼等一百六十六人進士及第出身有差。

translations.literal: Day guisi: one hundred sixty-six jinshi including Han Tan were granted graduated status in varying grades.
translations.idiomatic: On the guisi day one hundred sixty-six graduates, including Han Tan, received jinshi honors in differing ranks.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丁巳，遣官封暹羅國王。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day dingsi: officials were dispatched to confer investiture on the King of Siam.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the dingsi day, envoys were sent to invest the king of Siam.

sentences.zh: 五月壬申，學士傅達禮等請以夏至輟講。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day renshen: Academicians Fu Dali and others asked to suspend lectures at the summer solstice.
translations.idiomatic: On the renshen day of the fifth month Academician Fu Dali and others asked to suspend the classics lectures at the summer solstice.

sentences.zh: 上曰：「學問之道，宜無間斷。

translations.literal: The emperor said: "The path of learning should know no interruption.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said, "The pursuit of learning ought never to be broken off.

sentences.zh: 其勿輟。

translations.literal: Do not suspend them.
translations.idiomatic: Do not stop the lectures.

translations.literal: "" (closing punctuation in source.)
translations.idiomatic: The passage continues.

sentences.zh: 六月壬寅，起張朝珍為湖廣巡撫，李之芳為浙江總督。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day renyin: Zhang Chaozhen was recalled as Huguang governor; Li Zhifang as Zhejiang governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin day of the sixth month Zhang Chaozhen was reappointed Huguang governor and Li Zhifang Zhejiang governor-general.

sentences.zh: 丁未，上御瀛台，召群臣觀荷賜宴。

translations.literal: Day dingwei: the emperor went to Yingtai, summoned the ministers to view the lotuses, and granted a banquet.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingwei day the emperor went to Yingtai, summoned the officials to view the lotuses, and gave a banquet.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，禁八旗以奴僕殉葬。

translations.literal: Day yimao: the Eight Banners were forbidden to bury slaves and servants alive with the dead.
translations.idiomatic: On the yimao day the court forbade the Eight Banners to bury slaves and servants alive with the dead.

sentences.zh: 秋七月庚午，平西王吳三桂疏請撤籓。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day gengwu: Pacifying-the-West Prince Wu Sangui memorialized requesting withdrawal of his fief.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the gengwu day, Pacifying-the-West Prince Wu Sangui memorialized asking to surrender his fief.

sentences.zh: 許之。

translations.literal: Permitted.
translations.idiomatic: The request was granted.

sentences.zh: 丙子，嗣靖南王耿精忠疏請撤籓。

translations.literal: Day bingzi: the succeeding Pacifying-the-South Prince Geng Jingzhong memorialized requesting withdrawal of his fief.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingzi day the succeeding Pacifying-the-South Prince Geng Jingzhong likewise asked to withdraw his fief.

sentences.zh: 許之。

translations.literal: Permitted.
translations.idiomatic: This too was granted.

sentences.zh: 壬午，命重修太宗實錄。

translations.literal: Day renwu: ordered the Veritable Records of Taizong to be revised.
translations.idiomatic: On the renwu day the court ordered the Veritable Records of Taizong to be revised.

sentences.zh: 八月丁未，試漢科道官於保和殿，不稱職者罷。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day dingwei: Han censorate officials were tested at the Hall of Preserving Harmony; those unfit were dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingwei day of the eighth month Han censorate officials were examined in the Hall of Preserving Harmony, and those found unfit were removed.

sentences.zh: 壬子，遣侍郎折爾肯、學士傅達禮往雲南，尚書梁清標往廣東，侍郎陳一炳往福建，經理撤籓。

translations.literal: Day renzi: Vice Minister Zhe'erken and Academician Fu Dali were sent to Yunnan, Minister Liang Qingbiao to Guangdong, and Vice Minister Chen Yibing to Fujian to manage the withdrawal of the fiefs.
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi day Vice Minister Zhe'erken and Academician Fu Dali were dispatched to Yunnan, Minister Liang Qingbiao to Guangdong, and Vice Minister Chen Yibing to Fujian to oversee the dismantling of the fiefs.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，諭禮部：「祭祀大典，必儀文詳備，乃可昭格。

translations.literal: Day dingsi: instructed the Ministry of Rites: "Grand sacrificial ceremonies must have rites and texts fully complete, only then can they manifest blessing.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingsi day the emperor instructed the Ministry of Rites, "In great state sacrifices the ritual text must be complete before Heaven can be properly addressed.

sentences.zh: 其稽古典禮酌議以聞。

translations.literal: Investigate the ancient canonical rites, deliberate, and report.
translations.idiomatic: Review the classical precedents, weigh them, and report your findings.

translations.literal: "" (closing punctuation in source.)
translations.idiomatic: The passage continues.

sentences.zh: 九月戊辰，禮部尚書龔鼎孳乞休。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day wuchen: Minister of Rites Gong Dingzi requested retirement.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuchen day of the ninth month Minister of Rites Gong Dingzi asked to retire.

sentences.zh: 允之。

translations.literal: Permitted.
translations.idiomatic: The request was granted.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，京師地震，詔修省。

translations.literal: Day yihai: earthquake in the capital; an edict ordered self-examination and restraint.
translations.idiomatic: On the yihai day an earthquake struck the capital, and an edict called for court and officials to examine themselves and practice restraint.

sentences.zh: 冬十月壬寅，以王之鼎為京口將軍。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day renyin: Wang Zhiding was appointed Jingkou garrison general.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the renyin day, Wang Zhiding was made general of the Jingkou garrison.

sentences.zh: 己酉，上幸南苑行圍。

translations.literal: Day jiyou: the emperor visited the Southern Park for a hunting encampment.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiyou day the emperor went to the Southern Park for a hunting camp.

sentences.zh: 十一月丁卯，故明宗室朱議潀以蓄髮論死。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day dingmao: Ming imperial clansman Zhu Yicheng was sentenced to death for growing his hair.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingmao day of the eleventh month the Ming clansman Zhu Yicheng was condemned to death for wearing his hair long.

sentences.zh: 得旨免死入旗，給與妻室房地。

translations.literal: Upon receiving the imperial rescript, death was remitted; he was enrolled in a banner and granted a wife, household, land, and dwelling.
translations.idiomatic: After the rescript arrived, execution was remitted; he was enrolled in a banner and given a wife, household, land, and housing.

sentences.zh: 庚午，詔民間墾荒田畝，以十年起科。

translations.literal: Day gengwu: edict that reclaimed wasteland by commoners would be taxed only after ten years.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengwu day an edict declared that farmland reclaimed by commoners would not be taxed until the tenth year.

sentences.zh: 十二月壬子，以姚文然為左都御史。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day renzi: Yao Wenran was appointed Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi day of the twelfth month Yao Wenran was made Left Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 吳三桂反，殺雲南巡撫朱國治，貴州提督李本深、巡撫曹申吉俱降賊，總督甘文焜死之。

translations.literal: Wu Sangui rebelled, killed Yunnan governor Zhu Guozhi; Guizhou provincial military commissioner Li Benshen and governor Cao Shenji both surrendered to the rebels; governor-general Gan Wenkan died.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Sangui rose in rebellion, killed Yunnan governor Zhu Guozhi, and saw Guizhou military commissioner Li Benshen and governor Cao Shenji surrender to him; governor-general Gan Wenkan died in the crisis.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，反問至，命前鋒統領碩岱率禁旅守荊州。

translations.literal: Day bingchen: news of the rebellion arrived; ordered Vanguard Commander Suodai to lead the Forbidden Troops to hold Jingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen day word of the rebellion reached the capital, and Vanguard Commander Suodai was ordered to lead the Forbidden Troops to defend Jingzhou.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，召梁清標、陳一炳還，停撤二籓。

translations.literal: Day dingsi: recalled Liang Qingbiao and Chen Yibing and suspended the dismantling of the two fiefs.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingsi day Liang Qingbiao and Chen Yibing were recalled and the withdrawal of the two fiefs was halted.

sentences.zh: 命加孫延齡撫蠻將軍，線國安為都統，鎮廣西。

translations.literal: Ordered Sun Yanling promoted to Pacify-the-Barbarians General and Xian Guo'an made commandant to guard Guangxi.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Yanling was promoted to Pacify-the-Barbarians General and Xian Guo'an made commandant to hold Guangxi.

sentences.zh: 命西安將軍瓦爾喀進守四川。

translations.literal: Ordered Xi'an garrison general Waerka to advance and guard Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: Xi'an garrison general Waerka was ordered to advance and secure Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 京師民楊起隆偽稱朱三太子，圖起事。

translations.literal: A Beijing commoner, Yang Qilong, falsely claimed to be the Third Prince Zhu and plotted an uprising.
translations.idiomatic: In the capital the commoner Yang Qilong posed as the Third Prince Zhu and plotted rebellion.

sentences.zh: 事發覺，起隆逸去。

translations.literal: The plot was discovered; Qilong escaped.
translations.idiomatic: The plot was uncovered, but Qilong escaped.

sentences.zh: 捕誅其黨。

translations.literal: His followers were arrested and executed.
translations.idiomatic: His accomplices were seized and put to death.

sentences.zh: 詔奸民作亂已平，勿株連，民勿驚避。

translations.literal: Edict that the wicked commoners' disturbance had been pacified; no extension of guilt by association; the people should not flee in panic.
translations.idiomatic: An edict announced that the traitors' rising had been crushed, that guilt would not be extended by association, and that the people were not to flee in fear.

sentences.zh: 己未，命順承郡王勒爾錦為寧南靖寇大將軍，討吳三桂。

translations.literal: Day jiwei: ordered Prince of Shuncheng Le'erjin as Grand General for Pacifying the South and Suppressing Rebels to campaign against Wu Sangui.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiwei day Prince of Shuncheng Le'erjin was appointed Grand General for Pacifying the South and Suppressing Rebels to take the field against Wu Sangui.

sentences.zh: 執三桂子額駙吳應熊下之獄。

translations.literal: Wu Sangui's son, the imperial son-in-law Wu Yingxiong, was arrested and imprisoned.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Sangui's son, the imperial son-in-law Wu Yingxiong, was seized and thrown into prison.

sentences.zh: 庚申，命副都統馬哈達帥師駐兗州，擴爾坤駐太原，備調遣。

translations.literal: Day gengshen: ordered Vice Commandant Mahada to command troops stationed at Yanzhou and Kubo'erkan at Taiyuan, ready for deployment.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengshen day Vice Commandant Mahada was ordered to hold Yanzhou with his force and Kubo'erkan Taiyuan, both standing ready for dispatch.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，命直省巡撫仍管軍務。

translations.literal: Day xinyou: ordered provincial governors to resume military duties.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinyou day the court ordered provincial governors once again to oversee military affairs.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，詔削吳三桂爵，宣示中外。

translations.literal: Day renxu: edict stripping Wu Sangui of his rank, proclaimed within and without.
translations.idiomatic: On the renxu day an edict stripped Wu Sangui of his titles and proclaimed the fact at home and abroad.

sentences.zh: 命都統赫業為安西將軍，會瓦爾喀守漢中。

translations.literal: Ordered Commandant Heye as Pacify-the-West General to join Waerka in holding Hanzhong.
translations.idiomatic: Commandant Heye was made Pacify-the-West General and ordered to join Waerka in defending Hanzhong.

sentences.zh: 以倭內為奉天將軍。

translations.literal: Wo'nei was made Fengtian garrison general.
translations.idiomatic: Wo'nei was appointed Fengtian garrison general.

sentences.zh: 吳三桂陷辰州。

translations.literal: Wu Sangui captured Chenzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Sangui took Chenzhou.

sentences.zh: 甲子，祫祭太廟。

translations.literal: Day jiazi: joint sacrifice at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiazi day the court performed the joint sacrifice at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 是歲，免直隸、山東、安徽、浙江、湖廣等省二十六州縣衛災賦有差。

translations.literal: That year, disaster levies were remitted in varying degrees for twenty-six prefectures, counties, and guards in Zhili, Shandong, Anhui, Zhejiang, Huguang, and other provinces.
translations.idiomatic: That year disaster taxes were reduced or remitted, in varying degrees, across twenty-six prefectures, counties, and guards in Zhili, Shandong, Anhui, Zhejiang, Huguang, and other provinces.

sentences.zh: 朝鮮、安南入貢。

translations.literal: Korea and Annam sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Korea and Annam presented tribute.

sentences.zh: 十三年甲寅春正月乙亥，勒爾錦師行。

translations.literal: Thirteenth year, jiayin cycle, first month of spring, day yihai: Le'erjin's army set out.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year, on the yihai day of the first month of spring, Le'erjin's army marched out.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，吳三桂陷沅州。

translations.literal: Day gengchen: Wu Sangui captured Yuanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengchen day Wu Sangui seized Yuanzhou.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，偏沅巡撫盧震棄長沙遁。

translations.literal: Day dinghai: Pian-Yuan governor Lu Zhen abandoned Changsha and fled.
translations.idiomatic: On the dinghai day Pian-Yuan governor Lu Zhen abandoned Changsha and fled.

sentences.zh: 己丑，以提督佟國瑤守鄖陽。

translations.literal: Day jichou: provincial military commissioner Tong Guoyao was assigned to hold Xiangyang.
translations.idiomatic: On the jichou day provincial military commissioner Tong Guoyao was ordered to hold Xiangyang.

sentences.zh: 總兵吳之茂以四川叛，巡撫羅森、提督鄭蛟麟降之。

translations.literal: Regional commander Wu Zhimao rebelled in Sichuan; governors Luo Sen and provincial military commissioner Zheng Jiaolin surrendered to him.
translations.idiomatic: Regional commander Wu Zhimao rebelled in Sichuan; governor Luo Sen and military commissioner Zheng Jiaolin surrendered to him.

sentences.zh: 命總兵徐治都還守夷陵。

translations.literal: Ordered regional commander Xu Zhidu to return and hold Yiling.
translations.idiomatic: Regional commander Xu Zhidu was ordered back to defend Yiling.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，封世祖第七子隆禧為純親王。

translations.literal: Day gengyin: Shizu's seventh son Longxi was enfeoffed as Prince Chun.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengyin day the seventh son of Shizu, Longxi, was enfeoffed as Prince Chun.

sentences.zh: 以席卜臣為鎮西將軍，守西安。

translations.literal: Xibuchen was made Guard-the-West General to hold Xi'an.
translations.idiomatic: Xibuchen was appointed Guard-the-West General to hold Xi'an.

sentences.zh: 二月乙未朔，太皇太后頒內帑犒軍。

translations.literal: Second month, first day yimao: the Grand Empress Dowager distributed inner-palace funds to reward the troops.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the second month, the yimao day, the Grand Empress Dowager issued inner-palace funds to reward the armies.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，欽天監新造儀象成。

translations.literal: Day dingyou: the Astronomical Directorate's newly made armillary sphere and celestial globe were completed.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day the Astronomical Directorate completed its newly built armillary sphere and celestial globe.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，賊犯澧州，守卒以城叛，提督桑峨退荊州，陷常德。

translations.literal: Day renyin: rebels attacked Lizhou; the garrison betrayed the city; provincial military commissioner Sang E retreated to Jingzhou; Changde fell.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin day the rebels struck Lizhou; the garrison turned traitor and surrendered the city; military commissioner Sang E fell back to Jingzhou; and Changde was lost.

sentences.zh: 命鎮南將軍尼雅翰率師守武昌。

translations.literal: Ordered Guard-the-South General Niyaohan to lead troops to hold Wuchang.
translations.idiomatic: Guard-the-South General Niyaohan was ordered to lead a force to defend Wuchang.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，上御經筵。

translations.literal: Day guichou: the emperor attended the classics lecture.
translations.idiomatic: On the guichou day the emperor held the classics lecture.

sentences.zh: 以趙賴為貴州提督。

translations.literal: Zhao Lai was appointed Guizhou provincial military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Lai was made Guizhou military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，吳三桂陷長沙，副將黃正卿叛應之，旁陷衡州。

translations.literal: Day jiayin: Wu Sangui took Changsha; vice-commander Huang Zhengqing rebelled in support; Hengzhou fell nearby.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiayin day Wu Sangui captured Changsha; vice-commander Huang Zhengqing went over to him; and Hengzhou fell in the same thrust.

sentences.zh: 命都統覺羅朱滿守岳州，未至，岳州失。

translations.literal: Ordered commandant Aisin Gioro Zhumin to hold Yuezhou; before he arrived, Yuezhou was lost.
translations.idiomatic: Commandant Aisin Gioro Zhumin was ordered to hold Yuezhou, but before he arrived the city had already fallen.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，命刑部尚書莫洛加大學士銜，經略陝西。

translations.literal: Day xinyou: ordered Minister of Justice Moluo given Grand Academician rank to take charge of Shaanxi affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinyou day Minister of Justice Moluo was given the rank of Grand Academician and charged with overall direction of Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 孫延齡以廣西叛，殺都統王永年，執巡撫馬雄鎮幽之。

translations.literal: Sun Yanling rebelled in Guangxi, killed commandant Wang Yongnian, seized governor Ma Xiong, and imprisoned him.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Yanling rebelled in Guangxi, killed commandant Wang Yongnian, seized governor Ma Xiong, and held him in confinement.

sentences.zh: 三月乙丑，命整飭驛站，每四百里置一筆帖式，接遞軍報，探發塘報。

translations.literal: Third month, day yichou: ordered postal stations reorganized; every four hundred li a clerk posted to relay military reports and dispatch courier bulletins.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day of the third month the court ordered the postal system put in order: every four hundred li a clerk was posted to relay military reports and issue courier bulletins.

sentences.zh: 命左都御史多諾等軍前督餉。

translations.literal: Ordered Left Censor-in-Chief Duonuo and others to supervise supplies at the front.
translations.idiomatic: Left Censor-in-Chief Duonuo and others were ordered to supervise provisions at the front.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，吳三桂將犯夷陵，勒爾錦遣兵擊敗之。

translations.literal: Day wuchen: Wu Sangui was about to attack Yiling; Le'erjin sent troops and defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuchen day, as Wu Sangui was moving against Yiling, Le'erjin sent troops and defeated him.

sentences.zh: 庚午，以額駙華善為安南將軍，鎮京口。

translations.literal: Day gengwu: the imperial son-in-law Huashan was made Pacify-Annam General, garrisoning Jingkou.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengwu day the imperial son-in-law Huashan was appointed Pacify-Annam General and stationed at Jingkou.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，耿精忠反，執福建總督范承謨幽之，巡撫劉秉政降賊。

translations.literal: Day gengchen: Geng Jingzhong rebelled, seized Fujian governor Fan Chengmo and imprisoned him; governor Liu Bingzheng surrendered to the rebels.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengchen day Geng Jingzhong rebelled, seized Fujian governor Fan Chengmo and held him captive, while governor Liu Bingzheng went over to the rebels.

sentences.zh: 癸未，鄖陽副將洪福叛，提督佟國瑤擊敗之。

translations.literal: Day guimao: Xiangyang vice-commander Hong Fu rebelled; provincial military commissioner Tong Guoyao defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day Xiangyang vice-commander Hong Fu rebelled, and military commissioner Tong Guoyao defeated him.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，襄陽總兵楊來嘉以穀城叛。

translations.literal: Day renchen: Xiangyang regional commander Yang Laijia rebelled at Gucheng.
translations.idiomatic: On the renchen day Xiangyang regional commander Yang Laijia rebelled at Gucheng.

sentences.zh: 命希爾根為定南將軍，尚書哈爾哈齊副之。

translations.literal: Ordered Hilgen as Stabilize-the-South General, with Minister Ha'erhaqi as deputy.
translations.idiomatic: Hilgen was appointed Stabilize-the-South General, with Minister Ha'erhaqi as his deputy.

sentences.zh: 命舒恕、桑遏、根特、席布率師赴江西。

translations.literal: Ordered Shushu, Sange, Gent, and Xibu to lead armies to Jiangxi.
translations.idiomatic: Shushu, Sange, Gent, and Xibu were ordered to lead forces into Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 甲午，西安將軍瓦爾喀克陽平關。

translations.literal: Day jiawu: Xi'an garrison general Waerka seized Yangping Pass.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiawu day Xi'an garrison general Waerka took Yangping Pass.

sentences.zh: 夏四月癸卯，調西安副都統德業立守襄陽。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day guimao: transferred Xi'an vice commandant Deyeli to hold Xiangyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the guimao day, Xi'an vice commandant Deyeli was transferred to defend Xiangyang.

sentences.zh: 丁未，吳三桂子應熊、孫世霖伏誅。

translations.literal: Day dingwei: Wu Sangui's son Yingxiong and grandson Shilin were executed.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingwei day Wu Sangui's son Yingxiong and grandson Shilin were executed.

sentences.zh: 初，三桂倉卒起兵，而名義不揚，中悔。

translations.literal: Earlier, Sangui had risen in haste and his cause lacked clear legitimacy; he came to regret it midway.
translations.idiomatic: At first Sangui had risen in haste without a clear righteous cause, and halfway through he began to regret the venture.

sentences.zh: 至澧州，頗前卻。

translations.literal: Reaching Lizhou, he advanced and retreated by turns.
translations.idiomatic: When he reached Lizhou his army wavered, advancing one day and pulling back the next.

sentences.zh: 至是，方食聞報，驚曰：「上少年乃能是耶？

translations.literal: At this point, while eating he heard the report and exclaimed in alarm: "The emperor is so young— and he can do this?
translations.idiomatic: Now, as he was at table, he heard the news and cried out in alarm, "The emperor is still a youth— and he can act like this?

sentences.zh: 事決矣！

translations.literal: The affair is decided!
translations.idiomatic: The matter is settled!

sentences.zh: 」推食而起。

translations.literal: " He pushed aside his bowl and rose.
translations.idiomatic: " He pushed away his food and stood up.

sentences.zh: 詔削孫延齡職。

translations.literal: An edict stripped Sun Yanling of his office.
translations.idiomatic: An edict removed Sun Yanling from office.

sentences.zh: 以阿密達為揚威將軍，駐江寧，賴塔為平南將軍，赴杭州。

translations.literal: Amitai was made Awesome Pacification General and stationed at Jiangning; Laita was made Southern Pacification General and sent to Hangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Amitai was appointed Pacification Commissioner and posted at Jiangning, while Laita was named Southern Pacification General and sent to Hangzhou.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，潮州總兵劉進忠以城叛。

translations.literal: On jiayin, Chao Zhou circuit commander Liu Jinzhong rebelled with the city.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day Liu Jinzhong, commander of Chaozhou, turned the city over to the rebels.

sentences.zh: 戊午，以根特為平寇將軍，赴廣西討孫延齡。

translations.literal: On wuwu, Gent was made Bandit-Suppression General and sent to Guangxi to attack Sun Yanling.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day Gent was made Bandit-Suppression General and dispatched to Guangxi against Sun Yanling.

sentences.zh: 河北總兵蔡祿謀叛，命阿密達襲誅之。

translations.literal: Hebei circuit commander Cai Lu plotted rebellion; Amitai was ordered to surprise and execute him.
translations.idiomatic: When Hebei commander Cai Lu plotted rebellion, the court ordered Amitai to take him by surprise and put him to death.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，詔削耿精忠爵。

translations.literal: On xinyou, an edict stripped Geng Jingzhong of his rank.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day an edict stripped Geng Jingzhong of his noble rank.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，詔以分調禁旅遣將分防情形寄示平南王尚可喜。

translations.literal: On guihai, an edict sent to Southern Pacification King Shang Kexi a memorandum on the situation of dispatching the Eight Banners guards in detachments and generals to garrison separate posts.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day the throne sent Shang Kexi, Prince of Southern Pacification, a briefing on how the Eight Banners guards and field generals were being split up and posted to separate garrisons.

sentences.zh: 五月丙寅，皇子胤礽生，皇后赫舍里氏崩。

translations.literal: Fifth month, bingyin: Prince Yinreng was born; Empress Heseri died.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on bingyin day, Prince Yinreng was born and Empress Heseri died.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，安西將軍赫業等敗吳之茂於劄閣堡，復朝天關。

translations.literal: On wuyin, Pacification-of-the-West General He Ye and others defeated Wu Zhimao at Zhage Fort and recovered Chaotian Pass.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day He Ye, Western Pacification General, defeated Wu Zhimao at Zhage Fort and retook Chaotian Pass.

sentences.zh: 壬午，浙江平陽兵變，執總兵蔡朝佐，應耿精忠將曾養性，圍瑞安。

translations.literal: On renwu, Pingyang troops mutinied in Zhejiang, seized circuit commander Cai Chaozuo, joined Geng Jingzhong's general Zeng Yangxing, and besieged Ruian.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day the Pingyang garrison mutinied in Zhejiang, seized Commander Cai Chaozuo, rallied to Geng Jingzhong's officer Zeng Yangxing, and laid siege to Ruian.

sentences.zh: 命賴塔進兵討之。

translations.literal: Laita was ordered to advance and suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: Laita was ordered to march out and suppress them.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，副都統德業立敗洪福於武當。

translations.literal: On renchen, Vice Commander-in-Chief Deyeli defeated Hong Fu at Wudang.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day Vice Commander Deyeli defeated Hong Fu at Wudang.

sentences.zh: 六月丙午，命貝勒尚善為安遠靖寇大將軍，率師赴岳州，貝子准達赴荊州。

translations.literal: Sixth month, bingwu: Prince Shangshan was appointed Grand General for Pacifying the Distant and Suppressing Bandits and led troops to Yuezhou; Prince's son Zhunda went to Jingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on bingwu day, Prince Shangshan was made Grand General for Distant Pacification and Bandit Suppression and led an army to Yuezhou, while the prince's son Zhunda went to Jingzhou.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，總兵祖弘勛以溫州叛。

translations.literal: On gengxu, circuit commander Zu Hongxun rebelled at Wenzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day Commander Zu Hongxun rebelled at Wenzhou.

sentences.zh: 金華副將牟大寅敗耿精忠將於常山。

translations.literal: Jinhua deputy commander Mou Dayin defeated Geng Jingzhong's general at Changshan.
translations.idiomatic: Jinhua Deputy Commander Mou Dayin defeated a general of Geng Jingzhong at Changshan.

sentences.zh: 壬子，命將軍喇哈達守杭州。

translations.literal: On renzi, General Lahada was ordered to defend Hangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day General Lahada was ordered to hold Hangzhou.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，命康親王傑書為奉命大將軍赴浙江，貝勒洞鄂為定西大將軍赴四川。

translations.literal: On yimao, Prince Kang Jieshu was appointed Grand General by Imperial Command and sent to Zhejiang; Prince Dong'e was appointed Western Pacification Grand General and sent to Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day Prince Kang Jieshu was commissioned grand general and sent to Zhejiang, and Prince Dong'e was made Western Pacification Grand General for Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 浙江溫州、黃岩、太平諸營相繼叛。

translations.literal: Garrisons at Wenzhou, Huangyan, and Taiping in Zhejiang rebelled in succession.
translations.idiomatic: The Wenzhou, Huangyan, and Taiping garrisons in Zhejiang rose in succession.

sentences.zh: 命喇哈達守台、寧。

translations.literal: Lahada was ordered to hold Taizhou and Ningbo.
translations.idiomatic: Lahada was ordered to defend Taizhou and Ningbo.

sentences.zh: 七月辛未，以郎廷佐為福建總督，段應舉為提督。

translations.literal: Seventh month, xinwei: Lang Tingzuo was made Fujian governor; Duan Yingju was made provincial commander.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on xinwei day, Lang Tingzuo was appointed governor of Fujian and Duan Yingju provincial military commander.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，賴塔敗耿精忠將於金華。

translations.literal: On guiyou, Laita defeated Geng Jingzhong's general at Jinhua.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day Laita defeated a general of Geng Jingzhong at Jinhua.

sentences.zh: 是時精忠遣其大將馬九玉、曾養性犯浙江，白顯忠犯江西，所至土匪蜂應，江西尤甚。

translations.literal: At this time Jingzhong sent his great generals Ma Jiuyu and Zeng Yangxing to invade Zhejiang, Bai Xianzhong to invade Jiangxi; everywhere local bandits rose in response — Jiangxi was especially severe.
translations.idiomatic: Jingzhong then sent his chief generals Ma Jiuyu and Zeng Yangxing against Zhejiang and Bai Xianzhong against Jiangxi; local bandits answered them everywhere, above all in Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 南瑞總兵楊富應賊，董衛國誅之。

translations.literal: Nanrui circuit commander Yang Fu joined the rebels; Dong Weiguo executed him.
translations.idiomatic: Nanrui Commander Yang Fu went over to the rebels, and Dong Weiguo had him executed.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，貝勒察尼大戰賊將吳應麒於岳州七里山，敗之。

translations.literal: On dinghai, Prince Chani fought a great battle with the rebel general Wu Yingqi at Qilishan in Yuezhou and defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day Prince Chani fought a major battle with the rebel general Wu Yingqi at Qilishan in Yuezhou and routed him.

sentences.zh: 八月壬寅，平寇將軍根特卒于軍，以哈爾哈齊代之。

translations.literal: Eighth month, renyin: Bandit-Suppression General Gent died in camp; Harhaqi replaced him.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on renyin day, Bandit-Suppression General Gent died in the field and Harhaqi succeeded him.

sentences.zh: 海澄公黃梧卒，子芳度襲爵，守漳州。

translations.literal: Marquis of Haicheng Huang Wu died; his son Fangdu inherited the title and held Zhangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Huang Wu, Marquis of Haicheng, died; his son Fangdu inherited the title and held Zhangzhou.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，金光祖報孫延齡陷梧州，督兵復之。

translations.literal: On yisi, Jin Guangzu reported that Sun Yanling had taken Wuzhou; he led troops to recover it.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day Jin Guangzu reported that Sun Yanling had seized Wuzhou and that he was leading troops to recover it.

sentences.zh: 丙午，上幸南苑。

translations.literal: On bingwu, the Emperor visited the Southern Park.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day the Emperor visited the Southern Park.

sentences.zh: 九月壬戌，上御經筵，命每日進講如常。

translations.literal: Ninth month, renxu: the Emperor attended the Classics Lecture Hall and ordered daily lectures to continue as usual.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on renxu day, the Emperor presided at the lecture hall and ordered the daily expositions to continue without interruption.

sentences.zh: 耿精忠將以土寇陷清谿、徽州，江寧將軍額楚、統領巴爾堪擊走之，連戰入江西，復樂平等縣。

translations.literal: Geng Jingzhong's generals, with local bandits, took Qingxi and Huizhou; Jiangning General Echu and commander Barkan drove them off, fought their way into Jiangxi, and recovered Leping and other counties.
translations.idiomatic: Geng Jingzhong's officers, aided by local bandits, seized Qingxi and Huizhou; Jiangning General Echu and Commander Barkan beat them back, pressed into Jiangxi, and recovered Leping and other counties.

sentences.zh: 命碩塔等駐安慶。

translations.literal: Shuota and others were ordered to station at Anqing.
translations.idiomatic: Shuota and others were ordered to encamp at Anqing.

sentences.zh: 辛未，麻城土寇鄒君升等作亂，知府于成龍討平之。

translations.literal: On xinwei, Maicheng bandits Zou Junsheng and others rose; prefect Yu Chenglong suppressed them.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day the Maicheng bandits Zou Junsheng and others rebelled, and Prefect Yu Chenglong put them down.

sentences.zh: 命簡親王喇布為揚威大將軍，率師赴江西，侍衛坤為振武將軍副之。

translations.literal: Prince Jian Labu was made Awesome Pacification Grand General and led troops to Jiangxi; guard Kun was made assistant Suppression General.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Jian Labu was made Awesome Pacification Grand General and marched to Jiangxi, with the guardsman Kun as his deputy Suppression General.

sentences.zh: 廣西提督馬雄叛，命安親王岳樂為定遠平寇大將軍，率師赴廣東，宗室瓦山、覺羅畫特副之。

translations.literal: Guangxi Provincial Commander Ma Xiong rebelled; Prince An Yuele was made Grand General for Pacifying the Far and Suppressing Bandits and led troops to Guangdong; imperial clansmen Waešan and Huat'e were his deputies.
translations.idiomatic: Guangxi Commander Ma Xiong rebelled; Prince An Yuele was made Grand General for Distant Pacification and Bandit Suppression and led an army to Guangdong, with the imperial clansmen Waešan and Huat'e as his deputies.

sentences.zh: 冬十月壬辰，喇布師行。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, renchen: Labu's army marched.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on renchen day, Labu's army took the field.

sentences.zh: 丙申，岳樂師行。

translations.literal: On bingchen, Yuele's army marched.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day Yuele's army marched out.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，上奉太皇太后幸南苑。

translations.literal: On renyin, the Emperor accompanied the Grand Empress Dowager to the Southern Park.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day the Emperor escorted the Grand Empress Dowager to the Southern Park.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，還宮。

translations.literal: On xinhai, he returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day he returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 十一月庚申朔，莫洛報吳之茂兵入朝天關，饟路中阻，洞鄂退守西安。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, gengshen new moon: Moluo reported Wu Zhimao's troops had entered Chaotian Pass, supply routes were blocked midway, and Dong'e retreated to guard Xi'an.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengshen new moon of the eleventh month, Moluo reported that Wu Zhimao's force had entered Chaotian Pass, that supply lines were cut in mid-course, and that Dong'e had fallen back to defend Xi'an.

sentences.zh: 命移西安軍守漢中，河南軍守西安。

translations.literal: Orders were issued to shift the Xi'an army to defend Hanzhong and the Henan army to defend Xi'an.
translations.idiomatic: Orders went out to move the Xi'an army to Hanzhong and the Henan army to Xi'an.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚寅朔，傑書大敗曾養性於衢州，又敗之於台州。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, gengyin new moon: Jieshu inflicted a great defeat on Zeng Yangxing at Quzhou, and again at Taizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengyin new moon of the twelfth month Jieshu routed Zeng Yangxing at Quzhou and defeated him again at Taizhou.

sentences.zh: 王輔臣叛，經略莫洛死之。

translations.literal: Wang Fuchen rebelled; Commissioner-in-Chief Moluo died in his service.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Fuchen rebelled, and Commissioner Moluo died in the field.

sentences.zh: 上議親征。

translations.literal: The Emperor deliberated a personal campaign.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor considered taking the field in person.

sentences.zh: 王大臣以京師根本重地，太皇太后年高，力諫乃止。

translations.literal: Senior ministers, citing the capital as the fundamental base and the Grand Empress Dowager's advanced age, strenuously remonstrated until he desisted.
translations.idiomatic: Senior ministers urged that the capital was the root of the realm and that the Grand Empress Dowager was advanced in years; they remonstrated so forcefully that he abandoned the plan.

sentences.zh: 徵盛京兵、蒙古兵分詣軍前。

translations.literal: Shenyang and Mongol troops were summoned and sent separately to the fronts.
translations.idiomatic: Troops from Mukden and Mongolia were called up and dispatched to the various fronts.

sentences.zh: 丁未，命尚可喜節制廣東軍事。

translations.literal: On dingwei, Shang Kexi was ordered to coordinate Guangdong military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day Shang Kexi was placed in overall command of Guangdong military affairs.

sentences.zh: 戊午，祫祭太廟。

translations.literal: On wuwu, joint worship at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day the court performed joint sacrifice at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 是歲，免直隸、江南、山東、河南、陝西等省七十八州縣災賦有差。

translations.literal: That year, land-tax relief for disaster areas was granted at graded rates to seventy-eight prefectures and counties in Zhili, Jiangnan, Shandong, Henan, Shaanxi, and other provinces.
translations.idiomatic: That year graded remission of disaster land tax was granted in seventy-eight prefectures and counties of Zhili, Jiangnan, Shandong, Henan, Shaanxi, and other provinces.

sentences.zh: 朝鮮、琉球入貢。

translations.literal: Korea and Ryukyu sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Korea and Ryukyu presented tribute.

sentences.zh: 十四年乙卯春正月辛酉，尚可喜報賊犯連州，官兵擊敗之。

translations.literal: Fourteenth year, yimao, spring, first month, xinyou: Shang Kexi reported rebels attacking Lianzhou; government troops defeated them.
