translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year, yimao, on xinyou day in the first month of spring, Shang Kexi reported rebels attacking Lianzhou; government troops beat them off.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，晉封尚可喜平南親王，命其子之孝佩大將軍印討賊。

translations.literal: On wuchen, Shang Kexi was promoted to Prince of Southern Pacification; his son Zhixiao was granted the Great General's seal to suppress the rebels.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day Shang Kexi was advanced to Prince of Southern Pacification, and his son Zhixiao was given the great general's seal to campaign against the rebels.

sentences.zh: 二月癸巳，下詔切責貝勒洞鄂退縮失機，飭令速定平涼、秦州以通棧道。

translations.literal: Second month, guisi: an edict sternly rebuked Prince Dong'e for shrinking back and missing his chance, ordering him to speedily secure Pingliang and Qinzhou to open the plank road.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on guisi day, an edict sharply rebuked Prince Dong'e for hanging back and losing his moment, and ordered him to secure Pingliang and Qinzhou at once and reopen the plank road.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，康親王傑書遣兵復處州，進復仙居。

translations.literal: On yisi, Prince Kang Jieshu sent troops to recover Chuzhou and advanced to recover Xianju.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day Prince Kang Jieshu sent troops to retake Chuzhou and pressed on to recover Xianju.

sentences.zh: 王輔臣陷蘭州。

translations.literal: Wang Fuchen took Lanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Fuchen seized Lanzhou.

sentences.zh: 西寧總兵王進寶大戰於新城，圍蘭州。

translations.literal: Xining circuit commander Wang Jinbao fought a great battle at Xincheng and besieged Lanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Xining Commander Wang Jinbao fought a great battle at Xincheng and laid siege to Lanzhou.

sentences.zh: 洞鄂復隴州關山關。

translations.literal: Dong'e recovered Longzhou and the Guanshan Pass.
translations.idiomatic: Dong'e recovered Longzhou and Guanshan Pass.

sentences.zh: 三月己未朔，叛將楊來嘉犯南漳，總兵劉成龍擊走之。

translations.literal: Third month, jiwei new moon: rebel general Yang Laijia attacked Nanzhang; circuit commander Liu Chenglong drove him off.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiwei new moon of the third month the rebel general Yang Laijia attacked Nanzhang, and Commander Liu Chenglong repulsed him.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，饒州賊犯祁門，巡檢張行健被執不屈，死之。

translations.literal: On wuchen, raiders at Raozhou attacked Qimen; inspector Zhang Xingjian was seized but would not submit and died.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day bandits from Raozhou struck Qimen; Inspector Zhang Xingjian was captured, refused to yield, and was killed.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，命張勇為靖逆將軍，會總兵孫思克等討王輔臣。

translations.literal: On dingchou, Zhang Yong was made Pacification-of-Rebellion General and joined circuit commanders Sun Sike and others to attack Wang Fuchen.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day Zhang Yong was made Rebellion-Pacification General and joined Commanders Sun Sike and others in the campaign against Wang Fuchen.

sentences.zh: 賊陷定邊城，命提督陳福駐寧夏討賊。

translations.literal: Rebels took Dingbian Fort; Provincial Commander Chen Fu was ordered to station at Ningxia to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels seized Dingbian; Commander Chen Fu was ordered to encamp at Ningxia and suppress them.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，蒙古布爾尼反，命信郡王鄂扎為撫遠大將軍，大學士圖海為副將軍，討平之。

translations.literal: On dinghai, the Mongol Burni rebelled; Prince Xin Ezha was made Grand General for Pacifying the Distance, Grand Secretary Tu Hai was made deputy general, and they suppressed him.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day the Mongol Burni rose; Prince Xin Ezha was made Grand General for Distant Pacification, with Grand Secretary Tu Hai as deputy, and they put the revolt down.

sentences.zh: 戊子，以熊賜履為大學士。

translations.literal: On wuzi, Xiong Cifu was made Grand Secretary.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day Xiong Cifu was appointed grand secretary.

sentences.zh: 夏四月己丑，以勒德洪為戶部尚書。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, jichou: Le Dehong was made Minister of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on jichou day, Le Dehong was made Minister of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 署護軍統領郎肅等剿耿寇於五桂寨，斬級二萬，復餘干。

translations.literal: Acting guard commander Lang Su and others destroyed Geng bandits at Wugui Stockade, took twenty thousand heads, and recovered Yugan.
translations.idiomatic: Acting guard commander Lang Su and others routed Geng's forces at Wugui Stockade, took twenty thousand heads, and recovered Yugan.

sentences.zh: 乙未，封張勇靖逆侯，王進寶一等男。

translations.literal: On yiwei, Zhang Yong was enfeoffed Marquis of Pacifying Rebellion, Wang Jinbao was made Baron of the First Rank.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day Zhang Yong was enfeoffed as Marquis Who Pacifies Rebellion, and Wang Jinbao was made a baron of the first rank.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，以左都督許貞鎮撫州、建昌、廣信。

translations.literal: On wuxu, Left Captain Xu Zhen was ordered to pacify Fuzhou, Jianchang, and Guangxin.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day Left Captain Xu Zhen was ordered to pacify Fuzhou, Jianchang, and Guangxin.

sentences.zh: 戊申，王輔臣遣兵援秦州，官兵迎擊敗之。

translations.literal: On wushen, Wang Fuchen sent troops to relieve Qinzhou; government troops met and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day Wang Fuchen sent a relief force toward Qinzhou; government troops intercepted and defeated it.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，上諭：「侍臣進講，朕乃覆講，互相討論，庶有發明。

translations.literal: On xinhai, the Emperor instructed: "When attendant ministers lecture, I then lecture in return; we discuss back and forth, so that insights may emerge."
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day the Emperor said: "When my attendants lecture, I lecture again in reply; we debate back and forth so that something may truly be learned."

sentences.zh: 」癸丑，王進寶復臨洮，孫思克復靖遠。

translations.literal: [Closing quotation mark] On guichou, Wang Jinbao recovered Lintao, and Sun Sike recovered Jingyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day Wang Jinbao retook Lintao and Sun Sike retook Jingyuan.

sentences.zh: 戊午，紹興知府許弘勛招撫降眾五萬人。

translations.literal: On wuwu, Shaoxing prefect Xu Hongxun induced fifty thousand surrenderers to submit.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day Shaoxing Prefect Xu Hongxun induced fifty thousand who had surrendered to submit.

sentences.zh: 五月庚午，察哈爾左翼四旗來歸。

translations.literal: Fifth month, gengwu: four banners of the Chahar Left Wing came over in submission.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on gengwu day, four banners of the Chahar Left Wing came in submission.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，命畢力克圖援榆林。

translations.literal: On gengchen, Biliketu was ordered to relieve Yulin.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day Biliketu was ordered to relieve Yulin.

sentences.zh: 王輔臣兵陷延安、綏德。

translations.literal: Wang Fuchen's troops took Yan'an and Suide.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Fuchen's army seized Yan'an and Suide.

sentences.zh: 甲申，張勇復洮、河二州。

translations.literal: On jiashen, Zhang Yong recovered Tao and He prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day Zhang Yong recovered Tao and He prefectures.

sentences.zh: 閏五月癸巳，上幸玉泉山觀禾。

translations.literal: Intercalary fifth month, guisi: the Emperor visited Yuquan Mountain to view the grain.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary fifth month, on guisi day, the Emperor went to Yuquan Mountain to inspect the crops.

sentences.zh: 楊來嘉、洪福陷穀城。

translations.literal: Yang Laijia and Hong Fu took Gucheng.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Laijia and Hong Fu seized Gucheng.

sentences.zh: 斬守城不力之副將馬郎阿以徇，削總兵金世需職，隨軍效力。

translations.literal: Deputy general Ma Lang'a, who had failed to hold the city, was executed as a warning; circuit commander Jin Shixu was stripped of office and ordered to serve with the army.
translations.idiomatic: Deputy Commander Ma Lang'a, who had failed to hold the city, was executed as an example; Commander Jin Shixu was dismissed and ordered to redeem himself in the ranks.

sentences.zh: 壬子，額楚復廣信。

translations.literal: On renzi, Echu recovered Guangxin.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day Echu recovered Guangxin.

sentences.zh: 樂平土寇復陷饒州，將軍希爾根擊之，復饒州。

translations.literal: Bandits at Leping again took Raozhou; General Hiergeen attacked them and recovered Raozhou.
translations.idiomatic: Leping bandits again seized Raozhou; General Hiergeen attacked them and retook the city.

sentences.zh: 六月，畢力克圖復吳堡，復綏德。

translations.literal: Sixth month: Biliketu recovered Wubao and Suide.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Biliketu recovered Wubao and Suide.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，命將軍舒恕援廣東。

translations.literal: On dingchou, General Shushu was ordered to relieve Guangdong.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day General Shushu was ordered to relieve Guangdong.

sentences.zh: 己卯，命振武將軍佛尼勒開棧道援漢中。

translations.literal: On jimao, Suppression General Fonile was ordered to open the plank road and relieve Hanzhong.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day Suppression General Fonile was ordered to reopen the plank road and relieve Hanzhong.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，上幸南苑行圍。

translations.literal: On gengchen, the Emperor visited the Southern Park for the hunting enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day the Emperor went to the Southern Park for the hunting enclosure.

sentences.zh: 壬午，張勇攻鞏昌。

translations.literal: On renwu, Zhang Yong attacked Gongchang.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day Zhang Yong attacked Gongchang.

sentences.zh: 江西官軍攻石峽，失利，副都統雅賴戰死。

translations.literal: Jiangxi government troops attacked Shixia, met defeat; Vice Commander-in-Chief Yalai died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangxi government troops attacked Shixia, were defeated, and Vice Commander Yalai fell in battle.

sentences.zh: 甲申，克蘭州。

translations.literal: On jiashen, Lanzhou was taken.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day Lanzhou was captured.

sentences.zh: 畢力克圖復延安。

translations.literal: Biliketu recovered Yan'an.
translations.idiomatic: Biliketu recovered Yan'an.

sentences.zh: 以軍興停陝西、湖廣鄉試。

translations.literal: Provincial examinations in Shaanxi and Huguang were suspended because of the military campaigns.
translations.idiomatic: The provincial examinations in Shaanxi and Huguang were suspended on account of the war.

sentences.zh: 七月乙巳，陳福剿定邊，斬賊將朱龍。

translations.literal: Seventh month, yisi: Chen Fu suppressed Dingbian and beheaded the rebel general Zhu Long.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on yisi day, Chen Fu suppressed Dingbian and beheaded the rebel general Zhu Long.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，江西官兵復浮梁、樂平、宜黃、崇仁、樂安諸縣。

translations.literal: On gengxu, Jiangxi government troops recovered Fuliang, Leping, Yihuang, Chongren, and Le'an counties.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day Jiangxi government troops recovered Fuliang, Leping, Yihuang, Chongren, Le'an, and other counties.

sentences.zh: 八月戊午，上幸南苑行圍。

translations.literal: Eighth month, wuwu: the Emperor visited the Southern Park for the hunting enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on wuwu day, the Emperor went to the Southern Park for the hunting enclosure.

sentences.zh: 洞鄂、畢力克圖、阿密達會攻王輔臣，斬賊將郝天祥。

translations.literal: Dong'e, Biliketu, and Amitai jointly attacked Wang Fuchen and beheaded the rebel general Hao Tianxiang.
translations.idiomatic: Dong'e, Biliketu, and Amitai jointly attacked Wang Fuchen and beheaded the rebel general Hao Tianxiang.

sentences.zh: 傅喇塔復黃岩。

translations.literal: Fulata recovered Huangyan.
translations.idiomatic: Fulata recovered Huangyan.

sentences.zh: 壬申，上奉太皇太后幸湯泉。

translations.literal: On renshen, the Emperor, accompanying the Grand Empress Dowager, visited the hot springs.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day the Emperor escorted the Grand Empress Dowager to the hot springs.

sentences.zh: 甲申，上還京，御經筵。

translations.literal: On jiashen, the Emperor returned to the capital and attended the Classics Lecture Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day the Emperor returned to the capital and resumed the lecture hall.

sentences.zh: 九月，上次昌平，詣明陵，致奠長陵，遣官分奠諸陵。

translations.literal: Ninth month: the Emperor went to Changping, visited the Ming tombs, offered sacrifices at Changling, and sent officials to sacrifice at the other tombs in turn.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month the Emperor went to Changping, visited the Ming imperial tombs, sacrificed at Changling, and dispatched officers to offer sacrifice at the other tombs in turn.

sentences.zh: 丙申，上奉太皇太后還宮。

translations.literal: On bingchen, the Emperor, accompanying the Grand Empress Dowager, returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day the Emperor escorted the Grand Empress Dowager back to the palace.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，詔每歲正月停刑，著為令。

translations.literal: On xinchou, an edict ordered executions to be suspended every year in the first month, establishing this as a statute.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day an edict ordered that executions be suspended each year in the first month, and made this a standing rule.

sentences.zh: 冬十月癸亥，康親王兵復太平、樂清諸縣。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, guihai: Prince Kang's army recovered Taiping, Leqing, and other counties.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on guihai day, Prince Kang's army recovered Taiping, Leqing, and other counties.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，上謁孝陵。

translations.literal: On bingyin, the Emperor visited Xiaoling.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day the Emperor visited Xiaoling.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，祭孝陵。

translations.literal: On the wuchen day, sacrifices were offered at Xiaoling.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuchen day, the Emperor offered sacrifice at the Xiaoling Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，還宮。

translations.literal: On the yihai day, he returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On the yihai day, he returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 陳福及王輔臣戰於固原，不利，副將太必圖戰沒。

translations.literal: Chen Fu fought Wang Fuchen at Guyuan with an unfavorable outcome; Vice-General Taibitu died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Fu engaged Wang Fuchen at Guyuan without success; Vice-General Taibitu was killed in action.

sentences.zh: 論平布爾尼功，封賞有差，及助順蒙古王貝勒沙津以次各晉爵，罰助逆奈曼等部。

translations.literal: Merit in pacifying Burni was assessed; enfeoffments and rewards were graded; Mongol princes and beiles who aided submission, including Shajin in order, were each advanced in rank; tribes such as Naiman that aided rebellion were punished.
translations.idiomatic: Rewards for pacifying Burni were apportioned by merit; Mongol princes and beiles who had aided submission, beginning with Shajin, were promoted in rank, while tribes such as the Naiman that had aided rebellion were penalized.

sentences.zh: 十一月癸巳，貝勒察尼復興山。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the guisi day, Beile Chani recovered Xingshan.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the guisi day, Beile Chani recovered Xingshan.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，復設詹事府官。

translations.literal: On the dingyou day, the offices of the Household of the Heir Apparent were restored.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day, the offices of the Household of the Heir Apparent were reinstated.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，叛將馬雄糾吳三桂兵犯高州，連陷廉州。

translations.literal: On the renyin day, the rebel Ma Xiong gathered Wu Sangui's troops to attack Gaozhou and in succession seized Lianzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin day, the rebel Ma Xiong, rallying Wu Sangui's forces, attacked Gaozhou and then took Lianzhou in succession.

sentences.zh: 命簡親王喇布自江西援廣東。

translations.literal: Prince Jian Labu was ordered to aid Guangdong from Jiangxi.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Jian Labu was ordered to march from Jiangxi to relieve Guangdong.

sentences.zh: 是月，鄭錦攻陷漳州，海澄公黃芳度死之，戕其家。

translations.literal: That month Zheng Jing captured Zhangzhou; Duke of Haicheng Huang Fangdu died, and his household was slaughtered.
translations.idiomatic: That month Zheng Jing captured Zhangzhou; Huang Fangdu, Duke of Haicheng, was killed, and his entire family was put to death.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙寅，立皇子胤礽為皇太子，頒詔中外，加恩肆赦。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the bingyin day, the Prince Yinreng was established as Crown Prince; an edict was promulgated at home and abroad, grace was extended, and a general amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the bingyin day, Prince Yinreng was invested as Crown Prince; an edict was issued throughout the realm, favors were granted, and a general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，以勒爾錦師久無功，奪其參贊巴爾布以下職。

translations.literal: On the yihai day, because Le'erjin's army had long been without achievement, his Deputy Counselor Balbu and those below were stripped of office.
translations.idiomatic: On the yihai day, because Le'erjin's army had long achieved nothing, his deputy counselor Balbu and the officers under him were dismissed from their posts.

sentences.zh: 寧夏兵變，提督陳福死之。

translations.literal: The Ningxia troops mutinied; Grand Coordinator Chen Fu died.
translations.idiomatic: The garrison at Ningxia mutinied, and Grand Coordinator Chen Fu was killed.

sentences.zh: 壬午，祫祭太廟。

translations.literal: On the renwu day, a collective offering was performed at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On the renwu day, the collective seasonal offering was performed in the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 是歲，免湖廣、河南七府五州縣災賦有差。

translations.literal: That year land tax from disaster-stricken areas in seven prefectures and five subprefectures and counties of Huguang and Henan was remitted in varying amounts.
translations.idiomatic: That year, disaster land taxes were remitted, in varying degrees, for seven prefectures and five subprefectures and counties in Huguang and Henan.

sentences.zh: 朝鮮入貢。

translations.literal: Korea sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Korea presented tribute.

sentences.zh: 十五年丙辰春正月丁亥，以王進寶為陝西提督，駐秦州。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year, bingchen, first month of spring, on the dinghai day, Wang Jinbao was made Grand Coordinator of Shaanxi, stationed at Qinzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year (1676), spring, first month, on the dinghai day, Wang Jinbao was appointed Grand Coordinator of Shaanxi and stationed at Qinzhou.

sentences.zh: 甲午，以建儲恭上太皇太后、皇太后徽號。

translations.literal: On the jiawu day, because of the establishment of the heir, honorific titles were respectfully presented to the Grand Empress Dowager and the Empress Dowager.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiawu day, in celebration of the heir's investiture, honorific titles were presented to the Grand Empress Dowager and the Empress Dowager.

sentences.zh: 乙未，升寧夏總兵官為提督，以趙良棟為之。

translations.literal: On the yiwei day, the Ningxia regional commander was promoted to Grand Coordinator; Zhao Liangdong was appointed to the post.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiwei day, the Ningxia regional commander was elevated to grand coordinator, with Zhao Liangdong appointed to the office.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，上幸南苑行圍。

translations.literal: On the xinchou day, the Emperor proceeded to the Southern Park for the hunt.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinchou day, the Emperor went to the Southern Park for a hunting encampment.

sentences.zh: 二月丁巳，詔軍中克城禁殺掠。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the dingsi day, an edict forbade killing and plunder when cities were taken in the army.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the dingsi day, an edict forbade killing and looting when army units captured cities.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，命大學士圖海為撫遠大將軍，統轄全秦，自貝勒洞鄂以下咸受節制。

translations.literal: On the renxu day, Grand Secretary Tu Hai was made Pacification Commissioner General of the Far Reaches, commanding all Shaanxi; from Beile Dong'e downward all were placed under his command.
translations.idiomatic: On the renxu day, Grand Secretary Tu Hai was appointed Pacification Commissioner General of the Far Reaches with overall command of Shaanxi; from Beile Dong'e downward, all forces were placed under his authority.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，上如鞏華城，諭扈從勿踐春田。

translations.literal: On the guiyou day, the Emperor went to Gonghua City and instructed the entourage not to trample the spring fields.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiyou day, the Emperor went to Gonghua City and ordered those in attendance not to tread upon the spring planting.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，吳三桂將高大傑陷吉安。

translations.literal: On the yihai day, Wu Sangui's general Gao Dajie captured Ji'an.
translations.idiomatic: On the yihai day, Gao Dajie, a general of Wu Sangui, captured Ji'an.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，安親王岳樂擊三桂將於萍鄉，敗之，復萍鄉。

translations.literal: On the wuyin day, Prince An Yuele attacked Wu Sangui's generals at Pingxiang, defeated them, and recovered Pingxiang.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuyin day, Prince An Yuele routed Wu Sangui's generals at Pingxiang and recovered the city.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，上御經筵。

translations.literal: On the xinsi day, the Emperor attended the Classics Lecture.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinsi day, the Emperor presided over the Classics Lecture.

sentences.zh: 贈死事副將張國彥太子太保，予世職。

translations.literal: Vice-General Zhang Guoyan, who died in service, was posthumously enfeoffed as Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent and granted a hereditary office.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Guoyan, the vice-general who had died in service, was posthumously enfeoffed as Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent and his family was granted a hereditary stipend.

sentences.zh: 三月癸未，贈海澄公黃芳度郡王。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the guiwei day, Duke of Haicheng Huang Fangdu was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of a Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the guiwei day, Huang Fangdu, Duke of Haicheng, was posthumously created a commandery prince.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，王進寶、佛尼勒大敗吳之茂於北山。

translations.literal: On the bingxu day, Wang Jinbao and Foni'le greatly defeated Wu Zhimao at Beishan.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingxu day, Wang Jinbao and Foni'le won a great victory over Wu Zhimao at Beishan.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，傅喇塔圍溫州，曾養性、祖弘勛悉眾來犯，副都統紀爾他布擊走之。

translations.literal: On the gengyin day, Fulata besieged Wenzhou; Zeng Yangxing and Zu Hongxun led all their forces to attack; Vice Commander-in-Chief Ji'ertaibu drove them off.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengyin day, Fulata besieged Wenzhou; Zeng Yangxing and Zu Hongxun marched out with their full strength, but Vice Commander-in-Chief Ji'ertaibu repulsed them.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，岳州水師克君山。

translations.literal: On the xinmao day, the Yuezhou naval force captured Junshan.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinmao day, the Yuezhou flotilla captured Junshan.

sentences.zh: 庚子，勒爾錦渡江與三桂之眾戰，迭敗之。

translations.literal: On the gengzi day, Le'erjin crossed the river and fought Wu Sangui's forces, repeatedly defeating them.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengzi day, Le'erjin crossed the Yangzi and repeatedly defeated Wu Sangui's armies.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，賜彭定求等二百九人進士及第出身有差。

translations.literal: On the yisi day, Peng Dingqiu and two hundred nine others were granted jinshi degrees and appointments in varying ranks.
translations.idiomatic: On the yisi day, Peng Dingqiu and 208 others received jinshi degrees and court appointments according to rank.

sentences.zh: 己酉，勒爾錦與三桂之眾戰於太平街，不利，退守荊州。

translations.literal: On the jiyou day, Le'erjin fought Wu Sangui's forces at Taiping Street with an unfavorable outcome and withdrew to defend Jingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiyou day, Le'erjin engaged Wu Sangui's forces at Taiping Street, was defeated, and fell back to defend Jingzhou.

sentences.zh: 壬子，移趙賴提督江西。

translations.literal: On the renzi day, Zhao Lai was transferred to serve as Grand Coordinator of Jiangxi.
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi day, Zhao Lai was transferred to the post of Grand Coordinator of Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 夏四月辛丑，馬雄、祖澤清糾滇賊犯廣東。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on the xinchou day, Ma Xiong and Zu Zeqing gathered Yunnan rebels to invade Guangdong.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the xinchou day, Ma Xiong and Zu Zeqing, rallying Yunnan rebel troops, invaded Guangdong.

sentences.zh: 尚可喜老病不能軍，屢疏告急，援兵不時至。

translations.literal: Shang Kexi was aged and ill and could not command the army; he repeatedly memorialized in urgent appeal, but relief troops did not arrive in time.
translations.idiomatic: Shang Kexi was old and gravely ill and unable to take the field; though he sent repeated urgent appeals, reinforcements did not arrive in time.

sentences.zh: 至是，賊逼廣州，尚之信劫其父以降賊。

translations.literal: At this point the rebels pressed Guangzhou; Shang Zhixin compelled his father to surrender to the rebels.
translations.idiomatic: By then the rebels had pressed Guangzhou, and Shang Zhixin forced his father to submit to them.

sentences.zh: 總督金光祖，巡撫佟養鉅、陳洪明，提督嚴自明俱從降。

translations.literal: Governor-General Jin Guangzu, Grand Coordinators Tong Yangju and Chen Hongming, and Regional Commander Yan Ziming all followed in surrendering.
translations.idiomatic: Governor-General Jin Guangzu and the grand coordinators Tong Yangju and Chen Hongming, together with Regional Commander Yan Ziming, all surrendered as well.

sentences.zh: 福建巡撫楊熙、總兵拜音達奪門出。

translations.literal: Fujian Grand Coordinator Yang Xi and Regional Commander Baiyinda broke out through the gate and fled.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Xi, grand coordinator of Fujian, and Regional Commander Baiyinda fought their way out through the gates and escaped.

sentences.zh: 舒恕、莽依圖退至江西。

translations.literal: Shushu and Mangyitu withdrew to Jiangxi.
translations.idiomatic: Shushu and Mangyitu fell back into Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 上聞廣東變作，命移兵益江西。

translations.literal: On hearing of the upheaval in Guangdong, the Emperor ordered troops to be shifted to reinforce Jiangxi.
translations.idiomatic: When word of the Guangdong revolt reached the court, the Emperor ordered additional forces transferred to Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 五月壬午朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: On the first day of the fifth month, renwu, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the fifth month, renwu, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，復設鄖陽撫治，以楊茂勛任之。

translations.literal: On the yiyou day, the Xiangyang pacification commission was restored; Yang Maoxun was appointed to it.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiyou day, the Xiangyang pacification commission was reestablished, with Yang Maoxun appointed to the post.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，鄂羅斯察漢汗使人來貢。

translations.literal: On the bingxu day, envoys of the Russian Tsar came bearing tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingxu day, envoys of the Russian tsar arrived to present tribute.

sentences.zh: 己亥，撫遠大將軍圖海敗王輔臣於平涼。

translations.literal: On the jihai day, Pacification Commissioner General Tu Hai defeated Wang Fuchen at Pingliang.
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai day, Pacification Commissioner General Tu Hai defeated Wang Fuchen at Pingliang.

sentences.zh: 六月壬子朔，王輔臣降，圖海以聞。

translations.literal: On the first day of the sixth month, renzi, Wang Fuchen surrendered; Tu Hai reported it.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the sixth month, renzi, Wang Fuchen surrendered, and Tu Hai reported the fact to the throne.

sentences.zh: 詔復其官，授靖寇將軍，立功自效，諸將弁皆原之。

translations.literal: An edict restored his office, appointed him General Who Pacifies the Bandits, and ordered him to establish merit in atonement; all generals and officers were pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: An edict restored his rank, appointed him General Who Pacifies the Bandits, and bade him redeem himself by further service; all his generals and officers were pardoned.

sentences.zh: 己卯，耿繼善棄建昌遁。

translations.literal: On the jimao day, Geng Jishan abandoned Jianchang and fled.
translations.idiomatic: On the jimao day, Geng Jishan abandoned Jianchang and fled.

sentences.zh: 上諭傑書曰：「耿精忠自撤其兵，顯為海寇所逼。

translations.literal: The Emperor instructed Jieshu: "Geng Jingzhong has himself withdrawn his troops, which plainly shows he is being pressed by the sea bandits.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor instructed Jieshu: "Geng Jingzhong has himself pulled back his troops, which plainly shows the sea rebels are pressing him.

sentences.zh: 其乘機速進。

translations.literal: Seize the opportunity and advance swiftly."
translations.idiomatic: Take advantage of the moment and press forward at once."

translations.literal: "" (closing punctuation in source.)
translations.idiomatic: The passage continues.

sentences.zh: 七月辛巳朔，賜鄂羅斯使臣鞍馬服物。

translations.literal: On the first day of the seventh month, xinsi, saddles, horses, and robes were bestowed on the Russian envoys.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the seventh month, xinsi, saddles, horses, and robes were bestowed upon the Russian envoys.

sentences.zh: 大學士熊賜履免。

translations.literal: Grand Secretary Xiong Cilü was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Secretary Xiong Cilü was dismissed from office.

sentences.zh: 以慕天顏為江蘇巡撫。

translations.literal: Mu Tianyan was made Grand Coordinator of Jiangsu.
translations.idiomatic: Mu Tianyan was appointed Grand Coordinator of Jiangsu.

sentences.zh: 庚子，以姚文然為刑部尚書，郎廷相為福建總督。

translations.literal: On the gengzi day, Yao Wenran was made Minister of Justice; Lang Tingxiang was made Governor-General of Fujian.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengzi day, Yao Wenran was appointed Minister of Justice and Lang Tingxiang Governor-General of Fujian.

sentences.zh: 振武將軍佛尼勒會張勇、王進寶擊吳之茂於秦州，大敗之，賊眾宵遁。

translations.literal: Pacifying Martial General Foni'le joined Zhang Yong and Wang Jinbao in attacking Wu Zhimao at Qinzhou, greatly defeated him, and the rebel host fled by night.
translations.idiomatic: Pacifying Martial General Foni'le, joining Zhang Yong and Wang Jinbao, routed Wu Zhimao at Qinzhou; the rebel forces fled overnight.

sentences.zh: 八月甲寅，穆占復禮縣。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the jiayin day, Muzhan recovered Li County.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the jiayin day, Muzhan recovered Li County.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，上奉太皇太后幸湯泉。

translations.literal: On the renxu day, the Emperor escorted the Grand Empress Dowager to the hot springs.
translations.idiomatic: On the renxu day, the Emperor escorted the Grand Empress Dowager to the hot springs.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，賴塔擊馬九玉於衢州，復江山，九玉棄軍遁。

translations.literal: On the yihai day, Laita attacked Ma Jiuyu at Quzhou, recovered Jiangshan, and Jiuyu abandoned his army and fled.
translations.idiomatic: On the yihai day, Laita attacked Ma Jiuyu at Quzhou, recovered Jiangshan, and Jiuyu deserted his army and fled.

sentences.zh: 九月庚辰朔，賴塔進擊馬九玉，破之，復常山。

translations.literal: On the first day of the ninth month, gengchen, Laita pressed the attack on Ma Jiuyu, defeated him, and recovered Changshan.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the ninth month, gengchen, Laita pressed Ma Jiuyu, defeated him, and recovered Changshan.

sentences.zh: 進攻仙霞關，賊將金應虎迎降，復浦城，連下建寧。

translations.literal: Advancing to attack Xianxia Pass, the rebel general Jin Yinghu came forward to surrender; Pucheng was recovered and Jianning was taken in succession.
translations.idiomatic: Advancing against Xianxia Pass, he accepted the surrender of the rebel general Jin Yinghu, recovered Pucheng, and then took Jianning in succession.

sentences.zh: 癸未，張勇復階州。

translations.literal: On the guiwei day, Zhang Yong recovered Jiezhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiwei day, Zhang Yong recovered Jiezhou.

sentences.zh: 乙未，耿精忠戕前總督范承謨。

translations.literal: On the yiwei day, Geng Jingzhong killed the former governor-general Fan Chengmo.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiwei day, Geng Jingzhong put the former governor-general Fan Chengmo to death.

sentences.zh: 山西巡撫達爾布有罪免。

translations.literal: Shanxi Grand Coordinator Da'erbu was dismissed for crime.
translations.idiomatic: Da'erbu, grand coordinator of Shanxi, was dismissed for misconduct.

sentences.zh: 丙午，命穆佔為征南將軍，移軍湖廣。

translations.literal: On the bingwu day, Muzhan was appointed General Who Campaigns South and his army was shifted to Huguang.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingwu day, Muzhan was appointed General Who Campaigns South and his forces were transferred to Huguang.

sentences.zh: 冬十月辛酉，上奉太皇太后還宮。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on the xinyou day, the Emperor escorted the Grand Empress Dowager back to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the xinyou day, the Emperor escorted the Grand Empress Dowager back to the palace.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，康親王傑書師次延平，賊將耿繼美以城降。

translations.literal: On the yichou day, Prince Kang Jieshu's army reached Yanping; the rebel general Geng Jimei surrendered the city.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day, Prince Kang Jieshu's army reached Yanping, and the rebel general Geng Jimei surrendered the city.

sentences.zh: 耿精忠遣子顯祚獻偽印乞降，傑書入福州，疏聞。

translations.literal: Geng Jingzhong sent his son Xianzuo to present a false seal and beg surrender; Jieshu entered Fuzhou and memorialized the throne.
translations.idiomatic: Geng Jingzhong sent his son Xianzuo to offer a counterfeit seal and sue for surrender; Jieshu entered Fuzhou and reported to the throne.

sentences.zh: 上命復其爵，從征海寇自效。

translations.literal: The Emperor ordered his rank restored and that he campaign against the sea bandits to establish merit.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor ordered his titles restored and commanded him to campaign against the sea rebels to redeem himself by service.

sentences.zh: 其將曾養性、叛將祖弘勛俱降。

translations.literal: His generals Zeng Yangxing and the rebel Zu Hongxun both surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: His generals Zeng Yangxing and the turncoat Zu Hongxun both submitted.

sentences.zh: 浙江官兵復溫、處二府。

translations.literal: Zhejiang government troops recovered the two prefectures of Wen and Chu.
translations.idiomatic: Government troops of Zhejiang recovered the prefectures of Wenzhou and Chuzhou.

sentences.zh: 撤兗州屯兵。

translations.literal: The garrison at Yanzhou was withdrawn.
translations.idiomatic: The garrison stationed at Yanzhou was withdrawn.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，命講官進講通鑒。

translations.literal: On the guiyou day, the Emperor ordered the lecturers to lecture on the Comprehensive Mirror.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiyou day, the Emperor ordered the lecturers to expound the Comprehensive Mirror.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙戌，海寇犯福州，都統喇哈達擊敗之。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the bingxu day, sea bandits attacked Fuzhou; Commander-in-Chief Lahada defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the bingxu day, sea rebels attacked Fuzhou and were repulsed by Commander-in-Chief Lahada.

sentences.zh: 丙申，官兵圍長沙。

translations.literal: On the bingshen day, government troops besieged Changsha.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingshen day, government troops laid siege to Changsha.

sentences.zh: 寧海將軍貝子傅拉塔卒于軍。

translations.literal: Pacifying-the-Sea General, Imperial Prince Fulata, died in the army.
translations.idiomatic: Fulata, Imperial Prince and Pacifying-the-Sea General, died in camp.

sentences.zh: 十二月壬子，遣耿昭忠為鎮平將軍，駐福州，分統靖南籓軍。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the renzi day, Geng Zhaozhong was dispatched as Pacifying-the-Region General, stationed at Fuzhou to take divided command of the Pacify-the-South princely forces.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the renzi day, Geng Zhaozhong was sent as Pacifying-the-Region General to Fuzhou to take divided command of the Pacify-the-South princely army.

sentences.zh: 叛將嚴自明犯南康，舒恕擊走之。

translations.literal: The rebel Yan Ziming attacked Nankang; Shushu drove him off.
translations.idiomatic: The rebel Yan Ziming attacked Nankang, but Shushu repulsed him.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，尚之信使人詣簡親王軍前乞降，且乞師，疏聞。

translations.literal: On the dingsi day, Shang Zhixin sent envoys to Prince Jian's headquarters to beg surrender and also to request troops; he memorialized the throne.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingsi day, Shang Zhixin sent envoys to Prince Jian's camp to sue for surrender and to ask for troops; the matter was reported to the throne.

sentences.zh: 許之。

translations.literal: It was granted.
translations.idiomatic: The request was granted.

sentences.zh: 吳三桂將吳世琮殺孫延齡，踞桂林。

translations.literal: Wu Sangui's general Wu Shicong killed Sun Yanling and seized Guilin.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Shicong, a general of Wu Sangui, killed Sun Yanling and occupied Guilin.

sentences.zh: 庚申，海澄公黃芳世自賊中脫歸。

translations.literal: On the gengshen day, Duke of Haicheng Huang Fangshi escaped and returned from among the rebels.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengshen day, Huang Fangshi, Duke of Haicheng, made his way out of rebel hands and returned.

sentences.zh: 上嘉之，加太子太保，與其弟黃藍並赴康親王大軍討賊。

translations.literal: The Emperor praised him, advanced him to Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent, and ordered him and his younger brother Huang Lan to join Prince Kang's great army to suppress the rebels.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor commended him, promoted him to Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent, and ordered him and his younger brother Huang Lan to join Prince Kang's main force against the rebels.

sentences.zh: 建威將軍吳丹復山陽。

translations.literal: Establishing Prestige General Wu Dan recovered Shanyang.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Dan, Establishing Prestige General, recovered Shanyang.

sentences.zh: 辛未，頒賞諸軍軍士金帛。

translations.literal: On the xinwei day, gold and silks were distributed to reward the soldiers of the various armies.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinwei day, gold and silks were distributed as rewards to the troops of the various armies.

sentences.zh: 丙子，祫祭太廟。

translations.literal: On the bingzi day, a collective offering was performed at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingzi day, the collective seasonal offering was performed in the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 耿繼善棄邵武，海寇據之。

translations.literal: Geng Jishan abandoned Shaowu; sea bandits occupied it.
translations.idiomatic: Geng Jishan abandoned Shaowu, which the sea rebels then occupied.

sentences.zh: 副都統穆赫林擊之，賊將彭世勛以城降。

translations.literal: Vice Commander-in-Chief Muhelin attacked them; the rebel general Peng Shixun surrendered the city.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Commander-in-Chief Muhelin attacked them, and the rebel general Peng Shixun surrendered the city.

sentences.zh: 是歲，免直隸、江南、江西、陝西各省三十四州縣災賦有差。

translations.literal: That year land tax from disaster-stricken areas in thirty-four subprefectures and counties of Zhili, Jiangnan, Jiangxi, and Shaanxi was remitted in varying amounts.
translations.idiomatic: That year, disaster land taxes were remitted, in varying degrees, for thirty-four subprefectures and counties in Zhili, Jiangnan, Jiangxi, and Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 朝鮮入貢。

translations.literal: Korea sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Korea presented tribute.

sentences.zh: 十六年丁巳春正月丙申，將軍額楚攻吉安失利，命侍郎班迪馳勘軍狀。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year, dingsi, first month of spring, on the bingshen day, General Echu attacked Ji'an with an unfavorable outcome; Attendant Minister Bandi was hurriedly sent to investigate the state of the army.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year (1677), spring, first month, on the bingshen day, General Echu's attack on Ji'an failed; Attendant Minister Bandi was dispatched posthaste to review the army's condition.

sentences.zh: 二月己未，上幸南苑行圍。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the jiwei day, the Emperor proceeded to the Southern Park for the hunt.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the jiwei day, the Emperor went to the Southern Park for a hunting encampment.

sentences.zh: 甲子，大閱於南苑。

translations.literal: On the jiazi day, a grand review was held at the Southern Park.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiazi day, a grand military review was held at the Southern Park.

sentences.zh: 免福建今年租賦，招集流亡。

translations.literal: This year's land tax of Fujian was remitted and displaced persons were summoned to return.
translations.idiomatic: Fujian's land tax for the year was remitted and refugees were summoned to return.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，以鄂內為討逆將軍，赴岳州。

translations.literal: On the bingyin day, E'nei was made Suppression-of-Rebellion General and sent to Yuezhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingyin day, E'nei was appointed Suppression-of-Rebellion General and sent to Yuezhou.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，康親王傑書敗鄭錦於興、泉，賊棄漳州遁，復海澄。

translations.literal: On the dingmao day, Prince Kang Jieshu defeated Zheng Jing at Xing and Quan; the rebels abandoned Zhangzhou and fled, and Haicheng was recovered.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingmao day, Prince Kang Jieshu defeated Zheng Jing in the Xing and Quan region; the rebels abandoned Zhangzhou and fled, and Haicheng was recovered.

sentences.zh: 遣郎中色度勞軍岳州，察軍狀。

translations.literal: Director of the Ministry Se'du was dispatched to Yuezhou to comfort the army and inspect its condition.
translations.idiomatic: Director of the Ministry Se'du was sent to Yuezhou to comfort the troops and review the army's condition.

sentences.zh: 辛未，以靳輔為河道總督。

translations.literal: On the xinwei day, Jin Fu was made Director-General of the Grand Canal.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinwei day, Jin Fu was appointed Director-General of the Grand Canal.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，論花馬池剿寇功，蒙古鄂爾多斯貝勒索諾木等晉爵有差。

translations.literal: Merit in suppressing bandits at Huamachi was assessed; Mongol Ordos beile Suonuomu and others were advanced in rank in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Rewards were apportioned for suppressing bandits at Huamachi; Suonuomu, beile of the Ordos Mongols, and others were promoted in rank according to merit.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，上御經筵。

translations.literal: On the yihai day, the Emperor attended the Classics Lecture.
translations.idiomatic: On the yihai day, the Emperor presided over the Classics Lecture.

sentences.zh: 是月江西官軍復瑞金、鉛山。

translations.literal: This month the government troops of Jiangxi recovered Ruijin and Yanshan.
translations.idiomatic: That month the Jiangxi government forces recovered Ruijin and Yanshan.

sentences.zh: 三月甲申，以莽依圖為鎮南將軍，督兵廣東。

translations.literal: Third month, day jiashen: Mangyitu was made Pacifying-the-South General and ordered to command troops in Guangdong.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiashen day of the third month, Mangyitu was appointed Pacifying-the-South General and ordered to take command in Guangdong.

sentences.zh: 己丑，諭禮部：「帝王克謹天戒，凡有垂象，皆關治理。

translations.literal: Day jichou: instructed the Ministry of Rites: "Emperors must scrupulously heed Heaven's warnings; every celestial omen bears on governance.
translations.idiomatic: On the jichou day the emperor instructed the Ministry of Rites: "A ruler must heed Heaven's warnings with care; every sign in the sky touches on how the realm is governed.

sentences.zh: 設立專官，謹司占候。

translations.literal: Special officers should be appointed to oversee observation and prognostication with care.
translations.idiomatic: Dedicated officers should be appointed to watch the heavens and report what they see.

sentences.zh: 今星辰凌犯，霜露非時，欽天監不以實告，有辜職掌。

translations.literal: Now the stars transgress and frost and dew come at the wrong season, yet the Directorate of Astronomy does not report truthfully — this fails their charge.
translations.idiomatic: Stars now violate their courses, and frost and dew arrive out of season, yet the Directorate of Astronomy does not report the facts — a dereliction of duty.

sentences.zh: 其察議以聞。

translations.literal: Let the matter be investigated and reported.
translations.idiomatic: Investigate the matter and report back.

sentences.zh: 」庚寅，命翰林長於詞賦書法者，以所業進呈。

translations.literal: " Day gengyin: ordered those among the Hanlin who excelled in rhapsody and calligraphy to present their work.
translations.idiomatic: " On the gengyin day he ordered Hanlin scholars skilled in fu verse and calligraphy to submit their compositions.

sentences.zh: 乙未，原任總兵劉進忠、苗之秀詣康親王軍降，命隨大軍剿賊。

translations.literal: Day yiwei: former regional commanders Liu Jinzhong and Miao Zhixiu came to Prince Kang's army to surrender; they were ordered to join the main force in suppressing the rebels.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiwei day the former regional commanders Liu Jinzhong and Miao Zhixiu surrendered to Prince Kang's army and were ordered to join the main force against the rebels.

sentences.zh: 癸未，詔：「軍興以來，文武官身殉封疆，克全忠節，其有旅親不能歸，妻子不得養者，深堪軫惻。

translations.literal: Day guimao, edict: "Since the raising of armies, civil and military officials have died for the frontiers and fulfilled loyal duty; where kin cannot return home or wives and children cannot be provided for, the case deeply moves compassion.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day an edict said: "Since the war began, civil and military officials have given their lives on the frontiers and kept their loyal integrity. Where families cannot return home or wives and children go without support, the hardship is deeply pitiable.

sentences.zh: 所在疆吏察明，妥為資送，以昭褒忠至意。

translations.literal: Local frontier officials should ascertain the facts and see to their passage and support, to manifest the utmost intent to honor loyalty."
translations.idiomatic: Let frontier officials everywhere ascertain the facts and provide for their safe return and upkeep, so that our intent to honor the loyal may be made plain."

sentences.zh: 」甲辰，含譽星見，慶雲見。

translations.literal: Day jiachen: the Armillary Halo Star appeared, and auspicious clouds were seen.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiachen day the Armillary Halo Star appeared and auspicious clouds were seen.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，吳三桂聚兵守長沙。

translations.literal: Day yisi: Wu Sangui massed troops to hold Changsha.
translations.idiomatic: On the yisi day Wu Sangui gathered his forces to defend Changsha.

sentences.zh: 命勒爾錦進臨江，圖海守漢中，喇布鎮吉安，莽依圖進韶州，額楚駐袁州，舒恕防贛州。

translations.literal: Ordered Le'erjin to advance to Linjiang, Tu Hai to hold Hanzhong, Labu to garrison Ji'an, Mangyitu to advance on Shaozhou, Echu to station at Yuanzhou, and Shushu to defend Ganzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Le'erjin was ordered to advance on Linjiang, Tu Hai to hold Hanzhong, Labu to garrison Ji'an, Mangyitu to push toward Shaozhou, Echu to station at Yuanzhou, and Shushu to defend Ganzhou.

sentences.zh: 夏四月己未，康親王傑書疏言處州府慶元縣民人吳臣任等不肯從賊，結寨自固，守義殺賊，實為可嘉。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day jiwei: Prince Kang Jieshu memorialized that the people of Qingyuan County in Chuzhou Prefecture, Wu Chenren and others, refused to follow the rebels, fortified stockades, upheld righteousness and killed rebels — truly praiseworthy.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, on the jiwei day of the fourth month, Prince Kang Jieshu reported that Wu Chenren and others of Qingyuan County in Chuzhou Prefecture had refused to join the rebels, built stockades to hold their ground, upheld righteousness, and killed rebels — conduct truly worthy of praise.

sentences.zh: 已交浙江督撫，效力者錄用，歸農者獎賞，其陣亡札委守備吳受南等並請恩恤。

translations.literal: Already referred to the Zhejiang governor-general and governor; those who serve were to be enrolled, those returning to farming rewarded, and the fallen, including Deputy Brigade Commander Wu Shounan, were recommended for favor and condolence.
translations.idiomatic: The case had been referred to the Zhejiang governor-general and governor: those who wished to serve were to be enrolled, those returning to farming were to be rewarded, and the fallen — including Deputy Brigade Commander Wu Shounan — were recommended for imperial favor and relief.

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: Approved.
translations.idiomatic: The request was approved.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，上幸霸州行圍。

translations.literal: Day xinyou: the emperor went to Bazhou for the hunting encampment.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinyou day the emperor went to Bazhou for the hunting camp.

sentences.zh: 以伊桑阿為工部尚書，宋德宜為左都御史。

translations.literal: Yisang'a was made Minister of Works; Song Deyi was made Censor-in-Chief of the Left.
translations.idiomatic: Yisang'a was appointed Minister of Works and Song Deyi Censor-in-Chief of the Left.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，提督趙賴敗土寇於泰和，擒賊目蕭元。

translations.literal: Day dingmao: Provincial Military Commander Zhao Lai defeated local bandits at Taihe and captured the rebel chieftain Xiao Yuan.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingmao day Provincial Military Commander Zhao Lai defeated local bandits at Taihe and captured the rebel leader Xiao Yuan.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，予死事溫處道陳丹赤等官廕。

translations.literal: Day wuchen: posthumous hereditary privileges were granted to Chen Danchi, Circuit Intendant of Wenzhou and Taizhou, and others who died in service.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuchen day hereditary office privileges were granted posthumously to Chen Danchi, Circuit Intendant of Wen-Tai, and others who had died in service.

sentences.zh: 辛未，上制大德景福頌，書屏，上太皇太后。

translations.literal: Day xinwei: the emperor composed the "Ode on Great Virtue and Auspicious Blessing," had it written on a screen, and presented it to the Grand Empress Dowager.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinwei day the emperor composed the "Ode on Great Virtue and Auspicious Blessing," had it written on a screen, and presented it to the Grand Empress Dowager.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，莽依圖師至南安，嚴自明以城降，遂克南雄，入韶州。

translations.literal: Day yihai: Mangyitu's army reached Nan'an; Yan Ziming surrendered the city; Nanxiong was taken and they entered Shaozhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the yihai day Mangyitu's army reached Nan'an; Yan Ziming surrendered the city; Nanxiong was taken, and the force entered Shaozhou.

sentences.zh: 五月己卯，尚之信降，命復其爵，隨大軍討賊。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day jimao: Shang Zhixin surrendered; his title was restored and he was ordered to join the main army against the rebels.
translations.idiomatic: On the jimao day of the fifth month Shang Zhixin surrendered; his rank was restored and he was ordered to join the main army against the rebels.

sentences.zh: 特擢謫戍知府傅弘烈為廣西巡撫。

translations.literal: Fu Honglie, a prefect demoted to garrison duty, was specially promoted to Governor of Guangxi.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Honglie, a prefect serving in exile, was specially promoted to Governor of Guangxi.

sentences.zh: 先是，弘烈以首吳三桂反狀謫梧州。

translations.literal: Earlier, Honglie had been the first to report Wu Sangui's rebellion and was banished to Wuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, Honglie had been the first to report Wu Sangui's rebellion and was banished to Wuzhou.

sentences.zh: 及兵起，弘烈上書陳方略，故有是命。

translations.literal: When war broke out he submitted a plan, hence this appointment.
translations.idiomatic: When hostilities began he submitted a strategic plan, and hence received this appointment.

sentences.zh: 旋加授撫蠻滅寇將軍，與莽依圖規取廣西。

translations.literal: He was soon further made General for Pacifying the Tribes and Exterminating Bandits, to plan the recovery of Guangxi with Mangyitu.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon further appointed General for Pacifying the Tribes and Exterminating Bandits and, with Mangyitu, was to plan the recovery of Guangxi.

sentences.zh: 甲午，額魯特噶爾丹攻敗喀爾喀車臣汗，來獻軍實，卻之。

translations.literal: Day jiawu: the Eleuth Galdan defeated the Khalkha Tsetsen Khan and came to offer booty; it was declined.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiawu day the Eleuth leader Galdan defeated the Khalkha Tsetsen Khan and came to present war booty; the gift was declined.

sentences.zh: 六月丁巳，祖澤清以高州降。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day dingsi: Zu Zeqing surrendered Gaozhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingsi day of the sixth month Zu Zeqing surrendered Gaozhou.

sentences.zh: 秋七月庚子，鄭錦將劉國軒自惠州犯東莞，尚之信大敗之，賊將陳璉以惠州降。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day gengzi: Zheng Jing's general Liu Guoxuan attacked Dongguan from Huizhou; Shang Zhixin routed him; the rebel general Chen Lian surrendered Huizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, on the gengzi day of the seventh month, Zheng Jing's general Liu Guoxuan advanced from Huizhou against Dongguan; Shang Zhixin routed him, and the rebel general Chen Lian surrendered Huizhou.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，上御便殿，召大學士等賜坐，論經史，因及前代朋黨之弊，諭加警戒。

translations.literal: Day jiachen: the emperor held court in the informal hall, summoned Grand Secretaries to be seated, discoursed on the classics and history, touched on the evils of faction in former ages, and exhorted heightened vigilance.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiachen day the emperor received audience in the informal hall, summoned the Grand Secretaries to be seated, discussed the classics and histories, spoke of the harm of factions in past dynasties, and urged greater vigilance.

sentences.zh: 以明珠、覺羅勒德洪為大學士。

translations.literal: Mingzhu and Aisin Gioro Ledehong were made Grand Secretaries.
translations.idiomatic: Mingzhu and Aisin Gioro Ledehong were appointed Grand Secretaries.

sentences.zh: 八月丁未，明宗人朱統錩起兵陷貴溪、瀘溪。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day dingwei: Ming clansman Zhu Tongkun raised troops and seized Guixi and Luxi.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingwei day of the eighth month the Ming clansman Zhu Tongkun raised troops and seized Guixi and Luxi.

sentences.zh: 己未，上御經筵。

translations.literal: Day jiwei: the emperor attended the Classics lecture.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiwei day the emperor attended the lecture on the classics.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，冊立貴妃鈕祜祿氏為皇后，佟佳氏為貴妃。

translations.literal: Day bingyin: the honored consort of the Niuhuru clan was installed as empress, and the Tonggiya clan as honored consort.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingyin day the honored consort of the Niuhuru clan was installed as empress and the Tonggiya clan as honored consort.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，傅弘烈等復梧州。

translations.literal: Day wuchen: Fu Honglie and others recovered Wuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuchen day Fu Honglie and others recovered Wuzhou.

sentences.zh: 九月丙子，命宗室公溫齊、提督周卜世赴湖廣協剿。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day bingzi: ordered the imperial clansman Duke Wenqi and Provincial Military Commander Zhou Boushi to proceed to Huguang to assist in suppression.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingzi day of the ninth month the imperial clansman Duke Wenqi and Provincial Military Commander Zhou Boushi were ordered to Huguang to assist in suppressing the rebels.

sentences.zh: 癸未，命額駙華善率師益簡親王軍，科爾科代接駐江寧。

translations.literal: Day guimao: ordered the emperor's son-in-law Huashan to lead troops to reinforce Prince Jian's army; Ko'erkedai took over garrison at Jiangning.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day the emperor's son-in-law Huashan was ordered to lead troops to reinforce Prince Jian's army, and Ko'erkedai was to relieve the garrison at Jiangning.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，上發京師，謁孝陵，巡近邊。

translations.literal: Day dinghai: the emperor left the capital, visited Xiaoling, and toured the nearby frontier.
translations.idiomatic: On the dinghai day the emperor left the capital, paid homage at Xiaoling, and toured the nearby frontier.

sentences.zh: 丙申，次喀拉河屯。

translations.literal: Day bingshen: halted at Kalahetun.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingshen day he halted at Kalahetun.

sentences.zh: 庚子，次達希喀布秦昂阿，近邊蒙古敖漢部札穆蘇等朝行在，敵駝馬，賜金幣。

translations.literal: Day gengzi: halted at Daxikabuqin'ang'a; border Mongols of the Aohan banner, Zhamusu and others, attended the mobile court, presented camels and horses, and received gold and coins.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengzi day he halted at Daxikabuqin'ang'a; Zhamusu and others of the Aohan Mongol banner on the frontier came to the mobile court, presented camels and horses, and were given gold and coins.

sentences.zh: 吳三桂將胡國柱、馬寶寇韶州，將軍莽依圖、額楚夾擊破之，賊遁，追之過樂昌，復仁化。

translations.literal: Wu Sangui's generals Hu Guozhu and Ma Bao attacked Shaozhou; Generals Mangyitu and Echu defeated them in pincer; the rebels fled; pursued beyond Lechang and recovered Renhua.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Sangui's generals Hu Guozhu and Ma Bao attacked Shaozhou; Generals Mangyitu and Echu defeated them in a pincer attack; the rebels fled, were pursued beyond Lechang, and Renhua was recovered.

sentences.zh: 冬十月甲辰，上次湯泉。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day jiachen: the emperor stopped at Tangquan.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, on the jiachen day of the tenth month, the emperor stopped at Tangquan.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，還宮。

translations.literal: Day guichou: returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On the guichou day he returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 傅弘烈敗吳世琮於昭平，復潯州。

translations.literal: Fu Honglie defeated Wu Shijong at Zhaoping and recovered Xunzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Honglie defeated Wu Shijong at Zhaoping and recovered Xunzhou.

sentences.zh: 福建按察使吳興祚敗朱統錩於光澤，其黨執統錩降。

translations.literal: Fujian Provincial Surveillance Commissioner Wu Xingzuo defeated Zhu Tongkun at Guangze; his followers seized Zhu Tongkun and surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: Fujian Surveillance Commissioner Wu Xingzuo defeated Zhu Tongkun at Guangze; Zhu's followers seized him and surrendered.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，始設南書房，命侍講學士張英、中書高士奇入直。

translations.literal: Day guihai: the Southern Studios were first established; Attendant Reader Zhang Ying and Secretariat Drafter Gao Shiqi were ordered to serve on duty there.
translations.idiomatic: On the guihai day the Southern Studios were established for the first time, and Attendant Reader Zhang Ying and Secretariat Drafter Gao Shiqi were ordered to serve there on duty.

sentences.zh: 十一月己卯，吳三桂將韓大任陷萬安，護軍統領哈克山擊敗之。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day jimao: Wu Sangui's general Han Daren seized Wan'an; Banner Guard Commander Hakeshan defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: On the jimao day of the eleventh month Wu Sangui's general Han Daren seized Wan'an; Banner Guard Commander Hakeshan defeated him.

sentences.zh: 庚子，封長白山神，遣官望祭。

translations.literal: Day gengzi: the god of Changbai Mountain was enfeoffed; officials were sent for distant veneration.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengzi day the deity of Changbai Mountain was enfeoffed and officials were dispatched to offer sacrifice from afar.

sentences.zh: 是月，官兵復茶陵、攸縣。

translations.literal: This month the government troops recovered Chaling and You Counties.
translations.idiomatic: That month the government forces recovered Chaling and You Counties.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙巳，海寇犯泉州，提督段應舉等御之。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day yisi: sea rebels attacked Quanzhou; Provincial Military Commander Duan Yingju and others resisted them.
translations.idiomatic: On the yisi day of the twelfth month sea rebels attacked Quanzhou; Provincial Military Commander Duan Yingju and others met them in battle.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，海寇犯欽州，游擊劉士貴擊敗之。

translations.literal: Day xinhai: sea rebels attacked Qinzhou; Brigade Commander Liu Shigui defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinhai day sea rebels attacked Qinzhou; Brigade Commander Liu Shigui defeated them.

sentences.zh: 命參贊勒貝、將軍額楚進取郴、永。

translations.literal: Ordered the campaign aide-de-camp Lebei and General Echu to advance on Chen and Yong.
translations.idiomatic: Campaign aide-de-camp Lebei and General Echu were ordered to advance on Chenzhou and Yongzhou.

sentences.zh: 己巳，以馮甦為刑部侍郎。

translations.literal: Day jisi: Feng Su was made Vice Minister of Justice.
translations.idiomatic: On the jisi day Feng Su was appointed Vice Minister of Justice.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，金星晝見。

translations.literal: Day xinyou: Venus appeared in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinyou day Venus was visible in daylight.

sentences.zh: 辛未，祫祭太廟。

translations.literal: Day xinwei: the joint seasonal offering was made at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinwei day the joint seasonal offering was performed at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 是歲，免直隸、江南、江西、陝西、湖廣等省七十州縣災賦有差。

translations.literal: This year disaster taxes were remitted in varying degrees for seventy prefectures and counties in Zhili, Jiangnan, Jiangxi, Shaanxi, Huguang, and other provinces.
translations.idiomatic: That year disaster land taxes were remitted in varying degrees for seventy prefectures and counties in Zhili, Jiangnan, Jiangxi, Shaanxi, Huguang, and other provinces.

sentences.zh: 朝鮮入貢。

translations.literal: Korea sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Korea sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 十七年戊午春正月己丑，副都統哈當、總兵許貞擊韓大任於寧都，大任遁之汀州，詣康親王軍前降，命執送京師。

translations.literal: Year 17, cycle year wuwu, spring first month, day jichou: Vice Commander-in-Chief Hadang and Regional Commander Xu Zhen attacked Han Daren at Ningdu; Daren fled to Tingzhou and surrendered before Prince Kang's army; ordered seized and sent to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year, the wuwu cycle year, on the jichou day of the first month of spring, Vice Commander-in-Chief Hadang and Regional Commander Xu Zhen attacked Han Daren at Ningdu; Daren fled to Tingzhou and surrendered to Prince Kang's army; he was ordered seized and sent to the capital.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，以郭四海為左都御史。

translations.literal: Day renchen: Guo Sihai was made Censor-in-Chief of the Left.
translations.idiomatic: On the renchen day Guo Sihai was appointed Censor-in-Chief of the Left.

sentences.zh: 乙未，詔曰：「一代之興，必有博學鴻儒振起文運，闡發經史，以備顧問。

translations.literal: Day yiwei, edict: "The rise of every age requires erudite scholars to revive the literary order, expound the classics and histories, and serve as advisers.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiwei day an edict said: "The founding of every dynasty calls for broadly learned scholars to revive literary culture, clarify the classics and histories, and stand ready as advisers.

sentences.zh: 朕萬幾餘暇，思得博通之士，用資典學。

translations.literal: In my spare moments amid myriad affairs I seek broadly learned men to enrich classical study.
translations.idiomatic: In the intervals of my myriad duties I wish to find men of wide learning to enrich our classical studies.

sentences.zh: 其有學行兼優、文詞卓越之士，勿論已仕未仕，中外臣工各舉所知，朕將親試焉。

translations.literal: Those of combined learning and conduct and outstanding literary talent, whether already in office or not, let officials within and without each recommend whom they know; I shall examine them in person."
translations.idiomatic: Those whose learning and conduct are both excellent and whose writing is outstanding, whether already in office or not, let officials throughout the realm each recommend those they know; I shall examine them personally."

sentences.zh: 」於是大學士李霨等薦曹溶等七十一人，命赴京齊集請旨。

translations.literal: Thereupon Grand Secretary Li Wei and others recommended Cao Rong and seventy others; they were ordered to assemble in the capital for imperial disposition.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon Grand Secretary Li Wei and others recommended Cao Rong and seventy-one others; they were ordered to assemble in the capital for the emperor's decision.

sentences.zh: 二月甲辰，傅弘烈疏言吳三桂兵犯廣西，詔額楚、勒貝守梧州。

translations.literal: Second month, day jiachen: Fu Honglie memorialized that Wu Sangui's army was invading Guangxi; Echu and Lebei were ordered to hold Wuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiachen day of the second month Fu Honglie reported that Wu Sangui's army was invading Guangxi; Echu and Lebei were ordered to hold Wuzhou.

sentences.zh: 己未，上御經筵，制四書講疏義序。

translations.literal: Day jiwei: the emperor attended the Classics lecture and composed a preface to the exegesis of the Four Books.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiwei day the emperor attended the lecture on the classics and composed a preface to the exegesis of the Four Books.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，皇后鈕祜祿氏崩，諡曰孝昭皇后。

translations.literal: Day dingmao: Empress Niuhuru died; posthumous title Empress Xiaozhao.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingmao day Empress Niuhuru died and was given the posthumous title Empress Xiaozhao.

sentences.zh: 辛未，莽依圖及吳世琮戰於平樂，失利，退守梧州。

translations.literal: Day xinwei: Mangyitu fought Wu Shijong at Pingle, suffered defeat, and withdrew to hold Wuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinwei day Mangyitu fought Wu Shijong at Pingle, was defeated, and withdrew to defend Wuzhou.

sentences.zh: 命尚之信及都統馬九玉會師守梧州。

translations.literal: Ordered Shang Zhixin and Banner Commander Ma Jiuyu to unite forces and hold Wuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Shang Zhixin and Banner Commander Ma Jiuyu were ordered to unite their forces and hold Wuzhou.

sentences.zh: 三月丙子，湖廣官兵擊楊來嘉、洪福，敗之，復房縣。

translations.literal: Third month, day bingzi: Huguang government troops attacked Yang Laijia and Hong Fu, defeated them, and recovered Fang County.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingzi day of the third month Huguang government troops attacked Yang Laijia and Hong Fu, defeated them, and recovered Fang County.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，海寇犯石門，黃芳世擊敗之。

translations.literal: Day dingchou: sea rebels attacked Shimen; Huang Fangshi defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingchou day sea rebels attacked Shimen; Huang Fangshi defeated them.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，祖澤清復叛應吳三桂。

translations.literal: Day guisi: Zu Zeqing rebelled again and joined Wu Sangui.
translations.idiomatic: On the guisi day Zu Zeqing rebelled again and went over to Wu Sangui.

sentences.zh: 閏三月癸卯，上巡近畿。

translations.literal: Intercalary third month, day guimao: the emperor toured the nearby capital region.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day of the intercalary third month the emperor toured the vicinity of the capital.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，命內大臣喀代、尚書馬喇往科爾沁四十九旗蒞盟。

translations.literal: Day yichou: ordered Inner Ministers Kadai and Minister Mala to go to the forty-nine banners of Horqin to preside over the league.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day Inner Ministers Kadai and Minister Mala were ordered to go to the forty-nine Horqin banners to preside over the league assembly.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，吳三桂將林興珠詣安親王軍前降，詔封建義侯，隨軍剿賊。

translations.literal: Day dingmao: Wu Sangui's general Lin Xingzhu came to Prince An's army to surrender; enfeoffed as Marquis of Establishing Righteousness; ordered to join the army against rebels.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingmao day Wu Sangui's general Lin Xingzhu surrendered to Prince An's army, was enfeoffed as Marquis of Establishing Righteousness, and was ordered to join the campaign against the rebels.

sentences.zh: 逮問副都統甘度海、阿進泰，以在江西剿賊失機也。

translations.literal: Vice Commanders-in-Chief Ganduhai and Aijintai were arrested and questioned for missing their opportunity while suppressing rebels in Jiangxi.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Commanders-in-Chief Ganduhai and Aijintai were arrested and interrogated for having lost their chance to strike while suppressing rebels in Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 夏四月庚午，海寇蔡寅陷平和，進逼潮州。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day gengwu: the sea rebel Cai Yin seized Pinghe and pressed toward Chaozhou.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, on the gengwu day of the fourth month, the sea rebel Cai Yin seized Pinghe and advanced on Chaozhou.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，祖澤清犯電白，尚之信、額楚擊之，澤清遁。

translations.literal: Day jiaxu: Zu Zeqing attacked Dianbai; Shang Zhixin and Echu attacked him and Zeqing fled.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiaxu day Zu Zeqing attacked Dianbai; Shang Zhixin and Echu attacked him and Zeqing fled.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，慶陽土賊袁本秀作亂，官兵擊斬之。

translations.literal: Day gengyin: the native bandit Yuan Benxiu of Qingyang rebelled; government troops attacked and killed him.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengyin day the local bandit Yuan Benxiu of Qingyang rose in revolt; government troops attacked and killed him.

sentences.zh: 五月庚子朔，海澄公黃芳世卒于軍，命其弟芳泰襲爵。

translations.literal: Fifth month, new moon on day gengzi: the Duke of Haicheng Huang Fangshi died in the army; his younger brother Fangtai was ordered to inherit the title.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengzi new moon of the fifth month the Duke of Haicheng Huang Fangshi died in the army; his younger brother Fangtai was ordered to inherit the title.

sentences.zh: 戊申，福建總督郎廷相、巡撫楊熙、提督段應舉俱免，以姚啟聖為福建總督，吳興祚為福建巡撫，楊捷為福建水陸提督。

translations.literal: Day wushen: Fujian Governor-General Lang Tingxiang, Governor Yang Xi, and Provincial Military Commander Duan Yingju were all dismissed; Yao Qisheng was made Fujian Governor-General, Wu Xingzuo Fujian Governor, and Yang Jie Fujian land-and-water Provincial Military Commander.
translations.idiomatic: On the wushen day Fujian Governor-General Lang Tingxiang, Governor Yang Xi, and Provincial Military Commander Duan Yingju were all dismissed; Yao Qisheng was made Fujian Governor-General, Wu Xingzuo Fujian Governor, and Yang Jie Fujian land-and-water Provincial Military Commander.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，上幸西郊觀禾。

translations.literal: Day jiayin: the emperor went to the western suburbs to view the grain.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiayin day the emperor went to the western suburbs to inspect the crops.

sentences.zh: 額魯特部濟農為噶爾丹所逼，入邊，張勇逐出之。

translations.literal: Eleuth tribesmen of Jinong, pressed by Galdan, entered the frontier; Zhang Yong drove them out.
translations.idiomatic: Eleuth tribesmen of Jinong, pressed by Galdan, crossed the border; Zhang Yong drove them out.

sentences.zh: 六月壬申，尚善遣林興珠敗三桂舟師於君山。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day renshen: Shang Shan sent Lin Xingzhu to defeat Sangui's river forces at Junshan.
translations.idiomatic: On the renshen day of the sixth month Shang Shan sent Lin Xingzhu to defeat Sangui's river fleet at Junshan.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，上以盛夏亢旱，步禱於天壇。

translations.literal: Day dinghai: because of severe midsummer drought, the emperor walked to pray at the Altar of Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: On the dinghai day, because of severe drought in midsummer, the emperor walked in person to pray at the Altar of Heaven.

sentences.zh: 是日，大雨。

translations.literal: That day, heavy rain fell.
translations.idiomatic: That day heavy rain fell.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，吳三桂將犯永興，都統伯宜理布、統領哈克山與戰，敗歿。

translations.literal: Day renchen: Wu Sangui's generals attacked Yongxing; Banner Commanders Boyilibu and Hakeshan fought them and were defeated and killed.
translations.idiomatic: On the renchen day Wu Sangui's generals attacked Yongxing; Banner Commanders Boyilibu and Hakeshan fought them and were defeated and killed.

sentences.zh: 海寇犯廉州，總兵班紹明等擊走之。

translations.literal: Sea rebels attacked Lianzhou; Regional Commander Ban Shaoming and others drove them off.
translations.idiomatic: Sea rebels attacked Lianzhou; Regional Commander Ban Shaoming and others drove them off.

sentences.zh: 吳三桂兵犯郴州，副都統碩岱與戰，不利，奔永興。

translations.literal: Wu Sangui's army attacked Chenzhou; Vice Commander-in-Chief Shuodai fought but did poorly and fled to Yongxing.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Sangui's army attacked Chenzhou; Vice Commander-in-Chief Shuodai fought but was beaten and fled to Yongxing.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，詔曰：「軍興以來，將士披堅執銳，盛暑祁寒，備極勞苦，朕甚憫焉。

translations.literal: Day dingyou, edict: "Since the raising of armies, soldiers have borne armor and wielded blades through blazing heat and bitter cold, enduring the utmost hardship; I am deeply moved.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day an edict said: "Since the war began, soldiers have worn armor and borne arms through scorching heat and bitter cold, enduring the utmost hardship; I am deeply moved.

sentences.zh: 其令兵部察軍中有負債責者，官為償之，戰歿及被創者恤其家。

translations.literal: Let the Ministry of War investigate those in the army burdened with debt; the state shall pay; families of those killed in battle or wounded shall receive relief."
translations.idiomatic: Let the Ministry of War investigate soldiers burdened with debts and have the state pay them off; families of those killed in battle or wounded in action shall receive relief."

translations.literal: "" (closing punctuation in source.)
translations.idiomatic: The passage continues.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，鄭錦陷海澄，前鋒統領希佛、副都統穆赫林、提督段應舉死之。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month: Zheng Jing seized Haicheng; Vanguard Commander Xifo, Vice Commander Muhelin, and Provincial Military Commander Duan Yingju were killed.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, in the seventh month, Zheng Jing seized Haicheng; Vanguard Commander Xifo, Vice Commander Muhelin, and Provincial Military Commander Duan Yingju were killed.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，鄭錦犯泉州。

translations.literal: Day jiachen: Zheng Jing attacked Quanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiachen day Zheng Jing attacked Quanzhou.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，以安珠護為奉天將軍。

translations.literal: Day jiayin: Anzhuhu was made General of Fengtian.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiayin day Anzhuhu was appointed General of Fengtian.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，以魏象樞為左都御史。

translations.literal: Day renxu: Wei Xiangshu was made Censor-in-Chief of the Left.
translations.idiomatic: On the renxu day Wei Xiangshu was appointed Censor-in-Chief of the Left.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，召翰林院學士陳廷敬、侍讀學士葉方藹入直南書房。

translations.literal: Day bingyin: Hanlin Academy academician Chen Tingjing and Reader Ye Fang'ai were summoned to serve in the Southern Studios.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingyin day Hanlin Academician Chen Tingjing and Reader Ye Fang'ai were summoned to serve on duty in the Southern Studios.

sentences.zh: 是月，吳三桂僭號于衡州。

translations.literal: This month Wu Sangui presumptuously declared himself emperor at Hengzhou.
translations.idiomatic: That month Wu Sangui presumptuously declared himself emperor at Hengzhou.

sentences.zh: 八月己卯，安遠靖寇大將軍、貝勒尚善卒于軍，命貝勒察尼代之。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day jimao: the Pacifying-the-Distant and Quelling-Rebels Grand General, Prince Shang Shan, died in the army; Prince Chani was ordered to replace him.
translations.idiomatic: On the jimao day of the eighth month the Pacifying-the-Distant and Quelling-Rebels Grand General, Prince Shang Shan, died in the army; Prince Chani was ordered to replace him.

sentences.zh: 庚午，西洋國王阿豐肅使臣入貢。

translations.literal: Day gengwu: envoys from King Afonso of the Western Ocean came to offer tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengwu day envoys from King Afonso of the Western Ocean came to offer tribute.

sentences.zh: 癸未，上御經筵，以御制詩集賜陳廷敬等。

translations.literal: Day guimao: the emperor attended the Classics lecture and bestowed his personally composed poetry collection on Chen Tingjing and others.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day the emperor attended the lecture on the classics and bestowed his personally composed poetry collection on Chen Tingjing and others.

sentences.zh: 乙未，吳三桂死，永興圍解。

translations.literal: Day yiwei: Wu Sangui died and the siege of Yongxing was lifted.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiwei day Wu Sangui died and the siege of Yongxing was lifted.

sentences.zh: 頒行康熙永年曆。

translations.literal: The Kangxi Perpetual Calendar was promulgated.
translations.idiomatic: The Kangxi Perpetual Calendar was promulgated.

sentences.zh: 丙申，詔曰：「逆賊倡亂，仰服天誅。

translations.literal: Day bingshen, edict: "The rebel villains stirred up rebellion and have submitted to Heaven's judgment.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingshen day an edict said: "The rebel chieftains raised rebellion and have been struck down by Heaven's judgment.

sentences.zh: 絓誤之徒，宜從寬典。

translations.literal: Those who were ensnared in error should be dealt with under lenient statutes.
translations.idiomatic: Those who were drawn in against their will should be treated under lenient law.

sentences.zh: 其有悔悟來歸者，咸與勿治。

translations.literal: Those among them who repent and come forward in submission shall all be left unpunished.
translations.idiomatic: Any who repent and return in submission shall all be spared punishment.
Thus concluded the edict.

sentences.zh: 九月，上奉太皇太后幸湯泉，晉謁孝陵。

translations.literal: Ninth month: the emperor escorted the Grand Empress Dowager to the hot springs and proceeded to pay homage at Xiaoling.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month the emperor escorted the Grand Empress Dowager to the hot springs and went on to pay homage at Xiaoling.

sentences.zh: 姚啟聖、拉哈達大敗海寇於蜈蚣山，劉國軒遁，泉州圍解。

translations.literal: Yao Qisheng and Lahada inflicted a great defeat on the sea rebels at Wugong Mountain; Liu Guoxuan fled and the siege of Quanzhou was lifted.
translations.idiomatic: Yao Qisheng and Lahada routed the sea rebels at Wugong Mountain; Liu Guoxuan fled and the siege of Quanzhou was raised.

sentences.zh: 冬十月癸未，上巡近邊，次灤河，閱三屯營兵。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day guimao: the emperor toured the nearby frontier, halted at the Luan River, and reviewed the troops of the Santun garrison.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, on the guimao day of the tenth month, the emperor toured the nearby frontier, stopped at the Luan River, and reviewed the Santun garrison.

sentences.zh: 己丑，將軍鄂內敗吳應麒於石口。

translations.literal: Day jichou: General E'nei defeated Wu Yingqi at Shikou.
translations.idiomatic: On the jichou day General E'nei defeated Wu Yingqi at Shikou.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，皇四子胤禛生，是為世宗，母曰吳雅氏。

translations.literal: Day dingyou: the fourth imperial son Yinzhen was born — he who became the Shizong Emperor; his mother was of the Wu-ya clan.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day the fourth imperial son, Yinzhen, was born — the future Shizong Emperor; his mother was of the Wu-ya clan.

sentences.zh: 十一月己亥，拉哈達疏言海賊斷江東橋，兵援泉州難進。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day jihai: Lahada memorialized that sea bandits had cut the Jiangdong Bridge and that troops could not advance to relieve Quanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the jihai day, Lahada reported that sea rebels had severed the Jiangdong Bridge and that reinforcements for Quanzhou could not get through.

sentences.zh: 在籍侍讀學士李光地為大軍鄉導，修通險路，接濟軍需，請議敘。

translations.literal: Retired Attendant Reader Li Guangdi served as local guide for the main army, opened routes through difficult terrain, and supplied military provisions; a memorial was submitted recommending him for reward.
translations.idiomatic: Li Guangdi, an Attendant Reader on leave, guided the main army through the countryside, cleared difficult passes, and provisioned the troops; a memorial asked that he be rewarded.

sentences.zh: 得旨：「李光地前當變亂之初，密疏機宜。

translations.literal: Imperial rescript: "Earlier, at the outset of the rebellion, Li Guangdi secretly memorialized on strategy.
translations.idiomatic: An imperial rescript said: "At the very start of the uprising Li Guangdi sent a secret memorial on strategy.

sentences.zh: 茲又迎接大兵，備辦糧米，深為可嘉。

translations.literal: Now again he has received the main army and prepared grain and rice — conduct deeply praiseworthy.
translations.idiomatic: Now he has again received the main army and supplied grain and rice — conduct deeply worthy of praise.

sentences.zh: 即升授學士。

translations.literal: Let him be immediately promoted to Bachelor.
translations.idiomatic: Let him be promoted at once to Hanlin Bachelor.

sentences.zh: 」辛酉，上奉太皇太后還宮。

translations.literal: " Day xinyou: the emperor escorted the Grand Empress Dowager back to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: " On the xinyou day the emperor escorted the Grand Empress Dowager back to the palace.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，命福建陸路提督楊捷加昭武將軍，王之鼎為福建水師提督。

translations.literal: Day guihai: ordered Yang Jie, Fujian land-route Provincial Military Commander, to receive the additional title Illustrious Martial General; Wang Zhiding was made Fujian naval Provincial Military Commander.
translations.idiomatic: On the guihai day Yang Jie, Fujian land-route Provincial Military Commander, was given the additional rank of Illustrious Martial General, and Wang Zhiding was made Fujian naval Provincial Military Commander.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁亥，額楚、傅弘烈及吳世琮戰於藤縣，不利，退守梧州。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day dinghai: Etu, Fu Honglie, and others fought Wu Shigong at Teng County with an unfavorable outcome and withdrew to defend Wuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the dinghai day, Etu and Fu Honglie fought Wu Shigong at Teng County, were beaten, and fell back to hold Wuzhou.

sentences.zh: 乙未，祫祭太廟。

translations.literal: Day yiwei: the joint autumn offering was performed at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiwei day the joint autumn offering was performed at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 是歲，免直隸、江南、江西、湖廣等省七十州縣災賦有差。

translations.literal: That year land tax from disaster-stricken districts was remitted in varying degrees in seventy prefectures and counties of Zhili, Jiangnan, Jiangxi, Huguang, and other provinces.
