translations.idiomatic: That year land tax was remitted in varying degrees in seventy disaster-stricken prefectures and counties of Zhili, Jiangnan, Jiangxi, Huguang, and other provinces.

sentences.zh: 朝鮮、西洋入貢。

translations.literal: Korea and the Western Ocean offered tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Korea and the Western Ocean sent tribute missions.

sentences.zh: 十八年己未春正月戊申，遣官分賑山東、河南。

translations.literal: Eighteenth year, jiwei cycle year, spring first month, day wushen: officials were dispatched to distribute relief separately in Shandong and Henan.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year, the jiwei cycle year, on the wushen day of the first month of spring, officials were sent to distribute famine relief in Shandong and Henan.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，貝勒察尼督水師圍岳州，賊將吳應麒遁，復岳州。

translations.literal: Day jiayin: Prince Chani directed the river fleet in besieging Yuezhou; the rebel general Wu Yingqi fled and Yuezhou was recovered.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiayin day Prince Chani led the naval force in besieging Yuezhou; the rebel general Wu Yingqi fled and Yuezhou was recovered.

sentences.zh: 上御午門宣捷。

translations.literal: The emperor went to the Meridian Gate to proclaim victory.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor went to the Meridian Gate to proclaim the victory.

sentences.zh: 設隨征總兵官以處降將，旋裁之。

translations.literal: Campaign deputy commander-in-chief posts were established to handle surrendered generals, and were soon abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Deputy commander-in-chief posts for the campaign were set up to absorb surrendered generals and were soon abolished again.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，劉國軒犯長樂，總督姚啟聖偕紀爾他布、吳興祚擊敗之。

translations.literal: Day renxu: Liu Guoxuan attacked Changle; Governor-General Yao Qisheng together with Ji'ertaibu and Wu Xingzuo defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: On the renxu day Liu Guoxuan attacked Changle; Governor-General Yao Qisheng, together with Ji'ertaibu and Wu Xingzuo, defeated him.

sentences.zh: 甲子，岳樂復長沙。

translations.literal: Day jiazi: Prince An Yuele recovered Changsha.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiazi day Prince An Yuele recovered Changsha.

sentences.zh: 二月丙寅，傅弘烈戰吳世琮於梧州，賊遁。

translations.literal: Second month, day bingyin: Fu Honglie fought Wu Shigong at Wuzhou and the rebels fled.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingyin day of the second month Fu Honglie fought Wu Shigong at Wuzhou and the rebels fled.

sentences.zh: 己巳，詔數江西奸民從逆之罪，仍免其逋賦。

translations.literal: Day jisi: an edict enumerated the crimes of Jiangxi malcontents who followed the rebels, yet still remitted their tax arrears.
translations.idiomatic: On the jisi day an edict recounted the offenses of Jiangxi commoners who had joined the rebels, yet still remitted their tax arrears.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，順承郡王勒爾錦督兵過江，分復松滋、枝江、宜都、澧州，叛將洪福以舟師降。

translations.literal: Day jiaxu: Prince of Shuncheng Le'erjin led troops across the river and in separate columns recovered Songzi, Zhijiang, Yidou, and Lizhou; the rebel general Hong Fu surrendered with his river fleet.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiaxu day Prince of Shuncheng Le'erjin led his army across the Yangzi and recovered Songzi, Zhijiang, Yidou, and Lizhou in turn; the rebel general Hong Fu surrendered with his river force.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，簡親王喇布遣前鋒統領希佛復衡州，賊將吳國貴、夏國相遁。

translations.literal: Day wuyin: Prince Jian Labu sent Vanguard Commander Xifo to recover Hengzhou; the rebel generals Wu Guogui and Xia Guoxiang fled.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuyin day Prince Jian Labu sent Vanguard Commander Xifo to recover Hengzhou; the rebel generals Wu Guogui and Xia Guoxiang fled.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，詔軍前王大臣議進取雲、貴事宜。

translations.literal: Day gengchen: an edict ordered the princes and great ministers at the front to deliberate on advancing into Yunnan and Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengchen day an edict ordered the princes and great ministers with the army to deliberate on the advance into Yunnan and Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 以周有德為雲貴總督，桑峨為雲南提督，趙賴為貴州提督，並隨王師進討。

translations.literal: Zhou Youde was made Governor-General of Yunnan and Guizhou, Sang'e Yunnan Provincial Military Commander, and Zhao Lai Guizhou Provincial Military Commander, all to advance with the imperial army.
translations.idiomatic: Zhou Youde was appointed governor-general of Yunnan and Guizhou, Sang'e provincial military commander of Yunnan, and Zhao Lai provincial military commander of Guizhou, all to march with the main army.

sentences.zh: 以楊雍建為貴州巡撫。

translations.literal: Yang Yongjian was made Governor of Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Yongjian was appointed governor of Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 癸未，以誇扎為蒙古都統。

translations.literal: Day guimao: Kuazha was made Mongol commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day Kuazha was appointed Mongol commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 三月丙申朔，御試博學鴻詞於保和殿，授彭孫遹等五十人侍讀、侍講、編修、檢討等官。

translations.literal: Third month, bingchen new moon: the special examination for Erudite Scholars was held at the Hall of Preserving Harmony; Peng Sunyu and fifty others were given posts as Attendant Readers, Attendant Lecturers, compilers, revisers, and the like.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen new moon of the third month the special examination for Erudite Scholars was held in the Hall of Preserving Harmony; Peng Sunyu and fifty others were appointed Attendant Readers, Attendant Lecturers, compilers, revisers, and similar offices.

sentences.zh: 修《明史》，以學士徐元文、葉方藹、庶子張玉書為總裁。

translations.literal: The History of Ming was undertaken; Academicians Xu Yuanwen and Ye Fang'ai and Substantive Reader Zhang Yushu were made chief compilers.
translations.idiomatic: Work on the History of Ming was ordered; Academicians Xu Yuanwen and Ye Fang'ai and Substantive Reader Zhang Yushu were named chief compilers.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，上幸保定縣行圍。

translations.literal: Day dingyou: the emperor went to Baoding County for the hunting encampment.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day the emperor went to Baoding County for the hunting camp.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，以徐治都為湖廣提督。

translations.literal: Day jiachen: Xu Zhidu was made Huguang Provincial Military Commander.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiachen day Xu Zhidu was appointed Huguang provincial military commander.

sentences.zh: 將軍穆占擊吳國貴於永州，敗之，復永州、道州、永明。

translations.literal: General Muzhan attacked Wu Guogui at Yongzhou, defeated him, and recovered Yongzhou, Daozhou, and Yongming.
translations.idiomatic: General Muzhan attacked Wu Guogui at Yongzhou, routed him, and recovered Yongzhou, Daozhou, and Yongming.

sentences.zh: 己酉，上還宮。

translations.literal: Day jiyou: the emperor returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiyou day the emperor returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 戊午，賜歸允肅等百五十一人進士及第出身有差。

translations.literal: Day wuwu: Gui Yunshu and one hundred fifty-one others were granted differing ranks as jinshi who passed the palace examination.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuwu day Gui Yunshu and one hundred fifty-one others received jinshi honors with graded ranks according to their examination placement.

sentences.zh: 庚申，岳州陣歿諸將喪至，遣侍衛迎奠。

translations.literal: Day gengshen: the coffins of generals killed at Yuezhou arrived; palace guards were sent to receive and offer sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengshen day the coffins of generals killed at Yuezhou arrived; palace guards were dispatched to receive them and offer sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 福建陣沒將士喪至亦如之。

translations.literal: The coffins of officers and soldiers killed in Fujian who arrived were treated in the same way.
translations.idiomatic: The coffins of officers and soldiers killed in Fujian were received and honored in the same manner.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丙寅，以楊茂勛為四川總督，駐鄖陽。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day bingyin: Yang Maoxun was made Governor-General of Sichuan, stationed at Xiangyang.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, on the bingyin day of the fourth month, Yang Maoxun was appointed governor-general of Sichuan with headquarters at Xiangyang.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，以萬正色為福建水師提督。

translations.literal: Day wuchen: Wan Zhengse was made Fujian naval Provincial Military Commander.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuchen day Wan Zhengse was appointed Fujian naval provincial military commander.

sentences.zh: 己卯，旱甚，上步禱於天壇。

translations.literal: Day jimao: drought being severe, the emperor walked in person to pray at the Altar of Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: On the jimao day, with drought severe, the emperor walked in person to pray at the Altar of Heaven.

sentences.zh: 是日，大雨。

translations.literal: That day heavy rain fell.
translations.idiomatic: That day heavy rain fell.

sentences.zh: 莽依圖擊吳世琮於潯州，敗走之。

translations.literal: Mangyitu attacked Wu Shigong at Xunzhou and routed him.
translations.idiomatic: Mangyitu attacked Wu Shigong at Xunzhou and drove him off.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，上出阜成門觀禾。

translations.literal: Day renyin: the emperor went out Fucheng Gate to view the grain.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin day the emperor went out Fucheng Gate to inspect the crops.

sentences.zh: 五月庚戌，劉國軒犯江東橋，賴塔大戰敗之。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day gengxu: Liu Guoxuan attacked the Jiangdong Bridge; Laita fought a great battle and defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu day of the fifth month Liu Guoxuan attacked the Jiangdong Bridge; Laita fought a major battle and defeated him.

sentences.zh: 六月辛未，詔曰：「盛治之世，餘一餘三。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day xinwei, edict: "In an age of great governance, reserves exceed one part in three.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinwei day of the sixth month an edict said: "In a well-governed age the granaries hold a surplus of one part in three.

sentences.zh: 蓋倉廩足而禮教興，水旱乃可無虞。

translations.literal: When the storehouses are full, rites and instruction flourish, and flood or drought need cause no fear.
translations.idiomatic: When the granaries are full, ritual and moral teaching flourish, and flood or drought need not be feared.

sentences.zh: 比聞小民不知積蓄，一逢歉歲，率致流移。

translations.literal: Recently it is heard that the common people do not know how to save; at the first lean year they tend to drift away.
translations.idiomatic: Of late we hear that common people do not know how to save; at the first bad harvest they tend to become refugees.

sentences.zh: 夫興儉化民，食時用禮，惟良有司是賴。

translations.literal: To promote frugality and transform the people, to eat in season and use rites — this depends on good local officials.
translations.idiomatic: To promote thrift and transform the people, to eat in season and observe ritual — all this depends on capable local officials.

sentences.zh: 督撫等其選吏教民，用副朕意。

translations.literal: Governors-general and governors should select officials to instruct the people, in accord with Our intent.
translations.idiomatic: Governors-general and governors must choose officers to teach the people, in fulfillment of Our intent.

sentences.zh: 」己卯，以希佛為蒙古都統。

translations.literal: " Day jimao: Xifo was made Mongol commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: " On the jimao day Xifo was appointed Mongol commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 秋七月甲午，靳輔疏報淮揚壩工成，涸出田地，招民種之。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day jiawu: Jin Fu memorialized that the Huai-Yang embankment works were complete, land had been drained, and people were summoned to plant it.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, on the jiawu day of the seventh month, Jin Fu reported that the Huai-Yang dike works were finished, fields had been reclaimed from the water, and settlers were being recruited to farm them.

sentences.zh: 丁未，上視純親王隆禧疾。

translations.literal: Day dingwei: the emperor visited Prince Chun Longxi in his illness.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingwei day the emperor visited Prince Chun Longxi, who was ill.

sentences.zh: 隆禧薨。

translations.literal: Longxi died.
translations.idiomatic: Longxi died.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，額楚敗吳世琮於南寧，世琮遁。

translations.literal: Day yimao: Etu defeated Wu Shigong at Nanning and Shigong fled.
translations.idiomatic: On the yimao day Etu defeated Wu Shigong at Nanning and Shigong fled.

sentences.zh: 庚申，京師地震，詔發內帑十萬賑恤，被震廬舍官修之。

translations.literal: Day gengshen: an earthquake struck the capital; an edict ordered one hundred thousand taels from the privy purse for relief, and official repair of dwellings damaged in the quake.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengshen day an earthquake struck the capital; an edict ordered one hundred thousand taels from the privy purse for relief and official repair of houses damaged in the tremor.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，召廷臣諭曰：「朕躬不德，政治未協，致茲地震示警。

translations.literal: Day renxu: the emperor summoned the court ministers and addressed them: "Our person lacks virtue; government is not in harmony, bringing this earthquake as a warning.
translations.idiomatic: On the renxu day the emperor summoned the ministers of court and said: "My person lacks virtue; policy is not in harmony, and this earthquake comes as a warning.

sentences.zh: 悚息靡寧，勤求致災之由。

translations.literal: Trembling and ill at ease, We diligently seek the cause of the calamity.
translations.idiomatic: Uneasy and unable to rest, I diligently seek what has brought on this disaster.

sentences.zh: 豈牧民之官苛取以行媚歟？

translations.literal: Is it that local officials harshly exact levies to curry favor?
translations.idiomatic: Is it that local officials extort harshly to win favor?

sentences.zh: 大臣或朋黨比周引用私人歟？

translations.literal: Or that great ministers form factions and bands, advancing their private followers?
translations.idiomatic: Or that great ministers form factions and cliques, advancing their private followers?

sentences.zh: 領兵官焚掠勿禁歟？

translations.literal: Or that commanders in the field burn and plunder without restraint?
translations.idiomatic: Or that field commanders burn and plunder without restraint?

sentences.zh: 蠲租給復不以實歟？

translations.literal: Or that tax remissions and relief are not carried out in fact?
translations.idiomatic: Or that tax remissions and relief grants are not carried out in fact?

sentences.zh: 問刑官聽訟或枉平民歟？

translations.literal: Or that judicial officers in hearing cases wrong the common people?
translations.idiomatic: Or that magistrates in hearing cases wrong innocent commoners?

sentences.zh: 王公大臣未能束其下致侵小民歟？

translations.literal: Or that princes and great ministers fail to restrain their subordinates, allowing injury to the humble?
translations.idiomatic: Or that princes and great ministers fail to restrain their subordinates and allow harm to common people?

sentences.zh: 有一於此，皆足致災。

translations.literal: If any one of these obtains, it is enough to bring calamity.
translations.idiomatic: If any one of these is true, it is enough to bring disaster.

sentences.zh: 惟在大法而小廉，政平而訟理，庶幾仰格穹蒼，弭消沴戾。

translations.literal: Only by upholding the great law and small integrity, by governing peacefully and settling litigation, may We perhaps reach up to Heaven and quell the evil portent.
translations.idiomatic: Only by holding to the great law in small matters, by governing in peace and settling suits justly, may we perhaps move Heaven and dispel this evil sign.

sentences.zh: 用是昭布朕心，原與中外大小臣工共勉之。

translations.literal: Therefore We make known Our heart, wishing to exhort ourselves together with great and small officials within and without the court.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore I make known my heart, wishing to exhort myself together with officials great and small, within the court and without.
Thus concluded the address.

sentences.zh: 八月癸亥朔，將軍穆占復新寧。

translations.literal: Eighth month, guihai new moon: General Muzhan recovered Xinning.
translations.idiomatic: On the guihai new moon of the eighth month General Muzhan recovered Xinning.

sentences.zh: 甲子，傅弘烈復柳城、融縣。

translations.literal: Day jiazi: Fu Honglie recovered Liucheng and Rong County.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiazi day Fu Honglie recovered Liucheng and Rong County.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，提督趙國祚、將軍林興珠大破吳國貴於武岡，國貴死，復武岡州。

translations.literal: Day gengchen: Provincial Military Commander Zhao Guozuo and General Lin Xingzhu inflicted a great defeat on Wu Guogui at Wugang; Guogui died and Wugang Prefecture was recovered.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengchen day Provincial Military Commander Zhao Guozuo and General Lin Xingzhu routed Wu Guogui at Wugang; Guogui was killed and Wugang Prefecture was recovered.

sentences.zh: 九月庚戌，以地震禱於天壇。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day gengxu: because of the earthquake, prayer was offered at the Altar of Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu day of the ninth month prayers were offered at the Altar of Heaven because of the earthquake.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，命簡親王喇布守桂林。

translations.literal: Day xinhai: Prince Jian Labu was ordered to hold Guilin.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinhai day Prince Jian Labu was ordered to defend Guilin.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，金光祖執叛鎮祖澤清送京，及其子良楩磔誅之。

translations.literal: Day jiayin: Jin Guangzu seized the rebel commander Zu Zeqing and sent him to the capital; he and his son Liangfen were executed by dismemberment.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiayin day Jin Guangzu seized the rebel commander Zu Zeqing and sent him to the capital; Zeqing and his son Liangfen were executed by dismemberment.

sentences.zh: 冬十月辛未，詔將軍張勇、王進寶，提督趙良棟、孫思克取四川。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day xinwei: an edict ordered Generals Zhang Yong and Wang Jinbao and Provincial Military Commanders Zhao Liangdong and Sun Sike to take Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, on the xinwei day of the tenth month, an edict ordered Generals Zhang Yong and Wang Jinbao and provincial military commanders Zhao Liangdong and Sun Sike to recover Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 王進寶、趙良棟行。

translations.literal: Wang Jinbao and Zhao Liangdong marched.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Jinbao and Zhao Liangdong took the field.

sentences.zh: 癸未，王進寶克武關，復鳳縣。

translations.literal: Day guimao: Wang Jinbao took Wuguan and recovered Feng County.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day Wang Jinbao captured Wuguan and recovered Feng County.

sentences.zh: 趙良棟復兩當。

translations.literal: Zhao Liangdong recovered Liangdang.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Liangdong recovered Liangdang.

sentences.zh: 十一月戊戌，王進寶擊叛將王屏籓，遁之廣元，復漢中。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day wuxu: Wang Jinbao attacked the rebel general Wang Pingfan, drove him to Guangyuan, and recovered Hanzhong.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the wuxu day, Wang Jinbao attacked the rebel general Wang Pingfan, drove him toward Guangyuan, and recovered Hanzhong.

sentences.zh: 庚子，趙良棟復略陽，進克陽平關。

translations.literal: Day gengzi: Zhao Liangdong recovered Lueyang and advanced to take Yangping Pass.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengzi day Zhao Liangdong recovered Lueyang and pressed on to capture Yangping Pass.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，以許貞為江西提督。

translations.literal: Day dingyou: Xu Zhen was made Jiangxi Provincial Military Commander.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day Xu Zhen was appointed Jiangxi provincial military commander.

sentences.zh: 十二月壬戌，以蔡毓榮為綏遠將軍，進定雲、貴。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day renxu: Cai Yurong was made Pacifying-the-Distant General and ordered to advance and settle Yunnan and Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the renxu day, Cai Yurong was appointed Pacifying-the-Distant General and ordered to advance and settle Yunnan and Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 將軍佛尼勒、吳丹克梁河關，賊將韓晉卿遁，復興安、平利、紫陽、石泉、漢陰、洵陽、白河及鄖陽之竹山、竹溪。

translations.literal: Generals Fonile and Wu Dan took Lianghe Pass; the rebel general Han Jinqing fled; Xing'an, Pingli, Ziyang, Shiquan, Hanyin, Xunyang, Baihe, and Zhushan and Zhuxi in Yunyang were recovered.
translations.idiomatic: Generals Fonile and Wu Dan captured Lianghe Pass; the rebel general Han Jinqing fled; Xing'an, Pingli, Ziyang, Shiquan, Hanyin, Xunyang, Baihe, and Zhushan and Zhuxi in Yunyang were all recovered.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，上幸南苑。

translations.literal: Day dingmao: the emperor went to the Southern Park.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingmao day the emperor went to the Southern Park.

sentences.zh: 辛未，詔安親王岳樂率林興珠班師。

translations.literal: Day xinwei: an edict ordered Prince An Yuele to lead Lin Xingzhu in withdrawing the army.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinwei day an edict ordered Prince An Yuele to lead Lin Xingzhu in withdrawing the army.

sentences.zh: 壬午，授趙良棟勇略將軍。

translations.literal: Day renwu: Zhao Liangdong was given the title Brave Strategist General.
translations.idiomatic: On the renwu day Zhao Liangdong was granted the rank of Brave Strategist General.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，祫祭太廟。

translations.literal: Day yichou: the joint autumn offering was performed at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day the joint autumn offering was performed at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 是歲，免順天、江南、山東、山西、河南、浙江、湖廣等省二百六十一州縣災賦有差。

translations.literal: That year land tax from disaster-stricken districts was remitted in varying degrees in two hundred sixty-one prefectures and counties of Shuntian, Jiangnan, Shandong, Shanxi, Henan, Zhejiang, Huguang, and other provinces.
translations.idiomatic: That year land tax was remitted in varying degrees in two hundred sixty-one disaster-stricken prefectures and counties of Shuntian, Jiangnan, Shandong, Shanxi, Henan, Zhejiang, Huguang, and other provinces.

sentences.zh: 朝鮮、琉球、安南入貢。

translations.literal: Korea, Ryukyu, and Annam offered tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Korea, Ryukyu, and Annam sent tribute missions.

sentences.zh: 十九年庚申春正月甲午，趙良棟復龍安府，進至綿竹，偽巡撫張文等迎降，遂入成都。

translations.literal: Nineteenth year, gengshen cycle year, spring first month, day jiawu: Zhao Liangdong recovered Long'an Prefecture, advanced to Mianzhu; the false governor Zhang Wen and others came forward to surrender, and he then entered Chengdu.
translations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth year, the gengshen cycle year, on the jiawu day of the first month of spring, Zhao Liangdong recovered Long'an Prefecture and advanced to Mianzhu; the puppet governor Zhang Wen and others came out to surrender, and he then entered Chengdu.

sentences.zh: 詔以良棟為雲貴總督。

translations.literal: An edict made Liangdong Governor-General of Yunnan and Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: An edict appointed Liangdong governor-general of Yunnan and Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 王進寶克朝天關，復廣元，王屏籓縊死，生擒吳之茂。

translations.literal: Wang Jinbao took Chaotian Pass, recovered Guangyuan; Wang Pingfan hanged himself; Wu Zhimao was captured alive.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Jinbao captured Chaotian Pass and recovered Guangyuan; Wang Pingfan hanged himself and Wu Zhimao was taken alive.

sentences.zh: 壬子，上幸鞏華城，遣內大臣賜奠昭勛公圖賴墓。

translations.literal: Day renzi: the emperor visited Gonghua City and dispatched an inner minister to offer sacrificial gifts at the tomb of Duke Zhaoxun Tulai.
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi day the emperor went to Gonghua City and sent an inner minister to offer sacrifice at the tomb of Duke Zhaoxun Tulai.

sentences.zh: 二月辛酉朔，詔吳丹會趙良棟進取雲南，王進寶鎮四川，勒爾錦取重慶，徐治都守荊州。

translations.literal: Second month, new moon on xinyou: an edict ordered Wu Dan to join Zhao Liangdong in advancing on Yunnan; Wang Jinbao to garrison Sichuan; Le'erjin to take Chongqing; Xu Zhidu to hold Jingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinyou new moon of the second month an edict ordered Wu Dan to unite with Zhao Liangdong in the advance on Yunnan, Wang Jinbao to garrison Sichuan, Le'erjin to take Chongqing, and Xu Zhidu to hold Jingzhou.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，佛尼勒收順慶府，潼川、中江、南部、蓬縣、廣安、西充諸縣悉下。

translations.literal: Day yichou: Foniule recovered Shunqing prefecture; Tongchuan, Zhongjiang, Nanbu, Peng county, Guang'an, Xichong, and other counties all fell.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day Foniule recovered Shunqing prefecture; Tongchuan, Zhongjiang, Nanbu, Peng county, Guang'an, Xichong, and the rest of the counties submitted.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，詔莽依圖督馬九玉、金光祖、高承廕進兵雲南。

translations.literal: Day dingmao: an edict ordered Mangyitu to supervise Ma Jiuyu, Jin Guangzu, and Gao Chengyin in advancing on Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingmao day an edict directed Mangyitu to command Ma Jiuyu, Jin Guangzu, and Gao Chengyin in the march on Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 己巳，上幸南苑。

translations.literal: Day jisi: the emperor visited the Southern Park.
translations.idiomatic: On the jisi day the emperor visited the Southern Park.

sentences.zh: 丙子，大閱。

translations.literal: Day bingzi: great review of troops.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingzi day a grand military review was held.

sentences.zh: 以于成龍為直隸巡撫。

translations.literal: Yu Chenglong was appointed Zhili governor.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Chenglong was appointed governor of Zhili.

sentences.zh: 徐治都大敗叛將楊來嘉，復巫山，進取夔州。

translations.literal: Xu Zhidu greatly defeated the rebel general Yang Laijia, recovered Wushan, and advanced to take Kuizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Zhidu routed the rebel general Yang Laijia, recovered Wushan, and pressed on toward Kuizhou.

sentences.zh: 楊茂勛復大昌、大寧。

translations.literal: Yang Maoxun recovered Dachang and Daning.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Maoxun recovered Dachang and Daning.

sentences.zh: 癸未，萬正色敗海寇于海壇。

translations.literal: Day guiwei: Wan Zhengse defeated sea rebels at Haitan.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiwei day Wan Zhengse defeated sea rebels at Haitan.

sentences.zh: 三月辛卯，吳丹復重慶，達州、奉鄉諸州縣悉定。

translations.literal: Third month, day xinmao: Wu Dan recovered Chongqing; Dazhou, Fengxiang, and other prefectures and counties were all pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinmao day of the third month Wu Dan recovered Chongqing; Dazhou, Fengxiang, and the surrounding prefectures and counties were all secured.

sentences.zh: 楊來嘉降，送京。

translations.literal: Yang Laijia submitted and was sent to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Laijia surrendered and was sent to the capital.

sentences.zh: 乙未，以伊闢為雲南巡撫。

translations.literal: Day yiwei: Yi Bi was appointed Yunnan governor.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiwei day Yi Bi was appointed governor of Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，安親王岳樂師旋，上勞於蘆溝橋。

translations.literal: Day dingyou: Prince An Yuele's army returned; the emperor received them with honors at the Lugou Bridge.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day Prince An Yuele's army returned; the emperor received them with honors at the Lugou Bridge.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，馬承廕誘執傅弘烈。

translations.literal: Day xinchou: Ma Chengyin treacherously seized Fu Honglie.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinchou day Ma Chengyin lured Fu Honglie into custody.

sentences.zh: 先是，馬雄踞柳州，死，其子承廕以柳州降。

translations.literal: Earlier Ma Xiong had held Liuzhou; after his death his son Chengyin surrendered Liuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Ma Xiong had held Liuzhou; when he died his son Chengyin surrendered the city.

sentences.zh: 至是，復叛，執弘烈送貴陽，不屈，死之。

translations.literal: Now he rebelled again, seized Honglie and sent him to Guiyang; Honglie refused to submit and was put to death.
translations.idiomatic: Now he rose again, seized Honglie and sent him to Guiyang; Honglie would not yield and was killed.

sentences.zh: 平南將軍賴塔復銅山，命守潮州備承廕。

translations.literal: Pacifying-the-South General Laita recovered Tongshan and was ordered to hold Chaozhou against Chengyin.
translations.idiomatic: Pacifying-the-South General Laita recovered Tongshan and was ordered to garrison Chaozhou against Chengyin.

sentences.zh: 萬正色擊海寇於平海嶴，克之，進克湄州、南日、崇武諸嶴。

translations.literal: Wan Zhengse attacked sea rebels at Pinghai Ao, took it, and advanced to take Meizhou, Nanri, Chongwu, and other islets.
translations.idiomatic: Wan Zhengse attacked sea rebels at Pinghai Ao, took the position, and went on to recover Meizhou, Nanri, Chongwu, and the other coastal islets.

sentences.zh: 朱天貴降。

translations.literal: Zhu Tiangui submitted.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Tiangui surrendered.

sentences.zh: 拉哈達擊劉國軒，敗之，遁廈門。

translations.literal: Lahada attacked Liu Guoxuan, defeated him, and he fled to Xiamen.
translations.idiomatic: Lahada attacked Liu Guoxuan, defeated him, and drove him back to Xiamen.

sentences.zh: 偽將蘇堪迎降，進平玉洲、石馬、海澄、馬州等十九寨，復偕吳興祚取金門。

translations.literal: The false general Su Kan came over in submission; [forces] advanced to pacify Yuzhou, Shima, Haicheng, Mazhou, and nineteen other stockades, and together with Wu Xingzuo recovered Jinmen.
translations.idiomatic: The rebel general Su Kan came over; government troops advanced to pacify Yuzhou, Shima, Haicheng, Mazhou, and nineteen other stockades, and with Wu Xingzuo recovered Jinmen.

sentences.zh: 己酉，察尼下辰龍關，蔡毓榮復銅仁。

translations.literal: Day jiyou: Chani took Chenlong Pass; Cai Yurong recovered Tongren.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiyou day Chani took Chenlong Pass; Cai Yurong recovered Tongren.

sentences.zh: 夏四月庚申朔，以賴塔為滿洲都統。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, new moon on gengshen: Laita was appointed Manchu commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, on the gengshen new moon of the fourth month, Laita was appointed Manchu commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，穆占、董衛國敗吳應麒，復沅州、靖州，進復黎平。

translations.literal: Day guihai: Muzhan and Dong Weiguo defeated Wu Yingqi, recovered Yuan and Jing prefectures, and advanced to recover Liping.
translations.idiomatic: On the guihai day Muzhan and Dong Weiguo defeated Wu Yingqi, recovered Yuan and Jing prefectures, and went on to recover Liping.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，上以學士張英等供奉內廷，日備顧問，下部優敘，高士奇、杜訥均授翰林官。

translations.literal: Day dingmao: because Academicians Zhang Ying and others attended the inner court as daily advisers, the ministry was ordered to reward them preferentially; Gao Shiqi and Du Ne were both granted Hanlin posts.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingmao day, because Academicians Zhang Ying and others served in the inner court as daily advisers, the ministry was ordered to reward them with preferential promotion; Gao Shiqi and Du Ne were both given Hanlin appointments.

sentences.zh: 己巳，命南書房翰林每日晚講《通鑒》。

translations.literal: Day jisi: ordered Hanlin of the Southern Studios to lecture each evening on the Comprehensive Mirror.
translations.idiomatic: On the jisi day the emperor ordered Southern Studio Hanlin scholars to lecture each evening on the Comprehensive Mirror.

sentences.zh: 丙子，上祈雨天壇，翌日，雨。

translations.literal: Day bingzi: the emperor prayed for rain at the Altar of Heaven; the next day it rained.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingzi day the emperor prayed for rain at the Altar of Heaven; rain fell the next day.

sentences.zh: 己卯，頒行尚書講義。

translations.literal: Day jimao: the exegetical commentaries on the Documents were promulgated.
translations.idiomatic: On the jimao day the court promulgated the exegetical lectures on the Book of Documents.

sentences.zh: 王進寶以病回固原，以其子總兵用予統軍駐保寧。

translations.literal: Wang Jinbao returned to Guyuan on account of illness; his son the regional commander Yongyu was ordered to command the army stationed at Baoning.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Jinbao withdrew to Guyuan on account of illness; his son, Regional Commander Yongyu, was ordered to take command of the army at Baoning.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，宗人府進玉牒。

translations.literal: Day gengchen: the Imperial Clan Court presented the jade genealogy.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengchen day the Imperial Clan Court presented the jade genealogy register.

sentences.zh: 五月壬辰，命甘肅巡撫治蘭州。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day renchen: ordered the Gansu governor to take up administration at Lanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the renchen day of the fifth month the Gansu governor was ordered to establish his headquarters at Lanzhou.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，莽依圖會軍討馬承廕，復降，命執送京師。

translations.literal: Day yisi: Mangyitu united armies to punish Ma Chengyin; he submitted again and was ordered seized and sent to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On the yisi day Mangyitu combined forces against Ma Chengyin; Chengyin submitted again and was ordered seized and sent to the capital.

sentences.zh: 己酉，山海關設關收稅。

translations.literal: Day jiyou: Shanhaiguan was established as a customs post to collect duties.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiyou day a customs office was set up at Shanhaiguan to collect transit duties.

sentences.zh: 六月甲子，蔡毓榮復思南。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day jiazi: Cai Yurong recovered Sinan.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiazi day of the sixth month Cai Yurong recovered Sinan.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，命五城粥廠再展三月，遣太醫官三十員分治飢民疾疫。

translations.literal: Day dingchou: ordered the five-city gruel kitchens to be extended three more months and thirty imperial physicians dispatched to treat famine victims and plague separately.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingchou day the five-city gruel kitchens were extended three months, and thirty imperial physicians were sent out to treat famine sufferers and epidemic sickness by district.

sentences.zh: 壬午，副都統馬爾哈齊、營總馬順德以縱兵殺人論罪。

translations.literal: Day renwu: Vice Commander-in-Chief Marhaqi and battalion chief Mashunde were prosecuted for allowing troops to kill people.
translations.idiomatic: On the renwu day Vice Commander-in-Chief Marhaqi and battalion chief Mashunde were charged with having let their troops kill civilians.

sentences.zh: 秋七月甲午，停捐納官考選科道。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day jiawu: suspended the selection of censorial and supervisory posts through purchase offices.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, on the jiawu day of the seventh month, the purchase of offices leading to appointment as censor or surveillance commissioner was suspended.

sentences.zh: 褒恤福建總督范承謨、廣西巡撫馬雄鎮，贈官予諡廕。

translations.literal: Posthumously honored Fujian Governor-General Fan Chengmo and Guangxi Governor Ma Xiongzhen with offices, posthumous titles, and hereditary privileges.
translations.idiomatic: Fujian Governor-General Fan Chengmo and Guangxi Governor Ma Xiongzhen were posthumously honored with offices, posthumous titles, and hereditary privileges.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，以折爾肯為左都御史。

translations.literal: Day yisi: Zheerken was appointed Censor-in-Chief of the Left.
translations.idiomatic: On the yisi day Zheerken was appointed Censor-in-Chief of the Left.

sentences.zh: 己酉，解順承郡王勒爾錦大將軍，撤還京。

translations.literal: Day jiyou: relieved Prince Shuncheng Le'erjin of his grand generalship and recalled him to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiyou day Prince Shuncheng Le'erjin was relieved of his grand generalship and recalled to the capital.

sentences.zh: 八月戊辰，上御經筵。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day wuchen: the emperor presided at the classics lecture.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuchen day of the eighth month the emperor attended the classics lecture.

sentences.zh: 己巳，命賴塔移駐廣州，以博濟軍益之。

translations.literal: Day jisi: ordered Laita to transfer his headquarters to Guangzhou and augmented his force with the Boji army.
translations.idiomatic: On the jisi day Laita was ordered to move his headquarters to Guangzhou and his command was reinforced with the Boji army.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，大學士索額圖免。

translations.literal: Day wuyin: Grand Secretary Songgotu was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuyin day Grand Secretary Songgotu was dismissed from office.

sentences.zh: 壬午，將軍莽依圖卒于軍，以勒貝代之。

translations.literal: Day renwu: General Mangyitu died in the army; Lebei was appointed to replace him.
translations.idiomatic: On the renwu day General Mangyitu died in camp; Lebei was appointed in his place.

sentences.zh: 甲申，尚之信以屬人王國光訐告其罪，擅殺之，詔賜之信死。

translations.literal: Day jiashen: Shang Zhixin, because his subordinate Wang Guoguang denounced his crimes, killed him on his own authority; an edict ordered Shang Zhixin to die.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiashen day Shang Zhixin, after his subordinate Wang Guoguang denounced his crimes, killed him on his own authority; an edict ordered Shang Zhixin to take his own life.

sentences.zh: 其弟之節，其黨李天植，皆伏誅，家口護還京師。

translations.literal: His younger brother Zhijie and his adherent Li Tianzhi were all executed; their households were escorted back to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: His younger brother Zhijie and his follower Li Tianzhi were all executed; their families were escorted back to the capital under guard.

sentences.zh: 閏八月乙未，命各將帥善撫綠旗軍士。

translations.literal: Intercalary eighth month, day yiwei: ordered all commanders to treat Green Banner soldiers well.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiwei day of the intercalary eighth month all commanders were ordered to treat Green Banner troops with care.

sentences.zh: 壬子，以王永譽為廣東將軍。

translations.literal: Day renzi: Wang Yongyu was appointed Guangdong general.
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi day Wang Yongyu was appointed general of Guangdong.

sentences.zh: 九月癸亥，吳世璠使其將夏國柱、馬寶潛寇四川，譚弘復叛應之，連陷瀘州、永寧，夔州土匪應之。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day guihai: Wu Shifan sent his generals Xia Guozhu and Ma Bao to raid Sichuan in secret; Tan Hong rebelled again in response; they successively took Luzhou and Yongning; bandits in Kuizhou prefecture rose in support.
translations.idiomatic: On the guihai day of the ninth month Wu Shifan sent his generals Xia Guozhu and Ma Bao to strike into Sichuan by stealth; Tan Hong rebelled again in support; Luzhou and Yongning fell in succession, and bandits in Kuizhou joined them.

sentences.zh: 命將軍吳丹、噶爾漢，提督范達理、徐治都分道討之。

translations.literal: Ordered General Wu Dan, Garhan, and Grand Coordinators Fan Dali and Xu Zhidu to attack them by separate routes.
translations.idiomatic: Generals Wu Dan and Garhan and Grand Coordinators Fan Dali and Xu Zhidu were ordered to attack them on separate routes.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，以賴塔為平南大將軍，率師進雲南。

translations.literal: Day yichou: Laita was appointed Pacifying-the-South Grand General and ordered to lead an army into Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day Laita was made Pacifying-the-South Grand General and ordered to lead an army into Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，吳丹復瀘州。

translations.literal: Day wuyin: Wu Dan recovered Luzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuyin day Wu Dan recovered Luzhou.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，仁懷失守，罷吳丹，以鄂克濟哈領其軍。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month: Renhuai was lost; Wu Dan was dismissed and Ekejiha was ordered to take command of his army.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, in the tenth month, Renhuai was lost; Wu Dan was dismissed and Ekejiha was ordered to take over his army.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，以阿密達為蒙古都統。

translations.literal: Day wuxu: Amida was appointed Mongol commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuxu day Amida was appointed Mongol commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 噶爾漢復巫山。

translations.literal: Garhan recovered Wushan.
translations.idiomatic: Garhan recovered Wushan.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，大將軍康親王傑書師旋，上郊勞之。

translations.literal: Day renyin: the Grand General, Prince Kang Jieshu, returned with his army; the emperor received him with honors in the suburbs.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin day the Grand General, Prince Kang Jieshu, returned with his army; the emperor received him with honors outside the city.

sentences.zh: 戊申，彰泰、穆占敗吳世璠於鎮遠。

translations.literal: Day wushen: Zhangtai and Muzhan defeated Wu Shifan at Zhenyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On the wushen day Zhangtai and Muzhan defeated Wu Shifan at Zhenyuan.

sentences.zh: 噶爾漢擊譚弘於鐵開峽，敗之。

translations.literal: Garhan attacked Tan Hong at Iron Gate Pass and defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: Garhan attacked Tan Hong at Iron Gate Pass and routed him.

sentences.zh: 是月，王大臣議上師行玩誤之王貝勒大臣罪。

translations.literal: That month princes and great ministers submitted memorials listing the crimes of princes, beile, and great ministers who had been negligent on campaign.
translations.idiomatic: That month princes and great ministers memorialized the throne with charges against princes, beile, and senior officers who had failed in their duty on campaign.

sentences.zh: 得旨，勒爾錦革去王爵，籍沒羈禁。

translations.literal: Imperial rescript: Le'erjin was stripped of his princedom, his property confiscated, and he was held in detention.
translations.idiomatic: By imperial rescript Le'erjin was stripped of his princedom, his property was confiscated, and he was placed under detention.

sentences.zh: 尚善、察尼均革去貝勒。

translations.literal: Shangshan and Chani were both stripped of their beile ranks.
translations.idiomatic: Shangshan and Chani were both deprived of their beile titles.

sentences.zh: 蘭布革去鎮國公。

translations.literal: Lanbu was stripped of his Duke Who Guards the State rank.
translations.idiomatic: Lanbu was stripped of his rank as Duke Who Guards the State.

sentences.zh: 朱滿革去都統，立絞。

translations.literal: Zhu Man was stripped of his commander-in-chiefship and executed immediately by strangulation.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Man was removed as commander-in-chief and summarily strangled.

sentences.zh: 餘各褫官、奪世職、鞭責、籍沒有差。

translations.literal: The rest were variously dismissed, deprived of hereditary offices, flogged, and had property confiscated in differing degrees.
translations.idiomatic: The others were variously dismissed, stripped of hereditary posts, flogged, and had their property confiscated to differing degrees.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙辰朔，冬至，祀天於圜丘。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, new moon on bingchen: winter solstice; Heaven was worshipped at the Circular Mound.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen new moon of the eleventh month, at the winter solstice, Heaven was worshipped at the Circular Mound Altar.

sentences.zh: 彗星見，詔求直言。

translations.literal: A comet appeared; an edict solicited frank counsel.
translations.idiomatic: A comet appeared; an edict called for frank memorials from the officials.

sentences.zh: 甲子，貝子彰泰進復平越，遂入貴陽。

translations.literal: Day jiazi: Beile Zhangtai advanced to recover Pingyue and then entered Guiyang.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiazi day Beile Zhangtai advanced to recover Pingyue and then entered Guiyang.

sentences.zh: 逆渠吳世璠及吳應麒等夜遁。

translations.literal: The rebel leader Wu Shifan and Wu Yingqi and others fled by night.
translations.idiomatic: The rebel leader Wu Shifan, Wu Yingqi, and the rest fled by night.

sentences.zh: 安順、石阡、都勻三府皆下。

translations.literal: Anshun, Shiqian, and Duyun — all three prefectures — submitted.
translations.idiomatic: Anshun, Shiqian, and Duyun — all three prefectures — submitted.

sentences.zh: 庚午，以達哈里為蒙古都統。

translations.literal: Day gengwu: Daha'er was appointed Mongol commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengwu day Daha'er was appointed Mongol commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 丙子，川北總兵高孟敗彭時亨於南溪橋，復營山，進圍靈鷲寨，斬偽將魏卿武。

translations.literal: Day bingzi: Sichuan North Regional Commander Gao Meng defeated Peng Shiheng at Nanxi Bridge, recovered Yingshan, advanced to besiege Lingjiu Stockade, and beheaded the false general Wei Qingwu.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingzi day Sichuan North Regional Commander Gao Meng defeated Peng Shiheng at Nanxi Bridge, recovered Yingshan, advanced to besiege Lingjiu Stockade, and beheaded the rebel general Wei Qingwu.

sentences.zh: 甲申，提督周卜世復思南。

translations.literal: Day jiashen: Grand Coordinator Zhou Boshi recovered Sinan.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiashen day Grand Coordinator Zhou Boshi recovered Sinan.

sentences.zh: 十二月壬辰，以徐元文為左都御史。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day renchen: Xu Yuanwen was appointed Censor-in-Chief of the Left.
translations.idiomatic: On the renchen day of the twelfth month Xu Yuanwen was appointed Censor-in-Chief of the Left.

sentences.zh: 甲午，高孟復渠縣。

translations.literal: Day jiawu: Gao Meng recovered Qu county.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiawu day Gao Meng recovered Qu county.

sentences.zh: 乙未，提督桑峨大敗吳世璠於永寧，追至鐵索橋，賊焚橋遁。

translations.literal: Day yiwei: Grand Coordinator Sang'e greatly defeated Wu Shifan at Yongning, pursued him to the Iron-Chain Bridge; the rebels burned the bridge and fled.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiwei day Grand Coordinator Sang'e routed Wu Shifan at Yongning and pursued him to the Iron-Chain Bridge; the rebels burned the bridge and fled.

sentences.zh: 土官龍天祐、沙起龍造盤江浮橋濟大軍。

translations.literal: Native officials Long Tianyou and Sha Qilong built a pontoon bridge on the Pan River to ferry the main army across.
translations.idiomatic: The native officials Long Tianyou and Sha Qilong built a pontoon bridge on the Pan River to carry the main army across.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，高孟復廣安州。

translations.literal: Day renyin: Gao Meng recovered Guang'an prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin day Gao Meng recovered Guang'an prefecture.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，以郝浴為廣西巡撫。

translations.literal: Day gengxu: Hao Yu was appointed Guangxi governor.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu day Hao Yu was appointed governor of Guangxi.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，祫祭太廟。

translations.literal: Day guichou: combined seasonal sacrifice at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On the guichou day the combined seasonal sacrifice was performed at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 是歲，免直隸、江南、山東、山西、陝西、江西、福建、湖廣等省一百八十六州縣災賦有差。

translations.literal: That year land-tax relief was granted in differing degrees to 186 prefectures and counties stricken by disaster in Zhili, Jiangnan, Shandong, Shanxi, Shaanxi, Jiangxi, Fujian, Huguang, and other provinces.
translations.idiomatic: That year disaster land-tax remissions of varying amounts were granted to 186 prefectures and counties in Zhili, Jiangnan, Shandong, Shanxi, Shaanxi, Jiangxi, Fujian, Huguang, and other provinces.

sentences.zh: 朝鮮、琉球入貢。

translations.literal: Korea and Ryukyu sent tribute missions.
translations.idiomatic: Korea and Ryukyu sent tribute missions.

sentences.zh: 二十年辛酉春正月壬申，叛將李本深降，械送京師。

translations.literal: Twentieth year, xinyou, spring, first month, day renshen: the rebel general Li Benshen submitted and was sent to the capital in cangues.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year, on the renshen day of the first month of spring, the rebel general Li Benshen surrendered and was sent to the capital in the cangue.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，總兵高孟復達州。

translations.literal: Day guiyou: Regional Commander Gao Meng recovered Dazhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiyou day Regional Commander Gao Meng recovered Dazhou.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，將軍噶爾漢復雲陽，譚弘死，進復忠州、萬縣、開縣。

translations.literal: Day jiaxu: General Garhan recovered Yunyang; Tan Hong died; [the army] advanced to recover Zhong prefecture, Wan county, and Kai county.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiaxu day General Garhan recovered Yunyang; Tan Hong died; the army went on to recover Zhong prefecture, Wan county, and Kai county.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，命侍郎溫代治通州運河。

translations.literal: Day yihai: ordered Vice Minister Wen to take charge of repairing the Tongzhou canal.
translations.idiomatic: On the yihai day a vice minister surnamed Wen was ordered to supervise repairs on the Tongzhou canal.

sentences.zh: 丙子，將軍穆占、提督趙賴擊夏國相等，走之，復平遠。

translations.literal: Day bingzi: General Muzhan and Grand Coordinator Zhao Lai attacked Xia Guoxiang and others, routed them, and recovered Pingyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingzi day General Muzhan and Grand Coordinator Zhao Lai attacked Xia Guoxiang and his fellows, drove them off, and recovered Pingyuan.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，增置講官。

translations.literal: Day xinsi: additional lecture officials were appointed.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinsi day additional lecture officials were appointed.

sentences.zh: 詔法司慎刑。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the judiciary to apply punishments with care.
translations.idiomatic: An edict instructed the judiciary to exercise caution in imposing punishments.

sentences.zh: 是月，鄭錦死，其子克塽繼領所部。

translations.literal: That month Zheng Jing died; his son Keshuang succeeded to command of his forces.
translations.idiomatic: That month Zheng Jing died and his son Keshuang succeeded to leadership of his forces.

sentences.zh: 二月己丑，貝子彰泰師至安南衛，擊賊將線緎於江西坡。

translations.literal: Second month, day jichou: Beile Zhangtai's army reached Annan Guard and attacked the rebel general Xian Xu at Jiangxi Slope.
translations.idiomatic: On the jichou day of the second month Beile Zhangtai's army reached Annan Guard and attacked the rebel general Xian Xu at Jiangxi Slope.

sentences.zh: 賊列象陣拒戰。

translations.literal: The rebels formed an elephant battle line to resist.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels drew up an elephant formation to block the advance.

sentences.zh: 官兵分三隊奮擊，大破之。

translations.literal: Government troops divided into three columns and struck fiercely, routing them completely.
translations.idiomatic: Government troops split into three columns and attacked with force, breaking them completely.

sentences.zh: 賊遁，公圖、達漢泰追擊，復敗之，復普安州、新興所。

translations.literal: The rebels fled; Gongtu and Daha'ertai pursued, defeated them again, and recovered Pu'an prefecture and Xinxing post.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels fled; Gongtu and Daha'ertai pursued, defeated them again, and recovered Pu'an prefecture and Xinxing post.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，副都統莽奕祿敗賊張足法等於三山。

translations.literal: Day renchen: Vice Commander-in-Chief Mangyilu defeated the rebels Zhang Fufa and others at Sanshan.
translations.idiomatic: On the renchen day Vice Commander-in-Chief Mangyilu defeated the rebels Zhang Fufa and others at Sanshan.

sentences.zh: 甲午，詔凡三籓往事為民害者悉除之。

translations.literal: Day jiawu: an edict declared that all past abuses of the people stemming from the Three Feudatories were to be abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiawu day an edict declared that every levy and abuse left over from the Three Feudatories that had harmed the people was to be abolished.

sentences.zh: 蠲奉天鹽引。

translations.literal: Salt certificates for Fengtian were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Salt certificates for Fengtian were remitted.

sentences.zh: 大將軍賴塔師至廣西，大破賊於黃草壩，復安籠，入曲靖。

translations.literal: Grand General Laita's army reached Guangxi, routed the rebels at Huangcao Dam, recovered Anlong, and entered Qujing.
translations.idiomatic: Grand General Laita's army reached Guangxi, routed the rebels at Huangcao Dam, recovered Anlong, and entered Qujing.

sentences.zh: 高孟復東鄉，敗彭時亨於月城寨。

translations.literal: Gao Meng recovered Dongxiang and defeated Peng Shiheng at Yuecheng Stockade.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Meng recovered Dongxiang and defeated Peng Shiheng at Yuecheng Stockade.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，增欽天監滿監副一員。

translations.literal: Day wuxu: one additional Manchu deputy director was added to the Directorate of Astronomy.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuxu day one additional Manchu deputy director was added to the Directorate of Astronomy.

sentences.zh: 都統希福、馬緝、碩塔復馬龍州、楊林城，入嵩明州，賊遁。

translations.literal: Banner Commander-in-Chief Xifu, Ma Ji, and Shuota recovered Malong Prefecture and Yanglin City, entered Songming Prefecture, and the rebels fled.
translations.idiomatic: Banner Commander-in-Chief Xifu, Ma Ji, and Shuota recovered Malong Prefecture and Yanglin City, advanced into Songming Prefecture, and the rebels fled.

sentences.zh: 穆占復黔西、大定，斬其偽將張維堅。

translations.literal: Muzhan recovered Qianxi and Dading and beheaded the rebel general Zhang Weijian.
translations.idiomatic: Muzhan recovered Qianxi and Dading and beheaded the rebel general Zhang Weijian.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，貝子彰泰、大將軍賴塔、將軍蔡毓榮先後入滇。

translations.literal: Day yisi: Prince of the Blood Zhangtai, Grand General Laita, and General Cai Yurong entered Yunnan in succession.
translations.idiomatic: On the yisi day Prince Zhangtai, Grand General Laita, and General Cai Yurong entered Yunnan in succession.

sentences.zh: 賊將胡國柄、劉起龍迎拒，官軍分擊敗之，斬國柄、起龍。

translations.literal: Rebel generals Hu Guobing and Liu Qilong came out to resist; government troops attacked in separate columns, defeated them, and beheaded Guobing and Qilong.
translations.idiomatic: Rebel generals Hu Guobing and Liu Qilong came out to resist; government troops attacked in separate columns, defeated them, and beheaded Guobing and Qilong.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，謁孝陵。

translations.literal: Day xinhai: the emperor visited the Xiaoling Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinhai day the emperor visited the Xiaoling Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 三月甲辰，宣威將軍鄂克濟哈以失援建昌自劾。

translations.literal: Third month, day jiachen: Pacifying-Prestige General E Kejiha impeached himself for failing to relieve Jianchang.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiachen day of the third month, Pacifying-Prestige General E Kejiha impeached himself for failing to relieve Jianchang.

sentences.zh: 詔以覺羅紀哈里代之。

translations.literal: An edict appointed the Aisin Gioro Jihali to replace him.
translations.idiomatic: An edict appointed the Aisin Gioro Jihali to replace him.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，葬仁孝皇后、孝昭皇后於昌瑞山陵。

translations.literal: Day xiyou: Empresses Renxiao and Xiaozhao were interred at the Changrui Mountain mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: On the xiyou day Empresses Renxiao and Xiaozhao were interred at the Changrui Mountain mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 詔行在批閱章奏，令大學士審校。

translations.literal: An edict ordered memorials to be reviewed at the traveling palace and directed grand secretaries to examine them.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered memorials reviewed at the traveling palace and directed the grand secretaries to examine them.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，胡國柱犯建昌，將軍佛尼勒擊走之，復馬湖。

translations.literal: Day renxu: Hu Guozhu attacked Jianchang; General Foenile routed him and recovered Mahu.
translations.idiomatic: On the renxu day Hu Guozhu attacked Jianchang; General Foenile routed him and recovered Mahu.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，馬寶棄遵義，犯瀘、敘。

translations.literal: Day guihai: Ma Bao abandoned Zunyi and raided Luzhou and Xuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the guihai day Ma Bao abandoned Zunyi and raided Luzhou and Xuzhou.

sentences.zh: 詔佛尼勒、趙良棟急擊滇賊，勿令回援。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Foenile and Zhao Liangdong to press the Yunnan rebels urgently and not let them return to reinforce.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Foenile and Zhao Liangdong to press the Yunnan rebels urgently and not allow them to return and reinforce.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，贈恤福建死事運使高天爵、知府張瑞午等官廕。

translations.literal: Day bingyin: posthumous honors and hereditary appointments were granted to Transport Commissioner Gao Tianjue of Fujian and Prefect Zhang Ruwu and others who died in service.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingyin day posthumous honors and hereditary appointments were granted to Transport Commissioner Gao Tianjue of Fujian, Prefect Zhang Ruwu, and others who died in service.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，土官陸道清以永寧降。

translations.literal: Day wuchen: the native official Lu Daoqing surrendered Yongning.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuchen day the native official Lu Daoqing surrendered Yongning.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，上奉太皇太后幸遵化湯泉。

translations.literal: Day guiyou: the emperor escorted the Grand Empress Dowager to the hot springs at Zunhua.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiyou day the emperor escorted the Grand Empress Dowager to the hot springs at Zunhua.

sentences.zh: 夏四月甲辰朔，王用予復納谿、江安、仁懷、合江。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, first day jiachen: Wang Yongyu recovered Naxi, Jiang'an, Renhuai, and Hejiang.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, on the first day, jiachen, of the fourth month, Wang Yongyu recovered Naxi, Jiang'an, Renhuai, and Hejiang.

sentences.zh: 己酉，貝子彰泰遣使招撫諸路，武定、大理、臨安、永順、姚安皆降。

translations.literal: Day jiyou: Prince Zhangtai sent envoys to pacify the routes; Wuding, Dali, Lin'an, Yongshun, and Yao'an all submitted.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiyou day Prince Zhangtai sent envoys to pacify the routes; Wuding, Dali, Lin'an, Yongshun, and Yao'an all submitted.

sentences.zh: 壬子，上奉太皇太后還宮。

translations.literal: Day renzi: the emperor escorted the Grand Empress Dowager back to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi day the emperor escorted the Grand Empress Dowager back to the palace.

sentences.zh: 五月癸丑朔，提督周卜世取遵義，降偽官金仕俊等，復真安州、仁懷、桐梓、綏陽等縣。

translations.literal: Fifth month, first day guichou: Regional Commander Zhou Bushi took Zunyi, accepted the surrender of the rebel officials Jin Shijun and others, and recovered Zhen'an Prefecture and the counties Renhuai, Tongzi, Suiyang, and others.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day, guichou, of the fifth month, Regional Commander Zhou Bushi took Zunyi, accepted the surrender of the rebel officials Jin Shijun and others, and recovered Zhen'an Prefecture and the counties Renhuai, Tongzi, Suiyang, and others.

sentences.zh: 己未，遣官察閱蒙古蘇尼特等旗被旱災狀。

translations.literal: Day jiwei: officials were dispatched to inspect drought damage among the Sonit and other Mongol banners.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiwei day officials were dispatched to inspect drought damage among the Sonit and other Mongol banners.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，詔行取州縣曾陷賊中者勿選科道。

translations.literal: Day yichou: an edict declared that officials from districts once occupied by rebels should not be selected for censorial posts.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day an edict declared that officials from districts once occupied by rebels should not be selected for censorial posts.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，大將軍貝子彰泰報抵雲南省城，偽將李發美以鶴慶、麗江二府降。

translations.literal: Day xinsi: Grand General Prince Zhangtai reported reaching the Yunnan provincial capital; the rebel general Li Famei surrendered Heqing and Lijiang prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinsi day Grand General Prince Zhangtai reported reaching the Yunnan provincial capital; the rebel general Li Famei surrendered Heqing and Lijiang prefectures.

sentences.zh: 六月戊子，除山西、陝西房號銀。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day wuzi: the house-number silver levy was abolished in Shanxi and Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day of the sixth month the house-number silver levy was abolished in Shanxi and Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丁巳，以禮部尚書郭四海兼管刑部。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day dingsi: Minister of Rites Guo Sihai was additionally placed in charge of the Ministry of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, on the dingsi day of the seventh month, Minister of Rites Guo Sihai was additionally placed in charge of the Ministry of Punishments.

sentences.zh: 庚申，詔四川民田為弁兵所佔者察還之。

translations.literal: Day gengshen: an edict directed that civilian farmland in Sichuan occupied by banner soldiers be investigated and restored.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengshen day an edict directed that civilian farmland in Sichuan occupied by banner soldiers be investigated and restored.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，都統希福、提督桑峨擊馬寶於烏木山，大敗之。

translations.literal: Day xinyou: Banner Commander-in-Chief Xifu and Regional Commander Sang E attacked Ma Bao at Wumu Mountain and routed him utterly.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinyou day Banner Commander-in-Chief Xifu and Regional Commander Sang E attacked Ma Bao at Wumu Mountain and routed him utterly.

sentences.zh: 馬寶降，械送京師誅之。

translations.literal: Ma Bao surrendered, was sent to the capital in the cangue, and was executed.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Bao surrendered, was sent to the capital in the cangue, and was executed.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，趙良棟遣總兵李芳述擊敗胡國柱，復建昌，入雲南。

translations.literal: Day yichou: Zhao Liangdong sent Brigade Commander Li Fangshu to defeat Hu Guozhu, recover Jianchang, and enter Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day Zhao Liangdong sent Brigade Commander Li Fangshu to defeat Hu Guozhu, recover Jianchang, and enter Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，詔圖海率王輔臣還京。

translations.literal: Day wuchen: an edict ordered Tu Hai to return to the capital with Wang Fuchen.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuchen day an edict ordered Tu Hai to return to the capital with Wang Fuchen.

sentences.zh: 壬申，賜宴瀛台，員外郎以上皆與焉，賜綵幣。

translations.literal: Day renshen: a banquet was given at Yingtai; all officials from assistant department director upward attended, and colored silks were granted.
translations.idiomatic: On the renshen day a banquet was given at Yingtai; all officials from assistant department director upward attended, and colored silks were granted.

sentences.zh: 己卯，以施琅為福建水師提督，規取台灣，改萬正色陸路提督。

translations.literal: Day jimao: Shi Lang was appointed Fujian naval commander-in-chief to plan the recovery of Taiwan; Wan Zhengse was transferred to land-route regional commander.
translations.idiomatic: On the jimao day Shi Lang was appointed Fujian naval commander-in-chief to plan the recovery of Taiwan; Wan Zhengse was transferred to land-route regional commander.

sentences.zh: 八月辛巳朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Eighth month, first day xinsi: there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day, xinsi, of the eighth month there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，上御經筵。

translations.literal: Day yisi: the emperor presided over the Classics Lecture.
translations.idiomatic: On the yisi day the emperor presided over the Classics Lecture.

sentences.zh: 九月辛亥，上巡幸畿甸。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day xinhai: the emperor toured the metropolitan district.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the xinhai day, the emperor toured the metropolitan district.

sentences.zh: 故平南王尚可喜喪至通州，賜銀八千兩，遣官奠茶果。

translations.literal: The funeral procession of the late Pacification-of-the-South King Shang Kexi reached Tongzhou; eight thousand taels of silver were granted and officials were sent to offer tea and fruit.
translations.idiomatic: The funeral procession of the late Pacification-of-the-South King Shang Kexi reached Tongzhou; eight thousand taels of silver were granted and officials were sent to offer tea and fruit.

sentences.zh: 戊午，上次雄縣，召見知州吳鑒，問渾河水決居民被災狀。

translations.literal: Day wuwu: the emperor stopped at Xiong County, summoned Prefect Wu Jian, and inquired about flooding when the Hun River burst its banks and the plight of afflicted residents.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuwu day the emperor stopped at Xiong County, summoned Prefect Wu Jian, and inquired about the Hun River's breach and the plight of afflicted residents.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，上還京。

translations.literal: Day bingyin: the emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingyin day the emperor returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 詔停本年秋決。

translations.literal: An edict halted this year's autumn executions.
translations.idiomatic: An edict halted this year's autumn executions.

sentences.zh: 壬申，復運丁工銀。

translations.literal: Day renshen: transport-corvée labor silver was restored.
translations.idiomatic: On the renshen day transport-corvée labor silver was restored.

sentences.zh: 冬十月癸未，偏沅巡撫韓世琦敗賊將黃明於古州。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day guiwei: Huguang-west governor Han Shiqiao defeated the rebel general Huang Ming at Guzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, on the guiwei day of the tenth month, Huguang-west governor Han Shiqiao defeated the rebel general Huang Ming at Guzhou.

sentences.zh: 甲申，額魯特噶爾丹入貢。

translations.literal: Day jiashen: the Eleuth leader Galdan came to offer tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiashen day the Eleuth leader Galdan came to offer tribute.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，大學士圖海師旋，上嘉勞之。

translations.literal: Day yiyou: Grand Secretary Tu Hai's army returned; the emperor praised and rewarded him.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiyou day Grand Secretary Tu Hai's army returned; the emperor praised and rewarded him.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，詔撤平南、靖南兩籓弁兵還京。

translations.literal: Day renchen: an edict ordered the withdrawal of banner soldiers of the Pacification-of-the-South and Pacification-of-the-Southwest principalities back to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On the renchen day an edict ordered the withdrawal of banner soldiers of the Pacification-of-the-South and Pacification-of-the-Southwest principalities back to the capital.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，詔免吐魯番貢犬馬。

translations.literal: Day guimao: an edict exempted Turfan from presenting dogs and horses as tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day an edict exempted Turfan from presenting dogs and horses as tribute.

sentences.zh: 十一月辛亥，詔從賊諸人，除顯抗王師外，餘俱削官放還。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day xinhai: an edict on those who had followed the rebels — except those who had conspicuously resisted the imperial armies, all were to be stripped of office and released.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinhai day of the eleventh month an edict declared that among those who had followed the rebels, except for those who had conspicuously resisted the imperial armies, all were to be stripped of office and released.

sentences.zh: 以諾邁為漢軍都統。

translations.literal: Nuomai was appointed banner commander-in-chief of the Chinese Banners.
translations.idiomatic: Nuomai was appointed banner commander-in-chief of the Chinese Banners.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，定遠平寇大將軍貝子彰泰、平南大將軍都統賴塔、勇略將軍總督趙良棟、綏遠將軍總督蔡毓榮疏報王師於十月二十八日入雲南城，吳世璠自殺，傳首，吳三桂析骸，示中外，誅偽相方光琛，餘黨降，雲南平。

translations.literal: Grand General for Pacifying Distant Rebels Prince Zhangtai, Pacification-of-the-South Grand General and Banner Commander-in-Chief Laita, Valiant-strategy General and Governor Zhao Liangdong, and Pacification-of-the-Distance General and Governor Cai Yurong memorialized that on the twenty-eighth day of the tenth month imperial forces entered Yunnan City; Wu Shifan killed himself and his head was forwarded; Wu Sangui's remains were dismembered and displayed within and beyond the realm; the rebel chancellor Fang Guangchen was executed; the remaining adherents submitted; Yunnan was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Grand General for Pacifying Distant Rebels Prince Zhangtai, Pacification-of-the-South Grand General and Banner Commander-in-Chief Laita, Valiant-strategy General and Governor Zhao Liangdong, and Pacification-of-the-Distance General and Governor Cai Yurong memorialized that on the twenty-eighth day of the tenth month imperial forces entered Yunnan City; Wu Shifan killed himself and his head was forwarded; Wu Sangui's remains were dismembered and displayed to the realm; the rebel chancellor Fang Guangchen was executed; the remaining adherents submitted; and Yunnan was pacified.

sentences.zh: 是日，以昭告孝陵，車駕次薊州。

translations.literal: That day the victory was reported at the Xiaoling Mausoleum; the imperial carriage was at Jizhou.
translations.idiomatic: That day the victory was reported at the Xiaoling Mausoleum; the imperial carriage was at Jizhou.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，祭孝陵。

translations.literal: Day dingmao: sacrifice was offered at the Xiaoling.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingmao day sacrifice was offered at the Xiaoling.

sentences.zh: 辛未，召貝子彰泰、將軍趙良棟還京。

translations.literal: Day xinwei: Prince Zhangtai and General Zhao Liangdong were recalled to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinwei day Prince Zhangtai and General Zhao Liangdong were recalled to the capital.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，上獵於南山，發矢殪三虎。

translations.literal: Day yihai: the emperor hunted at the Southern Hills and with one arrow killed three tigers.
translations.idiomatic: On the yihai day the emperor hunted at the Southern Hills and with one arrow killed three tigers.

sentences.zh: 己卯，迴鑾。

translations.literal: Day jimao: the emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On the jimao day the emperor returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊子，設滿洲將軍駐荊州，漢軍將軍駐漢中。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day wuzi: a Manchu general was stationed at Jingzhou and a Chinese Banner general at Hanzhong.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day of the twelfth month a Manchu general was stationed at Jingzhou and a Chinese Banner general at Hanzhong.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，群臣請上尊號。

translations.literal: Day guisi: the officials petitioned that an honorific title be conferred on the emperor.
translations.idiomatic: On the guisi day the officials petitioned that an honorific title be conferred on the emperor.

sentences.zh: 敕曰：「自逆賊倡亂，莠民響應，師旅疲於徵調，閭閻敝於轉輸。

translations.literal: The imperial rescript said: "Since the rebel chieftains raised insurrection and worthless men answered their call, armies have been exhausted by levies and the common lanes worn out by transport.
translations.idiomatic: The imperial rescript said: "Since rebel chieftains raised insurrection and worthless men answered their call, armies have been exhausted by levies and common lanes worn out by transport.

sentences.zh: 加以水旱頻仍，災異疊見。

translations.literal: Floods and droughts have come in succession, and portents have piled one upon another.
translations.idiomatic: Floods and droughts have come in succession, and portents have piled one upon another.

sentences.zh: 此皆朕躬不德所致。

translations.literal: All this stems from my own want of virtue.
translations.idiomatic: All this stems from my own want of virtue.

sentences.zh: 賴宗社之靈，削平庶孽。

translations.literal: Yet by the numen of the altars of state the lesser rebels have been cut down and pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Yet by the numen of the altars of state the lesser rebels have been cut down and pacified.

sentences.zh: 方當登進賢良，與民休息，而乃侈然自足，為無謂之潤色，能勿恧乎！

translations.literal: Just when we should advance the worthy and give the people rest, to gratify ourselves and add meaningless embellishment — can we not feel shame?
translations.idiomatic: Just when we should advance the worthy and give the people rest, to gratify ourselves with meaningless embellishment — can we not feel shame?

sentences.zh: 其勿行。

translations.literal: Let the proposal not be carried out.
translations.idiomatic: Let the proposal not be carried out.

sentences.zh: 」補廣西鄉試。

translations.literal: " The supplementary Guangxi provincial examination was held.
translations.idiomatic: " The supplementary Guangxi provincial examination was held.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，大學士圖海卒。

translations.literal: Day wuxu: Grand Secretary Tu Hai died.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuxu day Grand Secretary Tu Hai died.

sentences.zh: 己亥，上御太和門受賀，宣捷中外。

translations.literal: Day jihai: the emperor received congratulations at the Gate of Supreme Harmony and proclaimed victory within and abroad.
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai day the emperor received congratulations at the Gate of Supreme Harmony and proclaimed victory within and abroad.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，加上太皇太后、皇太后徽號，頒發恩詔，賜宗室，賚外籓，予封贈，廣解額，舉隱逸，旌節孝，恤孤獨，罪非常赦不原者悉赦除之。

translations.literal: Day guimao: honorific titles were added for the Grand Empress Dowager and Empress Dowager; a grace edict was issued, grants given to the imperial clan, gifts to outer domains, ranks and favors bestowed, examination quotas expanded, hidden worthies recommended, chastity and filial piety honored, orphans and the alone succored, and all crimes not normally within an amnesty were pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day honorific titles were added for the Grand Empress Dowager and Empress Dowager; a grace edict was issued, grants given to the imperial clan, gifts to outer domains, ranks and favors bestowed, examination quotas expanded, hidden worthies recommended, chastity and filial piety honored, orphans and the destitute succored, and all crimes not normally within an amnesty were pardoned.

sentences.zh: 以于成龍為江南江西總督，吳興祚為廣東廣西總督。

translations.literal: Yu Chenglong was appointed governor-general of Jiangnan and Jiangxi; Wu Xingzuo of Guangdong and Guangxi.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Chenglong was appointed governor-general of Jiangnan and Jiangxi, and Wu Xingzuo of Guangdong and Guangxi.

sentences.zh: 丁未，祫祭太廟。

translations.literal: Day dingwei: the collective ancestral temple rites were performed.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingwei day the collective ancestral temple rites were performed.

sentences.zh: 是歲，免直隸、江南、江西、山東、山西、浙江、福建等省七十五州縣災賦有差。

translations.literal: That year disaster remissions of land tax were granted, in varying amounts, to seventy-five districts in Zhili, Jiangnan, Jiangxi, Shandong, Shanxi, Zhejiang, Fujian, and other provinces.
translations.idiomatic: That year disaster remissions of land tax were granted, in varying amounts, to seventy-five districts in Zhili, Jiangnan, Jiangxi, Shandong, Shanxi, Zhejiang, Fujian, and other provinces.

sentences.zh: 丁戶一千七百二十三萬，徵銀二千二百一十八萬三千七百六十兩有奇。

translations.literal: Registered ding households numbered seventeen million two hundred thirty thousand; land-tax receipts came to twenty-two million one hundred eighty-three thousand seven hundred sixty taels and odd cash.
translations.idiomatic: Registered ding households totaled 17,230,000; land-tax receipts came to 22,183,760 taels and odd cash.

sentences.zh: 鹽、茶課銀二百三十九萬九千四百六十八兩。

translations.literal: Salt and tea levies produced two million three hundred ninety-nine thousand four hundred sixty-eight taels.
translations.idiomatic: Salt and tea levies produced 2,399,468 taels.

sentences.zh: 鑄錢二萬三千一百三十九萬。

translations.literal: Cash coined totaled two hundred thirty-one million three hundred ninety thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Cash coined totaled 231,390,000 wen.

sentences.zh: 朝鮮、厄魯特入貢。

translations.literal: Korea and the Eleuths presented tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Korea and the Eleuths presented tribute.
